source: You approach a man whose hard work and plenty have left their marks. There is a stout strength about him, but it carries a prodigious gut.
translation: 你走近一个男子，辛勤的劳作和富足的生活在他身上留下了痕迹。他体格结实有力，却挺着一个硕大的肚子。

raw_item.translation: 莱奥弗里克的微笑渐渐褪去，化作哀伤。

source: Leofric's smile fades into sadness.
translation: 莱奥弗里克的微笑渐渐褪去，化作哀伤。

raw_item.translation: 你抓住附近的一处岩沿，小心地开始向上攀爬。爬到洞壁约莫一半高度时，你手一滑没抓稳。你本能地伸手去抓墙上[P1]任何[P2]能抓的东西，同时把身体的重心往前移。

source: You grab on to a nearby ledge and carefully start climbing up. About halfway up the cave wall, your grip fails you. You instinctively reach for [i]anything[/i] on the wall, and shift the weight of your body forward.
translation: 你抓住附近的一处岩沿，小心地开始向上攀爬。爬到洞壁约莫一半高度时，你手一滑没抓稳。你本能地伸手去抓墙上[i]任何[/i]能抓的东西，同时把身体的重心往前移。

raw_item.translation: 你的金银上沾满了同胞兄弟的鲜血。

source: Your gold and your silver is covered in the blood of brethren.
translation: 你的金银上沾满了同胞兄弟的鲜血。

raw_item.translation: 凯蒂尔笑的更多是姑娘们的反应，而不是冲着你。

source: Ketill smiles more at the girls' reaction than at you.
translation: 凯蒂尔笑的更多是姑娘们的反应，而不是冲着你。

raw_item.translation: 我来这儿就是干这个的——陛下决定他想要什么，我来想办法弄到手。

source: That's what I'm here for - his majesty decides what he wants, I figure out how to get it.
translation: 我来这儿就是干这个的——陛下决定他想要什么，我来想办法弄到手。

raw_item.translation: 喂，[P1]。我跟你说，能亲手造一艘长船，我真是激动得没法形容。这将会是我的得意之作，你就等着瞧吧。

source: Ho there, [Player:Name]. I can't tell you how excited I am to finally build a longship. This is going to be my master piece, just you wait.
translation: 喂，[Player:Name]。我跟你说，能亲手造一艘长船，我真是激动得没法形容。这将会是我的得意之作，你就等着瞧吧。

raw_item.translation: 我们从诺森布里亚各地带来兽皮和工具。我们的兽皮足以抵御这些岛屿上的恶劣天气。

source: We bring hides and tools from all over Northumbria. Our hides will protect well against the harsh weather of these isles.
translation: 我们从诺森布里亚各地带来兽皮和工具。我们的兽皮足以抵御这些岛屿上的恶劣天气。

raw_item.translation: 格兰妮清楚这件事的细节。去吧，让她告诉你需要做些什么。

source: Grainne knows the particulars of the matter. Go on, let her tell you what needs to be done.
translation: 格兰妮清楚这件事的细节。去吧，让她告诉你需要做些什么。

raw_item.translation: 在奥丁的庇佑下，我们已经粉碎了你们那可怜又可悲的防御。很快，你们都将归属于众神之父！

source: With Odinn's help, we have crushed your pathetic defences. Soon, you will all belong to the Allfather!
translation: 在奥丁的庇佑下，我们已经粉碎了你们那可怜又可悲的防御。很快，你们都将归属于众神之父！

raw_item.translation: 这头猪是弗利里的吗？

source: Does the pig belong to Fliri?
translation: 这头猪是弗利里的吗？

raw_item.translation: 你还没来得及有机会自卫，他就转身扬长而去。

source: Before you have a chance to defend yourself, he turns on his heels and stalks away.
translation: 你还没来得及有机会自卫，他就转身扬长而去。

raw_item.translation: {扇他一巴掌。} 清醒点！

source: {Slap him.} Snap out of it!
translation: {扇他一巴掌。} 清醒点！

raw_item.translation: 你、凯蒂尔还有内夫娅……你们都这么年轻。我知道你们大概觉得自己天下无敌，可你们得互相照应着点。

source: You, Ketill, and Nefja... you're all so young. I know you probably feel invincible, but you need to watch out for each other.
translation: 你、凯蒂尔还有内夫娅……你们都这么年轻。我知道你们大概觉得自己天下无敌，可你们得互相照应着点。

raw_item.translation: 深入黑暗

source: Into The Dark
translation: 深入黑暗

raw_item.translation: 谢谢你。

source: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢你。

raw_item.translation: 如果我是个更强壮的男人，你本就不用这样。

source: You wouldn't have had to if I were a stronger man.
translation: 如果我是个更强壮的男人，你本就不用这样。

raw_item.translation: 内夫娅郑重地点点头，后退一步。

source: Nefja nods gravely and takes a step back.
translation: 内夫娅郑重地点点头，后退一步。

raw_item.translation: 你是想吓唬我，好让我赶紧好起来吗？过来吧，你。

source: Are you trying to terrify me into getting well? Come here, you.
translation: 你是想吓唬我，好让我赶紧好起来吗？过来吧，你。

raw_item.translation: 干得不错。他们看起来累得不轻，但肯定有不少实战经验。能有他们站在我们这边是好事。

source: Well, good job. They seem pretty worn out, but they must have a lot of armed combat experience. They'll be good to have on our side.
translation: 干得不错。他们看起来累得不轻，但肯定有不少实战经验。能有他们站在我们这边是好事。

raw_item.translation: 埃塞尔雷德狡黠地一笑。

source: Æthelred smiles shrewdly.
translation: 埃塞尔雷德狡黠地一笑。

raw_item.translation: 他脸上的悔意越来越浓。

source: His face grows every more regretful.
translation: 他脸上的悔意越来越浓。

raw_item.translation: 啊！等等！我卡住了！

source: Argh! Wait! I'm stuck!
translation: 啊！等等！我卡住了！

raw_item.translation: 越界的人正是[P1]你[P2]！你辜负了我们所有人对你的信任，利用我们的忠诚去达成什么目的，我实在看不透。

source: It is [i]you[/i] who are out of line! You are betraying the trust we all place in you, exploiting our loyalty for whatever indescernible end I simply cannot fathom.
translation: 越界的人正是[i]你[/i]！你辜负了我们所有人对你的信任，利用我们的忠诚去达成什么目的，我实在看不透。

raw_item.translation: 你不会得逞的！

source: You won't get away with this!
translation: 你不会得逞的！

raw_item.translation: 风忽然像是刮了起来，猛烈地穿过树林。你在空气中似乎闻到了烧焦的香料味。只持续了一瞬便消失了——也许是你想象出来的。

source: The wind suddenly seems to kick up, rushing through the trees with great force. On the air you think you smell burnt spices. It only lasts a moment, then it's gone - perhaps you imagined it.
translation: 风忽然像是刮了起来，猛烈地穿过树林。你在空气中似乎闻到了烧焦的香料味。只持续了一瞬便消失了——也许是你想象出来的。

raw_item.translation: 你是被迫向奥斯雷德宣誓效忠的吗？

source: Were you made to swear an oath of allegiance to Osred?
translation: 你是被迫向奥斯雷德宣誓效忠的吗？

raw_item.translation: 抱歉，我认识你吗？

source: I'm sorry, do I know you?
translation: 抱歉，我认识你吗？

raw_item.translation: 这趟行程会很危险。你得出一份力。

source: It'll be a dangerous trip. You'll have to contribute.
translation: 这趟行程会很危险。你得出一份力。

raw_item.translation: 只要我们能腾出时间，你愿意带我回家的话……我会很感激。

source: As soon as we can spare the time, if you'll take me back home... I'd be grateful.
translation: 只要我们能腾出时间，你愿意带我回家的话……我会很感激。

raw_item.translation: 然后，她仍旧哭着，转身跑出邓弗里斯，拼命迈开双腿狂奔。

source: Then, still crying, she turns and runs out of Dun Phris as fast as her legs will carry her.
translation: 然后，她仍旧哭着，转身跑出邓弗里斯，拼命迈开双腿狂奔。

raw_item.translation: 你想让我们做什么？

source: What are you asking us to do?
translation: 你想让我们做什么？

raw_item.translation: 呃，不，我们会杀了你。但如果你看重自己的自由，就不该让这吓住你。

source: Well no, we would kill you. But if you value your freedom, you shouldn't let that stop you.
translation: 呃，不，我们会杀了你。但如果你看重自己的自由，就不该让这吓住你。

raw_item.translation: 好吧。这听着还算公道。

source: Alright. That seems fair.
translation: 好吧。这听着还算公道。

raw_item.translation: 巡逻的哨兵有三个，营地里面还有五个人。他们看起来装备都很精良。

source: Three sentries on patrol, five more people inside the camp. They all look really well equipped.
translation: 巡逻的哨兵有三个，营地里面还有五个人。他们看起来装备都很精良。

raw_item.translation: 考斯坦丁看着基利安，神情里既怜悯又带着责备。

source: Caustantin regards Cillian with a mixture of pity and reproach.
translation: 考斯坦丁看着基利安，神情里既怜悯又带着责备。

raw_item.translation: 你觉得呢？

source: What do you think?
translation: 你觉得呢？

raw_item.translation: 恐怕我们仍然是日德兰最穷的氏族之一。你父亲那些壮举、宴会、今年冬天劫掠造成的损失，再加上建造[P1]……我们状况很糟。

source: I'm afraid we remain one of the poorest clans in Jutland. Between your father's exploits, the feast, the damage done in the raid this winter, and building [Shipname]... we're in bad shape.
translation: 恐怕我们仍然是日德兰最穷的氏族之一。你父亲那些壮举、宴会、今年冬天劫掠造成的损失，再加上建造[Shipname]……我们状况很糟。

raw_item.translation: 船还没有盖上。你从木制座椅下面摸出一个亚麻布袋，里面装满了兽皮和各式贵重物品。

source: The boat has not been covered. Tucked beneath the wooden seat you find a linen sack full of hides and sundry valuables.
translation: 船还没有盖上。你从木制座椅下面摸出一个亚麻布袋，里面装满了兽皮和各式贵重物品。

raw_item.translation: 斯泰因笑得合不拢嘴，就像女儿婚礼上骄傲的父亲。

source: Steinn beams like a proud father at his daughter's wedding.
translation: 斯泰因笑得合不拢嘴，就像女儿婚礼上骄傲的父亲。

raw_item.translation: 她注意到你在看她，便停止了挣扎。

source: She notices you looking at her, and stops struggling.
translation: 她注意到你在看她，便停止了挣扎。

raw_item.translation: 英吉马尔邀请你为已故的父亲饮酒。

source: Ingimarr has invited you to drink to your late father.
translation: 英吉马尔邀请你为已故的父亲饮酒。

raw_item.translation: 听着，你到底要不要我们帮忙？

source: Look, do you want our help or not?
translation: 听着，你到底要不要我们帮忙？

raw_item.translation: 我放了那个密探，但不会再有情报送到奥斯雷德那里了。

source: I let the spy go, but there'll be no more reports to Osred.
translation: 我放了那个密探，但不会再有情报送到奥斯雷德那里了。

raw_item.translation: 我正在奥克尼群岛集结军队。我们要拿下珀斯和约克。如果你在这件事上帮我们，我保证你独立。

source: I'm mustering an army on Orkneyjar. We will take Perth and Eoforwic. If you aid us in this, I guarantee your independence.
translation: 我正在奥克尼群岛集结军队。我们要拿下珀斯和约克。如果你在这件事上帮我们，我保证你独立。

raw_item.translation: 他为什么派两拨人去偷同一样东西？这是个陷阱，对吧？

source: Why would he send two groups to steal the same thing? This is some sort of trap, isn't it?
translation: 他为什么派两拨人去偷同一样东西？这是个陷阱，对吧？

raw_item.translation: 山崩！要是他们放开那些巨石，我们会损失惨重！

source: A rockslide! If they loose those boulders, we'll suffer heavy losses!
translation: 山崩！要是他们放开那些巨石，我们会损失惨重！

raw_item.translation: 很高兴认识你，马班。

source: Pleasure to meet you, Maban.
translation: 很高兴认识你，马班。

raw_item.translation: 我是说，家里的人都觉得你和内夫娅早晚要成亲，可你从没往前迈过一步。

source: I mean, everyone at home always figured you and Nefja for a marriage waiting to happen, but you never went for it.
translation: 我是说，家里的人都觉得你和内夫娅早晚要成亲，可你从没往前迈过一步。

raw_item.translation: 命名长船

source: Name Longship
translation: 命名长船

raw_item.translation: 某种不属于这个世界的东西。我们不该逗留。

source: Something out of this world. We shouldn't tarry.
translation: 某种不属于这个世界的东西。我们不该逗留。

raw_item.translation: 你真不像你父亲。

source: How unlike your father you are.
translation: 你真不像你父亲。

raw_item.translation: 这场对峙酝酿已久了。

source: This confrontation has been a long time coming.
translation: 这场对峙酝酿已久了。

raw_item.translation: 你们就是要去拿下里堡的人，对吧？我们会准备好。

source: You're the ones who'll take the milecastle, right? We'll be ready.
translation: 你们就是要去拿下里堡的人，对吧？我们会准备好。

raw_item.translation: 约斯泰因迅速从一名倒下的守卫身上抓起一把刀，割断了丹尔的绳子。

source: Josteinn quickly grabs a knife from a fallen guard and cuts Danr's ropes.
translation: 约斯泰因迅速从一名倒下的守卫身上抓起一把刀，割断了丹尔的绳子。

raw_item.translation: 又是一轮掌声，这次是为你。掌声起初很慢，虔诚的郡长们之间交换着许多犹豫的目光，但很快便汇成一片真诚而发自内心的赞颂。

source: Another round of applause, this time for you. It starts slowly, with many a hesitant glance exchanged between pious ealdormen, but soon it builds to a genuine and heartfelt tribute.
translation: 又是一轮掌声，这次是为你。掌声起初很慢，虔诚的郡长们之间交换着许多犹豫的目光，但很快便汇成一片真诚而发自内心的赞颂。

raw_item.translation: 我想我还是帮帮你吧。

source: I guess I'd better help you.
translation: 我想我还是帮帮你吧。

raw_item.translation: 总算走了。

source: Good riddance.
translation: 总算走了。

raw_item.translation: 你们这些僧侣好像什么都知道。

source: You monks seem to know an awful lot of things.
translation: 你们这些僧侣好像什么都知道。

raw_item.translation: 你能描述一下他们的领袖吗？

source: Can you describe their leader?
translation: 你能描述一下他们的领袖吗？

raw_item.translation: 去吧。去接管菲亚德林尼。不管[P1]在谋划什么，我们都要让它尽可能难以得逞。

source: Go. Take command of Fjardlinni. Whatever [Player:Name] is planning, we will make it as difficult as possible.
translation: 去吧。去接管菲亚德林尼。不管[Player:Name]在谋划什么，我们都要让它尽可能难以得逞。

raw_item.translation: 怎么了？

source: What is it?
translation: 怎么了？

raw_item.translation: 这是怎么回事？这些人是谁？

source: What's this? Who are these people?
translation: 这是怎么回事？这些人是谁？

raw_item.translation: 让那些杂种尝尝地狱的滋味。他们活该承受你能做的最狠的事。

source: Unleash Hell upon those bastards. They deserve the worst you can do.
translation: 让那些杂种尝尝地狱的滋味。他们活该承受你能做的最狠的事。

raw_item.translation: 你琢磨着怎样才能最好地完成这件事，随后意识到，没有远程武器，你什么也做不了。还没等你发动伏击，他们就会发现你。

source: You consider how best to accomplish the task, and realise that without a ranged weapon, there is nothing you can do. They would know of your presence before you could spring the ambush.
translation: 你琢磨着怎样才能最好地完成这件事，随后意识到，没有远程武器，你什么也做不了。还没等你发动伏击，他们就会发现你。

raw_item.translation: 一个孤零零的奴隶正在农场外围劈柴。听到你走近，他放下斧，抹去额头的汗水。

source: A solitary thrall is chopping firewood on the outskirts of the farm. Hearing your approach, he puts down the axe and wipes the sweat from his brow.
translation: 一个孤零零的奴隶正在农场外围劈柴。听到你走近，他放下斧，抹去额头的汗水。

raw_item.translation: 看在诸神的份上，这次他真要逼我们杀了他，是吧？

source: By the gods, he's going to make us kill him this time, isn't he?
translation: 看在诸神的份上，这次他真要逼我们杀了他，是吧？

raw_item.translation: 早晨醒来时，你身上只盖着一张毛皮，双脚被露水浸湿。

source: You awake in the morning barely covered by a single pelt, feet wet from the dew.
translation: 早晨醒来时，你身上只盖着一张毛皮，双脚被露水浸湿。

raw_item.translation: 你该趁他们其余人还没到，赶紧过去。

source: You should hurry across before the rest of them get here.
translation: 你该趁他们其余人还没到，赶紧过去。

raw_item.translation: 对，你大概说得没错，他确实该得到这份尊重。

source: Yeah you're probably right, he does deserve that much respect.
translation: 对，你大概说得没错，他确实该得到这份尊重。

raw_item.translation: 埃安巴尔德说话结结巴巴。

source: Eanbald splutters.
translation: 埃安巴尔德说话结结巴巴。

raw_item.translation: 我相信你不会失望的。

source: I'm sure you won't be disappointed.
translation: 我相信你不会失望的。

raw_item.translation: 斯库勒是耶灵的领主，众所周知，他与诺斯人整体上关系紧密，与考庞更是如此，而斯库勒显然对你的领地有所图谋。

source: Skule, the thegn of Jelling, is known to have strong ties to the Northmen in general and Kaupang in particular, and Skule clearly has designs on your territory.
translation: 斯库勒是耶灵的领主，众所周知，他与诺斯人整体上关系紧密，与考庞更是如此，而斯库勒显然对你的领地有所图谋。

raw_item.translation: 那信标怎么没有点燃？

source: And how is it the beacons weren't lit?
translation: 那信标怎么没有点燃？

raw_item.translation: 那些被他激怒的人担心，你无法带来他们所期望的改变。这不是你的错。

source: Those he angered fear that you won't bring the change they desire. It's not your fault.
translation: 那些被他激怒的人担心，你无法带来他们所期望的改变。这不是你的错。

raw_item.translation: 你[P1]竟敢[P2]如此，你这毒蛇？！

source: How [i]dare[/i] you, you snake?!
translation: 你[i]竟敢[/i]如此，你这毒蛇？！

raw_item.translation: 你穿行于沼泽之中，双腿被泥泞的土地浸湿，[P1]从前方喊了你一声。

source: As you're travelling through the marshes, your legs wet from the swampy earth, [Pointman:Name] calls out from up ahead of you.
translation: 你穿行于沼泽之中，双腿被泥泞的土地浸湿，[Pointman:Name]从前方喊了你一声。

raw_item.translation: {Attack.} 这一切都是你们自找的。

source: {Attack.} You've all brought this on yourselves.
translation: {Attack.} 这一切都是你们自找的。

raw_item.translation: 这名字可真拗口。

source: That's a mouthful.
translation: 这名字可真拗口。

raw_item.translation: 内夫娅站起身。她绷紧了下颌，双手攥成拳头。

source: Nefja stands. Her jaw is tight and her hands are clenched into fists.
translation: 内夫娅站起身。她绷紧了下颌，双手攥成拳头。

raw_item.translation: 不管你们供奉我们的诸神，还是谁也不供奉，对他们来说都一样。只要我们不供奉[i]他们[/i]的上帝就行。

source: Whether you worship our gods or no gods, it's all the same to them. As long as we don't worship [i]their[/i] god.
translation: 不管你们供奉我们的诸神，还是谁也不供奉，对他们来说都一样。只要我们不供奉[i]他们[/i]的上帝就行。

raw_item.translation: 诺森布里亚最优秀的战士也不是我们的对手。

source: The best warrior in Northumbria was no match for us.
translation: 诺森布里亚最优秀的战士也不是我们的对手。

raw_item.translation: {屈服于她的魅力。}

source: {Surrender to her charms.}
translation: {屈服于她的魅力。}

raw_item.translation: [P1]，你已证明自己既能干又重荣誉。我在想……

source: [Player:Name], you've proven yourself to be both capable and honourable. I was thinking...
translation: [Player:Name]，你已证明自己既能干又重荣誉。我在想……

raw_item.translation: 我明白。没有冒犯。

source: I understand. No offence taken.
translation: 我明白。没有冒犯。

raw_item.translation: 你们一同回到营地，洗得干干净净，重新穿好了衣服。

source: You return to the camp together, well washed and back in your clothes.
translation: 你们一同回到营地，洗得干干净净，重新穿好了衣服。

raw_item.translation: 内夫娅极力忍着不哭出来，做得令人敬佩。

source: Nefja is doing an admirable job of not crying.
translation: 内夫娅极力忍着不哭出来，做得令人敬佩。

raw_item.translation: 很好。

source: Good.
translation: 很好。

raw_item.translation: 再想想，这事就交给你们了。

source: On second thought, we'll leave you to it.
translation: 再想想，这事就交给你们了。

raw_item.translation: 奴隶贩子耸了耸肩。

source: The slaver shrugs.
translation: 奴隶贩子耸了耸肩。

raw_item.translation: 格兰妮的笑声如今干涩而轻蔑，全无平日那种温暖的颤音。

source: Far from its normal warm trill, Grainne's laughter now is flat and disdainful.
translation: 格兰妮的笑声如今干涩而轻蔑，全无平日那种温暖的颤音。

raw_item.translation: 很好，这下就够了。给我几个小时，我就能治好你朋友的病。

source: Very good. This will do nicely. Give me a few hours, and I will have a remedy for your friend's affliction.
translation: 很好，这下就够了。给我几个小时，我就能治好你朋友的病。

raw_item.translation: 你知道怎么防身吗？

source: Do you know how to defend yourself?
translation: 你知道怎么防身吗？

raw_item.translation: 很好，很快我就有机会谢谢他把你派来了。我们俩都会跟你一起回珀斯——这是你应得的。

source: Well, soon I'll get a chance to thank him for sending you. We'll both come with you back to Perth - you've earned that much.
translation: 很好，很快我就有机会谢谢他把你派来了。我们俩都会跟你一起回珀斯——这是你应得的。

raw_item.translation: 这里是罗慕路斯军团的地盘。你可以参观要塞，但禁止进入礼拜堂。

source: This place is the domain of the Legion of Romulus. You may visit the fortress, but you're forbidden from entering the chapel.
translation: 这里是罗慕路斯军团的地盘。你可以参观要塞，但禁止进入礼拜堂。

raw_item.translation: 我不能背叛德鲁伊！我[P1]绝[P2]不会！

source: I cannae betray the druid! I [i]will[/i] not!
translation: 我不能背叛德鲁伊！我[i]绝[/i]不会！

raw_item.translation: 你在守着这个入口，防的是谁？

source: Against whom do you guard this entrance?
translation: 你在守着这个入口，防的是谁？

raw_item.translation: 想要别人的性命或土地，就得趁早起身。

source: Wake early if you want another man's life or land.
translation: 想要别人的性命或土地，就得趁早起身。

raw_item.translation: {Leave.}

source: {Leave.}
translation: {Leave.}

raw_item.translation: 收集西格加的所有悬赏。

source: Collect all of Sicga's bounties.
translation: 收集西格加的所有悬赏。

raw_item.translation: 那儿！南边又来了更多！

source: There! More of them from the South!
translation: 那儿！南边又来了更多！

raw_item.translation: 成交。

source: Deal.
translation: 成交。

raw_item.translation: 当地的征召民兵已聚集起来，召开紧急会议。

source: The local fyrd has gathered for an emergency meeting.
translation: 当地的征召民兵已聚集起来，召开紧急会议。

raw_item.translation: 这时，她的目光扫过在场的听众，脸上又浮现出温和的微笑，整个人似乎也稍稍沉静下来。

source: Now, as her gaze drifts across her audience, the mild smile returns to her face, and she seems to sink a little.
translation: 这时，她的目光扫过在场的听众，脸上又浮现出温和的微笑，整个人似乎也稍稍沉静下来。

raw_item.translation: {Raid the garden.}先到先得。

source: {Raid the garden.} Finders keepers.
translation: {Raid the garden.}先到先得。

raw_item.translation: 矛将在下一回合命中目标，使占据目标六角格的任何人立即失去行动能力。

source: The spear will hit its target on the next turn, instantly incapacitating anybody occupying the target hex.
translation: 矛将在下一回合命中目标，使占据目标六角格的任何人立即失去行动能力。

raw_item.translation: 过了很久，你的亲卫队成员一个接一个地从水中冒了出来。

source: After a long while, your hirdmen emerge from the water one by one.
translation: 过了很久，你的亲卫队成员一个接一个地从水中冒了出来。

raw_item.translation: 船上见。

source: See you back on the ship.
translation: 船上见。

raw_item.translation: [P1]跟某个氏族领袖之子打了一架。[P2]处理了打出来的伤势。

source: [Aggressive:Name] starting a fight with some clan leader's son. [Altruistic:Name] treating the resulting injuries.
translation: [Aggressive:Name]跟某个氏族领袖之子打了一架。[Altruistic:Name]处理了打出来的伤势。

raw_item.translation: [P1]站起身，紧紧抓住你的手臂。自豪之情在[P2]脸上熠熠生辉。

source: [Bannerman:Name] stands and grasps your arm firmly. Pride shines brightly from [Bannerman:his/her] face.
translation: [Bannerman:Name]站起身，紧紧抓住你的手臂。自豪之情在[Bannerman:his/her]脸上熠熠生辉。

raw_item.translation: 打完了叫我起来就行。

source: Just wake me up when the fight is over.
translation: 打完了叫我起来就行。

raw_item.translation: 真可惜。他是个好人。

source: Damn shame. He was a fine man.
translation: 真可惜。他是个好人。

raw_item.translation: 留到我们觐见西居尔德国王时再说。

source: Leave it for our audience with King Sigurdr.
translation: 留到我们觐见西居尔德国王时再说。

raw_item.translation: 只是皮肉伤，没必要为这点事去麻烦[P1]。

source: It's just a flesh wound, there's no need to trouble [Healer:him/her] about it.
translation: 只是皮肉伤，没必要为这点事去麻烦[Healer:him/her]。

raw_item.translation: 空的。不意外。我们该把发生的事告诉军械总管。

source: Empty. No surprise there. We should tell the master-of-arms what happened.
translation: 空的。不意外。我们该把发生的事告诉军械总管。

raw_item.translation: 这事迟早会来。我很高兴总算发生了。

source: It's been a long time coming. I'm glad it finally happened.
translation: 这事迟早会来。我很高兴总算发生了。

source: [i]Crude.[/i]
translation: [i]粗鲁。[/i]

raw_item.translation: 就咱俩说？我倒希望他们别守得太严——上一仗打完，我可太需要一场漂亮胜利了！

source: Between you and me? I hope they're not entirely undefended - I could use a good victory after that last battle!
translation: 就咱俩说？我倒希望他们别守得太严——上一仗打完，我可太需要一场漂亮胜利了！

raw_item.translation: 来，我扶着你。

source: Here, I've got you.
translation: 来，我扶着你。

raw_item.translation: 你熟悉雷穆斯和罗慕路斯的故事吗？

source: You're familiar with the story of Remus and Romulus?
translation: 你熟悉雷穆斯和罗慕路斯的故事吗？

raw_item.translation: 到目前为止，我一直是这么选的，没错。要是你心里有更好的办法，尽管自己去办。

source: That has been my choice so far, yes. If you have a better solution in mind, you are welcome to handle it yourself.
translation: 到目前为止，我一直是这么选的，没错。要是你心里有更好的办法，尽管自己去办。

raw_item.translation: 你没事吧？

source: Are you all right?
translation: 你没事吧？

raw_item.translation: 你看到地上那个了吗？那根绳索？

source: Do you see that, on the ground? The rope?
translation: 你看到地上那个了吗？那根绳索？

raw_item.translation: 一个锋利的声音顺着隧道回荡而下，刺耳的回响中透出几分愤怒。

source: A sharp voice echoes down the tunnel, and the harsh reverb exposes undertones of outrage.
translation: 一个锋利的声音顺着隧道回荡而下，刺耳的回响中透出几分愤怒。

raw_item.translation: 快到午夜了，宴席眼看就要散场，可那一桶桶麦酒仿佛怎么也喝不完。国王挨个照看他的宾客，最后走到了你面前。

source: It's nearing midnight and the meal is almost over, but the caskets of ale appear to be bottomless. The king is checking on each of his guests in turn and makes his way eventually to you.
translation: 快到午夜了，宴席眼看就要散场，可那一桶桶麦酒仿佛怎么也喝不完。国王挨个照看他的宾客，最后走到了你面前。

raw_item.translation: 在邓弗里斯解决皮克特维亚与诺森布里亚之间的僵局。

source: Resolve the stalemate between Pictavia and Northumbria at Dun Phris.
translation: 在邓弗里斯解决皮克特维亚与诺森布里亚之间的僵局。

raw_item.translation: 我们[P1]俩[P2]都跟你一起去，只要把基利安平安带回来就行！

source: We'll [i]both[/i] come with you, just bring Cillian back safe!
translation: 我们[i]俩[/i]都跟你一起去，只要把基利安平安带回来就行！

raw_item.translation: 莫坎特把目光从贡纳尔那不满的注视上移开，索性不再祈祷了。过了片刻，乌尔夫赫丁大步走开，去忙他的任务了。莫坎特抬起头，发现你正看着他。

source: Morcant averts his eyes from Gunnarr's disapproving stare and stops praying altogether. After a few moments, the Ulfhedinn stalks off to go about his tasks. Morcant looks up to see you watching him.
translation: 莫坎特把目光从贡纳尔那不满的注视上移开，索性不再祈祷了。过了片刻，乌尔夫赫丁大步走开，去忙他的任务了。莫坎特抬起头，发现你正看着他。

raw_item.translation: 他总担心哪天嗜血狂暴会压过他，分不清敌友，或者干脆就不在乎了。到时候他那把该死的大斧就劈进我脑袋里了。

source: Always worried the bloodlust'll overtake him one day. Lose track of friend or foe, or just stop caring. Find myself with that bloody big axe of his half-way through my skull.
translation: 他总担心哪天嗜血狂暴会压过他，分不清敌友，或者干脆就不在乎了。到时候他那把该死的大斧就劈进我脑袋里了。

raw_item.translation: 要是我们插手，只会给自己惹上麻烦。

source: If we interfere we'll just get in trouble ourselves.
translation: 要是我们插手，只会给自己惹上麻烦。

raw_item.translation: 随你怎么跟自己解释吧。

source: Whatever you need to tell yourself.
translation: 随你怎么跟自己解释吧。

raw_item.translation: 有那么一瞬间，阿斯莱夫的表情只剩下震惊。随后他咬紧牙关，眉头深锁，骄傲地挺直了背。

source: For a brief moment, Asleifr's expression is pure shock. Then he clenches his jaw, frowns deeply, and straightens his back proudly.
translation: 有那么一瞬间，阿斯莱夫的表情只剩下震惊。随后他咬紧牙关，眉头深锁，骄傲地挺直了背。

raw_item.translation: 他重重地摇了摇头。

source: He shakes his head heavily.
translation: 他重重地摇了摇头。

raw_item.translation: 神父！

source: Father!
translation: 神父！

raw_item.translation: 多亏你诊断迅速、处置及时，[P1]很快就会康复，也不会受多少罪。几个时辰之后，[P2]就能扔掉药膏，这场磨难几乎没留下什么痕迹。

source: Thanks to your quick diagnosis and response, [Victim:Name] will recover quickly and with little discomfort. Over the course of a few hours, [Victim:he/she] is able to toss away the poultice with nary a mark to show for the ordeal.
translation: 多亏你诊断迅速、处置及时，[Victim:Name]很快就会康复，也不会受多少罪。几个时辰之后，[Victim:he/she]就能扔掉药膏，这场磨难几乎没留下什么痕迹。

raw_item.translation: 一片阴云笼上了唐科尔凯的脸。

source: A shadow settles over Donncoirce's face.
translation: 一片阴云笼上了唐科尔凯的脸。

raw_item.translation: 能为诺森布里亚王国效劳，一向是我的荣幸。

source: Always a pleasure to be of service to the Kingdom of Northumbria.
translation: 能为诺森布里亚王国效劳，一向是我的荣幸。

raw_item.translation: {坚毅地点头。}

source: {Nod stoically.}
translation: {坚毅地点头。}

raw_item.translation: 你必须接受这个事实：这也许是你最后一次见到凯蒂尔了。

source: You must accept the truth that this may be the last time you see Ketill.
translation: 你必须接受这个事实：这也许是你最后一次见到凯蒂尔了。

raw_item.translation: 你是哪里人？

source: Where are you from?
translation: 你是哪里人？

raw_item.translation: 啊，你回来了！找到他们了吗？

source: Ah, you're back! Did you find them?
translation: 啊，你回来了！找到他们了吗？

raw_item.translation: 回到营地后，那个僧侣提到过这条河里有什么怪物。

source: Back in camp the monk mentioned something about a monster in the river here.
translation: 回到营地后，那个僧侣提到过这条河里有什么怪物。

raw_item.translation: 四个小时后，瓦达和莱奥弗里克从下方的峡谷里爬了上来。

source: Four hours later, Wada and Leofric come up out of the ravine below.
translation: 四个小时后，瓦达和莱奥弗里克从下方的峡谷里爬了上来。

raw_item.translation: 但这是[P1]你[P2]的宴席。我会看着阿斯莱夫和他的朋友们，你该放松下来好好享受。

source: But this is [i]your[/i] feast. I'll watch Asleifr and his friends, you should relax and enjoy yourself.
translation: 但这是[i]你[/i]的宴席。我会看着阿斯莱夫和他的朋友们，你该放松下来好好享受。

raw_item.translation: 刚才那是怎么回事？

source: What was that all about?
translation: 刚才那是怎么回事？

raw_item.translation: 就是出去打猎。稍微迷了会儿路，不过最后还是找回原路了。

source: Just out hunting. Got a little lost, but I found the trail back eventually.
translation: 就是出去打猎。稍微迷了会儿路，不过最后还是找回原路了。

raw_item.translation: 我们的家向任何勇敢而睿智、能走完这段旅程的朝圣者敞开。

source: Our home is open to any pilgrim brave and wise enough to make the journey.
translation: 我们的家向任何勇敢而睿智、能走完这段旅程的朝圣者敞开。

raw_item.translation: 我建议你去镇上我们神庙里请教女祭司。如果这些标记带有宗教性质，她会知道它们是什么。

source: I would advise you to consult the gydja at our temple here in town. If these markings are religious in nature, she will know what they are.
translation: 我建议你去镇上我们神庙里请教女祭司。如果这些标记带有宗教性质，她会知道它们是什么。

raw_item.translation: 不仅如此，我们也找不到对抗他的盟友。

source: Not only that, but we'll find no allies against him.
translation: 不仅如此，我们也找不到对抗他的盟友。

raw_item.translation: 埃芙拉只是虚弱地轻笑了一声。

source: Eyfura just chuckles weakly.
translation: 埃芙拉只是虚弱地轻笑了一声。

raw_item.translation: 办完了吗？

source: Is it done?
translation: 办完了吗？

raw_item.translation: 她越过你的肩膀看向罗斯克娃。随后她的神情柔和了下来。

source: She looks over your shoulder at Røskva. Then her features soften.
translation: 她越过你的肩膀看向罗斯克娃。随后她的神情柔和了下来。

raw_item.translation: 检查完一切后，[P1]又对你说话了。

source: After having checked everything, [Helper:Name] addresses you again.
translation: 检查完一切后，[Helper:Name]又对你说话了。

raw_item.translation: 我觉得我能住在这样的地方。这里有一种安全感。我觉得这里会是个养孩子的好地方。

source: I think I could live in a place like this. There's a sense of safety here. I think it would be a good place to raise children.
translation: 我觉得我能住在这样的地方。这里有一种安全感。我觉得这里会是个养孩子的好地方。

raw_item.translation: 约迪斯的头盔

source: Jodis' Helmet
translation: 约迪斯的头盔

raw_item.translation: 我只希望事情不是这样。你们两家之间这种毫无意义的争端，早晚会把氏族撕成两半。

source: I only wish things had been different. This pointless dispute between your families will tear the clan apart one day.
translation: 我只希望事情不是这样。你们两家之间这种毫无意义的争端，早晚会把氏族撕成两半。

raw_item.translation: 还记得吗？我们把这里变成了阿斯加德，还得击退约顿巨人的入侵。

source: Remember when we turned this into Asgard and we had to fend off a Jøtunn invasion?
translation: 还记得吗？我们把这里变成了阿斯加德，还得击退约顿巨人的入侵。

raw_item.translation: 搜刮教会里的贵重物品。教士是杀是放，随你高兴。

source: Ransack the church for valuables. Kill or spare the clerics as it pleases you.
translation: 搜刮教会里的贵重物品。教士是杀是放，随你高兴。

raw_item.translation: 我不是有意冒昧……

source: I didn't mean to presume...
translation: 我不是有意冒昧……

raw_item.translation: 我们从东边渡海而来。此行的目的是和平，不想惹任何麻烦。

source: We've come across the sea from the east. Our errand is peaceful, and we don't wish to cause any trouble.
translation: 我们从东边渡海而来。此行的目的是和平，不想惹任何麻烦。

raw_item.translation: 你姐妹一直在找你。她就在城墙外等着。你觉得你能走到那儿吗？

source: Your sister has been looking for you. She's waiting outside the walls. Think you can make it there?
translation: 你姐妹一直在找你。她就在城墙外等着。你觉得你能走到那儿吗？

raw_item.translation: {拿走补给。}

source: {Take the supplies.}
translation: {拿走补给。}

raw_item.translation: 至少谢谢你带我们来这里。

source: Thank you for taking us here at least.
translation: 至少谢谢你带我们来这里。

raw_item.translation: 我抓到收税官了。

source: I got the tax collector.
translation: 我抓到收税官了。

raw_item.translation: 我没法排除这种可能。

source: I can't rule it out.
translation: 我没法排除这种可能。

raw_item.translation: 贡纳尔满意地打量着斯卡基的遗体。

source: Gunnarr looks approvingly at Skakki's earthly remains.
translation: 贡纳尔满意地打量着斯卡基的遗体。

raw_item.translation: {自保吧。}

source: {Defend yourselves.}
translation: {自保吧。}

raw_item.translation: 留里克像往常一样笑着迎接你，但笑意并未映入他的眼中。

source: Rurik greets you with a smile as always, but it's not reflected in his eyes.
translation: 留里克像往常一样笑着迎接你，但笑意并未映入他的眼中。

raw_item.translation: 节哀。他是个好人。

source: My condolences. He was a good man.
translation: 节哀。他是个好人。

raw_item.translation: 你——你[P1]！我们连那些村民都杀了，照样能收拾你！

source: You-- you [Player:son of a bitch/bitch]! We killed those villagers, we can take you too!
translation: 你——你[Player:son of a bitch/bitch]！我们连那些村民都杀了，照样能收拾你！

raw_item.translation: 如果他真选择了基督教，我们仍然欢迎你们所有人来参加集会——包括你的儿子。

source: If he does choose Christianity, you're all still welcome at our gatherings - that includes your son.
translation: 如果他真选择了基督教，我们仍然欢迎你们所有人来参加集会——包括你的儿子。

raw_item.translation: 你对自己此行的目的说得不太清楚。

source: You weren't altogether clear about the purpose of your visit.
translation: 你对自己此行的目的说得不太清楚。

raw_item.translation: [P1]，很高兴看到你完好无损地回来。

source: [Player:Name], good to see you back in one piece.
translation: [Player:Name]，很高兴看到你完好无损地回来。

raw_item.translation: 听起来像是去送死。

source: Sounds like suicide.
translation: 听起来像是去送死。

raw_item.translation: 我在里面一张床底下藏了块活板门。另一个入口就寒碜多了——你到时候就明白我什么意思了。

source: I hid a trapdoor under a bed inside. The other entrance is a bit shittier - you'll see what I mean.
translation: 我在里面一张床底下藏了块活板门。另一个入口就寒碜多了——你到时候就明白我什么意思了。

raw_item.translation: 踩进一个坑里，现在袜子全湿了！

source: Stepped into a hole, now my socks are wet!
translation: 踩进一个坑里，现在袜子全湿了！

raw_item.translation: 凯蒂尔咧开嘴，笑得合不拢。

source: Ketill's face splits into a wide grin.
translation: 凯蒂尔咧开嘴，笑得合不拢。

raw_item.translation: 当然。要不要我讲讲希米尔的歌谣？那里头强壮的托尔把米德加尔特巨蛇给拽了上来。

source: Of course. Shall I recount the ballad of Hymir, where mighty Thorr pulls up the Midgard-serpent?
translation: 当然。要不要我讲讲希米尔的歌谣？那里头强壮的托尔把米德加尔特巨蛇给拽了上来。

raw_item.translation: 朋友们！圣罗慕路斯的忠实信徒们，旧帝国的守护神。自从找到这地方，我们总算过了段太平日子，但绝不能就此松懈。

source: Friends! Faithful worshippers of Saint Romulus, patron of the Old Empire. We have enjoyed a measure of peace since we found this place, but we must not become complacent.
translation: 朋友们！圣罗慕路斯的忠实信徒们，旧帝国的守护神。自从找到这地方，我们总算过了段太平日子，但绝不能就此松懈。

raw_item.translation: 一面古老的罗马军团鹰旗，以黄金铸成。

source: An ancient eagle standard of a Roman legion, cast in gold.
translation: 一面古老的罗马军团鹰旗，以黄金铸成。

raw_item.translation: 我向你保证，我绝没有做那种事。

source: I assure you I'm doing no such thing.
translation: 我向你保证，我绝没有做那种事。

raw_item.translation: 既然危险已经过去，你有什么货物要交易吗？

source: Now that the danger has passed, do you have goods to trade?
translation: 既然危险已经过去，你有什么货物要交易吗？

raw_item.translation: 尚未准备离开

source: Not Ready to Leave
translation: 尚未准备离开

raw_item.translation: 她挥动手臂，画了个大弧，把两个摊位都圈了进去。

source: She sweeps her arm in a wide arc encompassing both stalls.
translation: 她挥动手臂，画了个大弧，把两个摊位都圈了进去。

raw_item.translation: 冷静！出什么事了？其他人呢？

source: Calm down! What's happening? Where are the others?
translation: 冷静！出什么事了？其他人呢？

raw_item.translation: 这柄维京斧最初被皮克特人当作战利品，从一名死去的劫掠者身上夺走，后来你在高地的一处洞穴里发现了它。斧刃上刻着精美的纹饰，结实的斧柄上留有刻痕。

source: First taken by Picts as a war trophy from a dead raider, you found this Viking axe hidden in a highland cave. Its blade is beautifully engraved, its sturdy hilt marked with notches.
translation: 这柄维京斧最初被皮克特人当作战利品，从一名死去的劫掠者身上夺走，后来你在高地的一处洞穴里发现了它。斧刃上刻着精美的纹饰，结实的斧柄上留有刻痕。

raw_item.translation: 她动作缓慢，几乎带着几分敬意，取出一柄用亚麻布包裹的精美宝剑。

source: With a slow, almost reverential movement, she produces a finely adorned sword wrapped in linens.
translation: 她动作缓慢，几乎带着几分敬意，取出一柄用亚麻布包裹的精美宝剑。

raw_item.translation: 这不正是你想要的吗？一个被人类前所未见的巨大威胁撕裂的世界？一场注定失败、却能死得有意义——死得像战士——的战斗。

source: Is this not what you wanted? A world rent asunder by as great a threat as mankind has ever faced? A doomed battle in which to die a meaningful death - a warrior's death.
translation: 这不正是你想要的吗？一个被人类前所未见的巨大威胁撕裂的世界？一场注定失败、却能死得有意义——死得像战士——的战斗。

raw_item.translation: 那老人脸色变得煞白。

source: The old man grows quite pale.
translation: 那老人脸色变得煞白。

raw_item.translation: 凯尔显然被迷得神魂颠倒，把另一只手覆在[P1]的手上，将他的手合在自己两手之间。她再次对你说话，目光却始终没有离开你的[P2]。

source: Blatantly smitten, Kyre places her other hand on top of [ObjectOfAffection:Name]'s, sandwiching his hand between hers. She addresses you again, without taking her eyes off your [ObjectOfAffection:archetype].
translation: 凯尔显然被迷得神魂颠倒，把另一只手覆在[ObjectOfAffection:Name]的手上，将他的手合在自己两手之间。她再次对你说话，目光却始终没有离开你的[ObjectOfAffection:archetype]。

raw_item.translation: 这么明显的破绽，可别怪我不客气。

source: Can't blame me for exploiting such an obvious opening.
translation: 这么明显的破绽，可别怪我不客气。

raw_item.translation: 一群维京人来到了那个村子。他们袭击了村民，还洗劫了附近的修道院。

source: A group of Vikings came to that village. They attacked the villagers and ransacked the nearby convent.
translation: 一群维京人来到了那个村子。他们袭击了村民，还洗劫了附近的修道院。

raw_item.translation: 是啊。

source: Yeah.
translation: 是啊。

raw_item.translation: 对不起。她想要你死。

source: I'm sorry. She wants you dead.
translation: 对不起。她想要你死。

raw_item.translation: 一个高个子黑发男子正不紧不慢地敲打着木栅栏，在旧木板上添上一排新板。他看到你时显得有些意外，但并不是不悦。

source: A tall dark-haired man is hammering steadily at a wooden fence, adding a new row of boards atop the old. He appears surprised to see you, but not unpleasantly so.
translation: 一个高个子黑发男子正不紧不慢地敲打着木栅栏，在旧木板上添上一排新板。他看到你时显得有些意外，但并不是不悦。

raw_item.translation: 一切……一切都没了。

source: Everything... everything is gone now.
translation: 一切……一切都没了。

raw_item.translation: 据你神父说，哈夫丹家族偷了一头猪。

source: According to your father, the Halfdansons stole a hog.
translation: 据你神父说，哈夫丹家族偷了一头猪。

raw_item.translation: 那我从你手里夺过来，也不过是顺理成章的事。

source: Then my taking it from you will only be a natural progression.
translation: 那我从你手里夺过来，也不过是顺理成章的事。

raw_item.translation: 听起来时间可是至关重要。

source: Sounds like time will be of the essence.
translation: 听起来时间可是至关重要。

raw_item.translation: 我知道你帮我们除掉了林中的那些强盗。可我能不能再请你把那些惹出这一切祸端的沉船贼也一并收拾了？

source: I know you helped us get rid of those bandits in the forest. But could I perhaps ask you to get rid of the wreckers that caused this whole thing in the first place?
translation: 我知道你帮我们除掉了林中的那些强盗。可我能不能再请你把那些惹出这一切祸端的沉船贼也一并收拾了？

raw_item.translation: 斯库勒领主是一位强大而睿智的领袖，在他的治理下耶灵繁荣兴旺。若由他来统领峡湾的防御，我们大家都会安心得多。

source: Thegn Skule is a strong and wise leader, under whose rule Jelling has prospered. We would all feel much safer with him in charge of the fjord's defence.
translation: 斯库勒领主是一位强大而睿智的领袖，在他的治理下耶灵繁荣兴旺。若由他来统领峡湾的防御，我们大家都会安心得多。

raw_item.translation: 我当然会帮你。我向来都尽我所能为你效劳。

source: Of course I'll help you. I always do what I can for you.
translation: 我当然会帮你。我向来都尽我所能为你效劳。

raw_item.translation: 你要是能替我除掉那诅咒，我保证给你更好的价钱。

source: I promise better prices if you rid me of that curse.
translation: 你要是能替我除掉那诅咒，我保证给你更好的价钱。

raw_item.translation: 愤怒与悲痛把他的脸扭曲成一个难看的苦相。

source: Anger and sorrow work his face into an ugly grimace.
translation: 愤怒与悲痛把他的脸扭曲成一个难看的苦相。

raw_item.translation: 你走近时，近旁的守卫抬手拦住了你。篝火边的男子站起身，仔细打量你。

source: The near guard holds up a hand to stop you as you approach. The man at the camp fire stands up to get a good look at you.
translation: 你走近时，近旁的守卫抬手拦住了你。篝火边的男子站起身，仔细打量你。

raw_item.translation: 我不会杀你。祝你好运。

source: I'll not kill you. Good luck.
translation: 我不会杀你。祝你好运。

raw_item.translation: 他沉了下去。

source: He sinks.
translation: 他沉了下去。

raw_item.translation: {交出240件贵重物品。}成交！

source: {Give 240 Valuables.} Deal!
translation: {交出240件贵重物品。}成交！

raw_item.translation: 你确认没人朝这边看，随即迅速拔出撒克斯短刀，顺着她薄皮甲上的缝线刺了进去。还没等那受害者尖叫，你就用另一只手捂住了她的嘴。

source: You make sure nobody's looking this way, then you quickly draw your seax and drive it through the seams in her thin hide armour. Before your victim has time to scream, you cover her mouth with your other hand.
translation: 你确认没人朝这边看，随即迅速拔出撒克斯短刀，顺着她薄皮甲上的缝线刺了进去。还没等那受害者尖叫，你就用另一只手捂住了她的嘴。

raw_item.translation: 前几天我在集市上见到了拉希尔，当面质问了她。她挺得意，毫不掩饰地承认自己立了五根。减去我砍倒的那根，就还剩四根。

source: Well I saw Lathir in the market the other day and confronted her about it. She was very proud of herself and made no effort to hide that she'd erected five. That makes four without the one I took down.
translation: 前几天我在集市上见到了拉希尔，当面质问了她。她挺得意，毫不掩饰地承认自己立了五根。减去我砍倒的那根，就还剩四根。

raw_item.translation: 他看你的眼神，就像你是刚从阿斯加德降临的女武神。

source: He looks at you like you're a valkyrie freshly descended from Asgard.
translation: 他看你的眼神，就像你是刚从阿斯加德降临的女武神。

raw_item.translation: 那些可恨的鼠帮还占着我的家。你就不肯接下把他们清干净这桩差事吗？

source: Those despicable rats still occupy my home. Will you not take on the task of clearing them out?
translation: 那些可恨的鼠帮还占着我的家。你就不肯接下把他们清干净这桩差事吗？

raw_item.translation: 我恳求你，等我家里的鼠帮清干净、我能安全搬进去的时候，再来这里一趟。我会翘首以盼！

source: I implore you to return here when my house is cleared of the rats and it's safe for me to move in. I will be waiting with baited breath!
translation: 我恳求你，等我家里的鼠帮清干净、我能安全搬进去的时候，再来这里一趟。我会翘首以盼！

raw_item.translation: 德鲁伊若有所思地挠了挠胡子，但当你转身离开时，他并没有试图拦你。

source: The druid scratches his beard pensively, but he makes no attempt to stop you as you turn to leave.
translation: 德鲁伊若有所思地挠了挠胡子，但当你转身离开时，他并没有试图拦你。

raw_item.translation: 我没有。我……那不是我选的。

source: I did not. I... it was not my choice.
translation: 我没有。我……那不是我选的。

raw_item.translation: 亲友们还聚在岸上更远处，听不见随意的交谈，却也近得能听到你想讲的任何鼓劲话。

source: Friends and family are still gathered further up on the shore, out of earshot of casual conversation but close enough to hear any rousing pep-talk you might attempt.
translation: 亲友们还聚在岸上更远处，听不见随意的交谈，却也近得能听到你想讲的任何鼓劲话。

raw_item.translation: 我不喜欢这样。

source: I don't like it.
translation: 我不喜欢这样。

raw_item.translation: 你竟敢以你的存在亵渎上帝的殿堂！

source: You desecrate the house of the Lord with your presence!
translation: 你竟敢以你的存在亵渎上帝的殿堂！

translation: 他的眉头竟又皱紧了几分，有那么一瞬间，你担心那张脸会因为这份沉重而裂成两半。

source: Well, do you think there's a small chance some of you might get hurt on this really dangerous trip? You know these herbs aren't just for making people sick, right?
translation: 呃，你觉得这趟这么危险的旅程，你们里头会不会有那么一点几率有人受伤？你知道这些草药可不只是用来让人生病的吧？

translation: 我若饶你一命，你可愿为我效劳？

translation: 换了你，说不定也会抱怨。

translation: 她甚至都没试着跑——也许等她明白过来要发生什么时，已经太迟了。

translation: 你这是怎么了？这根本不像你。

translation: 那些故事被夸大了，我们的人跟你们的人没什么两样。

translation: 你碰巧认识一个姑娘吗？她跟一个叫凯尔特拉姆的男子是朋友。

translation: 跟你父亲在弗里西亚并肩作战时死的，两个都死了。也没什么好多说的。

translation: 别那么说……

translation: 那你们可以走了，旅人。感谢你们尊重我们的习俗，也向地底之民致以应有的敬意。但愿你们的请求能得偿所愿。

translation: 你当时有机会就该把那帮斥候杀了。不过别难过。我战死沙场——我的归宿不在这里，我会找到通往瓦尔霍尔的路。

translation: 正是如此。你消息很灵通。

translation: 等等！我们不必动手，事情总能商量出个办法！

translation: 有点凶险，但我们挺过来了。最大的难处是渡海。为了弄到他的船，我们不得不杀了个渔夫。真可惜。

translation: 阿斯莱夫阴沉地笑了一声，挑起眉毛看了你一眼。

raw_item.translation: 拿着。告诉他……我是自愿还给他的。

source: Here. Tell him... I gave it back willingly.
translation: 拿着。告诉他……我是自愿还给他的。

raw_item.translation: 白天里，风越刮越猛，浪头也越来越大。你的船上堆满了货物和财宝，[P1]被货物塞得高高的，随着风暴的势头加剧，有些东西开始晃动起来。

source: During the day, the wind picks up and the waves turn larger. Your ship is overflowing with goods and riches, and having packed [Shipname] high with all your wares, some of it starts shuffling about as the storm grows in strength.
translation: 白天里，风越刮越猛，浪头也越来越大。你的船上堆满了货物和财宝，[Shipname]被货物塞得高高的，随着风暴的势头加剧，有些东西开始晃动起来。

raw_item.translation: 他的儿子们一旦动手，他的命运便已注定。若让这等冒犯轻轻揭过，整个氏族就走到头了。

source: Once his sons attacked, his fate was sealed. To let such an offence slide would have been the end of the clan.
translation: 他的儿子们一旦动手，他的命运便已注定。若让这等冒犯轻轻揭过，整个氏族就走到头了。

raw_item.translation: 去一趟那个小村落。

source: Visit the small hamlet.
translation: 去一趟那个小村落。

raw_item.translation: 水流太急了，我们带着孩子过不去！那座桥是唯一的出路。

source: The current is too strong, we can't cross with the children! That bridge is the only way.
translation: 水流太急了，我们带着孩子过不去！那座桥是唯一的出路。

raw_item.translation: 我不知道，但光站在这儿说话可弄不明白。

source: I don't know, but we won't find out by standing around and talking.
translation: 我不知道，但光站在这儿说话可弄不明白。

raw_item.translation: 现在！开宴吧！

source: Now! Let us feast!
translation: 现在！开宴吧！

raw_item.translation: 暂时如此。不过眼下，我想买点东西。

source: For the time being. In the mean time, I'd like to purchase something.
translation: 暂时如此。不过眼下，我想买点东西。

raw_item.translation: 我们可不是什么富有的氏族。

source: We're not a rich clan.
translation: 我们可不是什么富有的氏族。

raw_item.translation: 一个穿着木匠皮围裙的男子从白菜地里抬起头，抬手打招呼。

source: A man wearing the leather apron of a woodworker looks up from a cabbage patch and raises his hand in greeting.
translation: 一个穿着木匠皮围裙的男子从白菜地里抬起头，抬手打招呼。

raw_item.translation: 莫坎特的声音颤抖着，几乎要惊慌失措。

source: Morcant's voice is quivering with near-panic.
translation: 莫坎特的声音颤抖着，几乎要惊慌失措。

raw_item.translation: 当然，我主要说的是埃迪丝。这可怜的姑娘对我死心塌地，她藏得很好，可骗不过我。

source: I'm mainly referring to Eydis of course. Poor old girl has a hopeless crush on me. She hides it well, but I can't be fooled.
translation: 当然，我主要说的是埃迪丝。这可怜的姑娘对我死心塌地，她藏得很好，可骗不过我。

raw_item.translation: 战斗持续了许多个小时。最终，皮克特人突破防线，攻占了约克。

source: Many hours pass as the battle rages on. Eventually, the Picts break through and capture Eoforwic.
translation: 战斗持续了许多个小时。最终，皮克特人突破防线，攻占了约克。

raw_item.translation: 你倒了两只木杯的甜蜂蜜酒。一杯恭恭敬敬地放在树下，留给奥丁之子或许再经此地之时。另一杯，你为阿萨神族的荣耀一饮而尽。

source: You pour two wooden mugs of sweet mead. One you place reverently at the base of the tree for when Odinn's son might again pass this place. The other, you drink to the honour of the Æsir.
translation: 你倒了两只木杯的甜蜂蜜酒。一杯恭恭敬敬地放在树下，留给奥丁之子或许再经此地之时。另一杯，你为阿萨神族的荣耀一饮而尽。

raw_item.translation: 嗯。我不知道……也许……

source: Hmm. I don't know... perhaps...
translation: 嗯。我不知道……也许……

raw_item.translation: 你到底想以什么罪名逮捕我？

source: What could you possible want to arrest me for?
translation: 你到底想以什么罪名逮捕我？

raw_item.translation: 带着战利品，把这些船开回奥克尼群岛吧。我相信那儿有一整桶新酿的蜂蜜酒正等着我。

source: Let's get these ships back to Orkneyjar with the spoils. I believe I have a freshly brewed vat of mead with my name on it waiting there.
translation: 带着战利品，把这些船开回奥克尼群岛吧。我相信那儿有一整桶新酿的蜂蜜酒正等着我。

raw_item.translation: 你吃得不错，朋友！只是还不够好。

source: You ate well, friend! Just not well enough.
translation: 你吃得不错，朋友！只是还不够好。

raw_item.translation: 我们……见过你妻子了。我们会把你救出去。只是要当心那些守卫。

source: We've... met your wife. We're going to break you out. Just watch out for the guards.
translation: 我们……见过你妻子了。我们会把你救出去。只是要当心那些守卫。

raw_item.translation: 你还和我在一起吗？

source: Are you still with me?
translation: 你还和我在一起吗？

raw_item.translation: 你能修理我损坏的装备吗？

source: Can you repair my damaged equipment?
translation: 你能修理我损坏的装备吗？

raw_item.translation: 我真为你骄傲！你真是你父亲的[P1]。

source: I'm so proud of you! You truly are your father's [Player:son/daughter].
translation: 我真为你骄傲！你真是你父亲的[Player:son/daughter]。

raw_item.translation: 她是个好女人。要是她再年轻些，或者我再老些……唉，我可不是安顿下来的人，但若真要我安顿，我怕也找不到比她更好的了。

source: She's a fine woman. If she were a bit younger, or I a bit older... ah, I'm not one for settling down, but if I were, I doubt I could do much better than her.
translation: 她是个好女人。要是她再年轻些，或者我再老些……唉，我可不是安顿下来的人，但若真要我安顿，我怕也找不到比她更好的了。

raw_item.translation: 你现在为什么问这个？

source: Why are you asking about this now?
translation: 你现在为什么问这个？

raw_item.translation: 这还不足以让我现在感兴趣。也许我晚点再来。

source: That's not enough to get me interested right now. Maybe I'll come back later.
translation: 这还不足以让我现在感兴趣。也许我晚点再来。

raw_item.translation: 你打得不错。祝你今后好运。

source: You fought well. I wish you good luck in the future.
translation: 你打得不错。祝你今后好运。

raw_item.translation: 当然知道。一艘远航至此的漂亮长船。

source: Of course I do. A beautiful longship that has travelled far.
translation: 当然知道。一艘远航至此的漂亮长船。

raw_item.translation: 前往高地洞窟，清除所有敌人。

source: Travel to the highland caves and clear out all enemies.
translation: 前往高地洞窟，清除所有敌人。

raw_item.translation: 正是如此。下一届阿尔庭议会上，他肯定会对我们动手，没人会帮我们阻止他。

source: Precisely. He'll certainly move against us on the next Althing, and nobody will help us stop him.
translation: 正是如此。下一届阿尔庭议会上，他肯定会对我们动手，没人会帮我们阻止他。

raw_item.translation: 要是我们在沼泽里看到什么灯火，我提议派贡纳尔去找宝贝。

source: If we spot any lights in the marsh, I say we send Gunnarr to look for treasure.
translation: 要是我们在沼泽里看到什么灯火，我提议派贡纳尔去找宝贝。

raw_item.translation: 你最好别告诉任何人。

source: You'd better not tell anyone.
translation: 你最好别告诉任何人。

raw_item.translation: 夜里某时，你的随从正忙各自的差事，你注意到少了一个奴隶。

source: Some time during the night, as your followers are going about their duties, you notice one of the thralls missing.
translation: 夜里某时，你的随从正忙各自的差事，你注意到少了一个奴隶。

raw_item.translation: 留下

source: Stay
translation: 留下

raw_item.translation: 看起来像一座沾满血的神龛。

source: Looks like a shrine covered in blood.
translation: 看起来像一座沾满血的神龛。

raw_item.translation: 你也许可以说，那是他们的观念。他们死守着野蛮的信仰，那是上帝降临这片土地之前的黑暗时代遗留下来的东西。

source: You might say it's their ideas. They hold on to barbaric beliefs, left-overs of the dark ages before the Lord came to this land.
translation: 你也许可以说，那是他们的观念。他们死守着野蛮的信仰，那是上帝降临这片土地之前的黑暗时代遗留下来的东西。

raw_item.translation: 你当然说得对，可这份羞耻还是不由自主地涌上来。

source: You're right of course, but the shame comes unbidden.
translation: 你当然说得对，可这份羞耻还是不由自主地涌上来。

raw_item.translation: 这事儿在我们那位祭司朋友那儿可讨不到好。要是我们这么做，他会继续找麻烦。我们离开之前得把他处理掉。

source: That won't go over well with our friend the priest. If we do this, he'll continue to cause trouble. We'll have to deal with him before we leave.
translation: 这事儿在我们那位祭司朋友那儿可讨不到好。要是我们这么做，他会继续找麻烦。我们离开之前得把他处理掉。

raw_item.translation: 他那深陷的眼睛打量了你的脸片刻。

source: His deep-set eyes search your face for a moment.
translation: 他那深陷的眼睛打量了你的脸片刻。

raw_item.translation: 她丝毫没有掩饰眼中的恐惧。她四下张望，可尽管你被严密监视着，除了她和那女孩，没人听见你的要求。她得尖叫才能叫来帮手。

source: She makes no attempt to hide the fear in her eyes. She looks around, but though you are closely watched, none beside her and the girl have heard your demand. She'd have to scream to summon help.
translation: 她丝毫没有掩饰眼中的恐惧。她四下张望，可尽管你被严密监视着，除了她和那女孩，没人听见你的要求。她得尖叫才能叫来帮手。

raw_item.translation: 谢谢，现在不用。

source: Thank you, not now.
translation: 谢谢，现在不用。

raw_item.translation: 你想要什么？

source: What do you want?
translation: 你想要什么？

raw_item.translation: 呃！天哪，我感觉她就在我身后。

source: Gah! Oh, I felt like she was right behind me.
translation: 呃！天哪，我感觉她就在我身后。

raw_item.translation: 我好像也迷路了……

source: I seem to have gotten lost as well...
translation: 我好像也迷路了……

raw_item.translation: 他冲你咧嘴一笑，那笑容满不在乎，然后站起身，绕过桌子，一直走到紧贴你的私人空间，逼得你也站了起来。

source: He flashes you a devil-may-care grin, stands up, and walks around the table until he's well inside your personal space, forcing you to stand up as well.
translation: 他冲你咧嘴一笑，那笑容满不在乎，然后站起身，绕过桌子，一直走到紧贴你的私人空间，逼得你也站了起来。

raw_item.translation: 我改主意了，我什么都不给。

source: I've changed my mind - I'm keeping everything.
translation: 我改主意了，我什么都不给。

raw_item.translation: 我现在不能插手。我晚些时候也许会再来。

source: I can't get involved right now. I may be back later.
translation: 我现在不能插手。我晚些时候也许会再来。

raw_item.translation: 唉，考斯坦丁让你来插手，是吧？我猜也是时候收拾那烂摊子了。

source: Ach, Caustantin asked you to get involved, hm? I suppose it's about time we do something about that mess.
translation: 唉，考斯坦丁让你来插手，是吧？我猜也是时候收拾那烂摊子了。

raw_item.translation: 一顿[P1]不用[P2]我亲手做的美餐？行啊。

source: A fine meal that I [i]don't[/i] have to cook? Sure.
translation: 一顿[i]不用[/i]我亲手做的美餐？行啊。

raw_item.translation: 我终于要掌控自己的人生了，试着找回这些年丢掉的尊严。别把这事归咎于什么外头的邪恶影响。

source: I'm finally taking charge of my own life - trying to get back some of the dignity I've lost over the years. Don't try to attribute this to some nefarious outside influence.
translation: 我终于要掌控自己的人生了，试着找回这些年丢掉的尊严。别把这事归咎于什么外头的邪恶影响。

raw_item.translation: 我们希望在我们氏族和你们王国之间开辟新的贸易路线。

source: Our wish is to establish new trade routes between our clan and your kingdom.
translation: 我们希望在我们氏族和你们王国之间开辟新的贸易路线。

raw_item.translation: [P1]脸微微一红，递给你一枚做工精巧的护符。

source: With a light blush, [ObjectOfAffection:Name] hands you a finely crafted talisman.
translation: [ObjectOfAffection:Name]脸微微一红，递给你一枚做工精巧的护符。

raw_item.translation: 罗斯克娃与你对视片刻，然后只是点点头，转过身，朝沼泽走回去。

source: Røskva holds your gaze for a moment, then she simply nods, turns around, and walks back towards the bog.
translation: 罗斯克娃与你对视片刻，然后只是点点头，转过身，朝沼泽走回去。

raw_item.translation: 那肯定就是他的最终计划了。这样一来，他就有将近一年时间在国王眼里进一步削弱我们——而且没人会帮我们对付他。

source: That must be his ultimate plan, yes. This gives him almost a year to weaken us further in the eyes of the king - and nobody will help us against him.
translation: 那肯定就是他的最终计划了。这样一来，他就有将近一年时间在国王眼里进一步削弱我们——而且没人会帮我们对付他。

raw_item.translation: 如果你经历过这些，那我也不会试着说服你改变想法。

source: If that has been your experience, I will not try to convince you otherwise.
translation: 如果你经历过这些，那我也不会试着说服你改变想法。

raw_item.translation: 我觉得它们全都是。它们肯定是趁劫掠者袭击时逃出来的。

source: They all are, I think. They must have escaped during the raider attack.
translation: 我觉得它们全都是。它们肯定是趁劫掠者袭击时逃出来的。

raw_item.translation: 你找到那个背信弃义的混蛋了吗？

source: Did you find that treacherous prick?
translation: 你找到那个背信弃义的混蛋了吗？

raw_item.translation: 再多讲讲你的故事吧。你是哪里人？你是怎么当上这支队伍首领的？

source: Tell me more of your story. Where are you from? How did you come to lead this crew?
translation: 再多讲讲你的故事吧。你是哪里人？你是怎么当上这支队伍首领的？

raw_item.translation: 他俯身逼近，深陷的眼睛眯了起来。一声表示认可的低沉喉音朝你这边传来。

source: He looms in, deep-set eyes squinting. An acknowledging rumble thrums in your direction.
translation: 他俯身逼近，深陷的眼睛眯了起来。一声表示认可的低沉喉音朝你这边传来。

raw_item.translation: 我们[i]确实[/i]如此。这次劫掠是我们自己的错，我们的防御不够充分。

source: And we [i]were[/i]. This raid was our own fault, our defences are inadequate.
translation: 我们[i]确实[/i]如此。这次劫掠是我们自己的错，我们的防御不够充分。

raw_item.translation: 老渔夫从正在摆弄的鱼钩上抬起头。

source: The old fisherman looks up from the hook he is working on.
translation: 老渔夫从正在摆弄的鱼钩上抬起头。

raw_item.translation: 我是布鲁诺，欧贝尔特之子。这位是我的妻子贡希尔德。我们是从萨克森来的普通商人，带着北方的货物回家去。

source: I am Bruno, son of Eubert. This is my wife, Gunnhild. We are humble merchants from Saxony returning home with goods from the north.
translation: 我是布鲁诺，欧贝尔特之子。这位是我的妻子贡希尔德。我们是从萨克森来的普通商人，带着北方的货物回家去。

raw_item.translation: 你的船员们现在都站了起来，重重地拍着彼此的肩膀。岸上的人群鼓着掌，高声欢呼喝彩。

source: Your crew is standing up now and patting each other heavily on the shoulders. The crowd on the shore is clapping and shouting accolades.
translation: 你的船员们现在都站了起来，重重地拍着彼此的肩膀。岸上的人群鼓着掌，高声欢呼喝彩。

raw_item.translation: 我不后悔我们那场小打小闹，不过咱们还是别养成习惯。

source: I don't regret our little tussle, but let's not make a habit of it.
translation: 我不后悔我们那场小打小闹，不过咱们还是别养成习惯。

raw_item.translation: 他咬紧牙关，但还是低下了头。

source: His jaw clenches, but he bows his head.
translation: 他咬紧牙关，但还是低下了头。

raw_item.translation: 你是在想发动突袭吗？

source: Are you thinking about a surprise attack?
translation: 你是在想发动突袭吗？

raw_item.translation: 如果我们绕远路，可能会撞上另一群皮克特人。不过话说回来，堂堂正正打一场，总比从那瀑布上摔下去送命强。

source: If we take the long way around we might blunder into another group of Picts. Then again, an honest fight is better than plunging to our deaths over that waterfall.
translation: 如果我们绕远路，可能会撞上另一群皮克特人。不过话说回来，堂堂正正打一场，总比从那瀑布上摔下去送命强。

raw_item.translation: 我想让你知道，这并非针对个人。我唯一的目标就是赢得战争。

source: I want you to know this was nothing personal. My only goal is to win the war.
translation: 我想让你知道，这并非针对个人。我唯一的目标就是赢得战争。

raw_item.translation: {Attack.}

source: {Attack.}
translation: {Attack.}

raw_item.translation: [P1]，你能告诉我发生了什么吗？

source: [Player:Name], will you tell me what happened?
translation: [Player:Name]，你能告诉我发生了什么吗？

raw_item.translation: 你的挑战者挣扎着想站起来，却把武器留在了泥里。最后，他只好跪在内夫娅面前。

source: Your challenger struggles to get back on his feet, but he leaves his weapon in the mud. In the end, he settles for just sitting on his knees before Nefja.
translation: 你的挑战者挣扎着想站起来，却把武器留在了泥里。最后，他只好跪在内夫娅面前。

raw_item.translation: 你想回到宾客那里，结束今晚的活动吗？那样你就没有更多时间为明天的决斗做准备了。

source: Do you wish to return to your guests and end tonight's events? You will have no further time to prepare for the duel tomorrow.
translation: 你想回到宾客那里，结束今晚的活动吗？那样你就没有更多时间为明天的决斗做准备了。

raw_item.translation: [P1]当年参加过好几次佣兵劫掠。那看起来是门利润丰厚的营生——如果你受得了的话。

source: [Player:Father] went on several mercenary raids in his time. It seemed like highly profitable work, if you can stomach it.
translation: [Player:Father]当年参加过好几次佣兵劫掠。那看起来是门利润丰厚的营生——如果你受得了的话。

raw_item.translation: 我会给你一次证明自己的机会——弥补你的罪过，也许还能让你踏上救赎之路。

source: I will grant you one chance to prove yourself - to make up for your sins, and perhaps to set you on the path to redemption.
translation: 我会给你一次证明自己的机会——弥补你的罪过，也许还能让你踏上救赎之路。

raw_item.translation: 如今，康纳尔·麦克·泰格这桩麻烦事闹得这么大，我们一直没多少时间去查，但等我[i]真的[/i]四处打听他时，我发现异教徒们至少可以说是守口如瓶。

source: Now, with all this Conall mac Taidg trouble, we haven't had much time to look into it, but when I [i]have[/i] asked around about him, I've found the pagans to be tight-lipped, to say the least.
translation: 如今，康纳尔·麦克·泰格这桩麻烦事闹得这么大，我们一直没多少时间去查，但等我[i]真的[/i]四处打听他时，我发现异教徒们至少可以说是守口如瓶。

raw_item.translation: 埃塞尔雷德的侦察队长塔拉得知她的队伍里有一名间谍。她需要一个外人来确认情报并除掉这名间谍。

source: Æthelred's scout captain Tara has learned that there's a spy in her ranks. She needs an outsider to confirm the information and neutralise the spy.
translation: 埃塞尔雷德的侦察队长塔拉得知她的队伍里有一名间谍。她需要一个外人来确认情报并除掉这名间谍。

raw_item.translation: 谢谢，但我才刚开始。等我们准备就绪时，这片地方的每一英寻都会布满帐篷和战士。

source: Thank you, but I'm just getting started. Every fathom of this place will be covered in tents and warriors by the time we're ready.
translation: 谢谢，但我才刚开始。等我们准备就绪时，这片地方的每一英寻都会布满帐篷和战士。

raw_item.translation: 你对阿斯莱夫有什么看法？

source: Any thoughts on Asleifr?
translation: 你对阿斯莱夫有什么看法？

raw_item.translation: 重荣誉的[P1]！请留步，占用您片刻时间。

source: Honourable [Player:warrior/shieldmaiden]! A moment of your time, please.
translation: 重荣誉的[Player:warrior/shieldmaiden]！请留步，占用您片刻时间。

raw_item.translation: {查看尸体。}

source: {Look at the body.}
translation: {查看尸体。}

raw_item.translation: 不，你才[P1]。我自有麻烦要处理——多亏你，麻烦少了一件，但还没完。

source: No you [Player:big lug/silly girl]. I've got my own problems to take care of - one less now thanks to you, but it's not over yet.
translation: 不，你才[Player:big lug/silly girl]。我自有麻烦要处理——多亏你，麻烦少了一件，但还没完。

raw_item.translation: 他伸出手，捏了捏你的手臂。

source: He reaches out and squeezes your arm.
translation: 他伸出手，捏了捏你的手臂。

raw_item.translation: 我们只为财宝而来。若你不反抗，我保证饶你一命。

source: We're just here for the treasure. If you don't resist, I promise to spare you.
translation: 我们只为财宝而来。若你不反抗，我保证饶你一命。

raw_item.translation: 他见你面露疑问，便继续说下去。

source: He sees your questioning look and continues.
translation: 他见你面露疑问，便继续说下去。

raw_item.translation: 闭嘴，你们都闭嘴。决定由我来做，只由我来做。

source: Shut up, all of you. The decision is mine, and mine alone.
translation: 闭嘴，你们都闭嘴。决定由我来做，只由我来做。

raw_item.translation: 不，陛下。我发誓为保卫约克和诺森布里亚国王而战。我效忠王冠。

source: No, your majesty. I swore to fight for the protection of Eoforwic and the king of Northumbria. I serve the crown.
translation: 不，陛下。我发誓为保卫约克和诺森布里亚国王而战。我效忠王冠。

raw_item.translation: 可你不觉得这会害了我们的……我们的家人吗？

source: But don't you think it'll harm our... our family?
translation: 可你不觉得这会害了我们的……我们的家人吗？

raw_item.translation: （侦察）规避

source: (Scouting) Evade
translation: （侦察）规避

raw_item.translation: 又一座镇子……在那边南面。

source: Another town... south of here.
translation: 又一座镇子……在那边南面。

raw_item.translation: 畜栏花卉

source: Animal Pen Flower
translation: 畜栏花卉

raw_item.translation: 我名叫梅林·埃姆里斯。你若来寻最后一位德鲁伊，那你已经找到他了——拜托，别把失望写在脸上。你为何来找我？

source: I am called Myrddin Emrys. If you came to speak to the last of the druids, then you have found him - please, control your disappointment. Why've you sought me out?
translation: 我名叫梅林·埃姆里斯。你若来寻最后一位德鲁伊，那你已经找到他了——拜托，别把失望写在脸上。你为何来找我？

raw_item.translation: 嗯，当然还有财宝。

source: Well, and treasure of course.
translation: 嗯，当然还有财宝。

raw_item.translation: 我想这颗头颅自己会说话。

source: I think the head speaks for itself.
translation: 我想这颗头颅自己会说话。

raw_item.translation: [P1]来到你身旁，站在倒下的勇士旁边。

source: [Random01:Name] joins you next to the fallen champion.
translation: [Random01:Name]来到你身旁，站在倒下的勇士旁边。

raw_item.translation: 她把双手按在胸口，煞有介事地凝望天空。

source: She places her palms over her heart and stares dramatically into the sky.
translation: 她把双手按在胸口，煞有介事地凝望天空。

raw_item.translation: 他飞快地回头瞥了一眼斯库勒的盾女——她正用一柄格外锋利的撒克斯短刀修着指甲，同时羞答答地打量着你。

source: He casts a quick look back at Skule's shieldmaiden, who's picking her nails with a remarkably sharp seax while watching you coyly.
translation: 他飞快地回头瞥了一眼斯库勒的盾女——她正用一柄格外锋利的撒克斯短刀修着指甲，同时羞答答地打量着你。

raw_item.translation: 我只是——嘿嘿——真不敢相信那事发生了。

source: I just - hee hee - I can't believe that happened.
translation: 我只是——嘿嘿——真不敢相信那事发生了。

raw_item.translation: 那恕我失礼了，维京人。

source: My apologies then, Viking.
translation: 那恕我失礼了，维京人。

raw_item.translation: 你当时想和他一起出海。

source: You wanted to sail with him.
translation: 你当时想和他一起出海。

raw_item.translation: 别讲那个笑话。他以前听过了。

source: Don't use that joke. He's heard it before.
translation: 别讲那个笑话。他以前听过了。

raw_item.translation: 上帝保佑。你们是主教派来的人吗？

source: God speed. Are you the ones the bishop sent?
translation: 上帝保佑。你们是主教派来的人吗？

raw_item.translation: 你可以自由离开，但会有人严密监视你。现在告诉我，你叫什么名字？

source: You will be allowed to walk free, but you will be watched carefully. Now tell me, what is your name?
translation: 你可以自由离开，但会有人严密监视你。现在告诉我，你叫什么名字？

raw_item.translation: 再次感谢你的帮助！我保证给你公道的价钱作为回报！

source: Thank you again for your help! I promise you fair prices in return!
translation: 再次感谢你的帮助！我保证给你公道的价钱作为回报！

raw_item.translation: 你的几名亲卫队成员用拳头敲了敲船身，人群中响起“好啊！”和“让他们瞧瞧！”的喊声。

source: A few of your hirdmen knock their fists against the ship, and shouts of "yeah!" and "we'll show them!" rise from the crowd.
translation: 你的几名亲卫队成员用拳头敲了敲船身，人群中响起“好啊！”和“让他们瞧瞧！”的喊声。

raw_item.translation: 他搓着下巴，掂量着这个小念头的好坏。

source: He rubs his chin, weighing the pros and cons of that little thought.
translation: 他搓着下巴，掂量着这个小念头的好坏。

raw_item.translation: 布雷萨尔脸上最后一丝血色也褪尽了。

source: The last remaining colour drains from Bressal's face.
translation: 布雷萨尔脸上最后一丝血色也褪尽了。

raw_item.translation: 你拔剑冲上前去，但那猎人总算及时滚开，躲过了你的攻击。他翻身站起，钢刃在火光中闪亮，猎人们已围到你四周，准备进攻！

source: You rush forward, blade drawn, but the hunter manages to throw himself clear of your attack. He rolls onto his feet, steel glinting in the firelight as the hunters circle around you, ready to attack!
translation: 你拔剑冲上前去，但那猎人总算及时滚开，躲过了你的攻击。他翻身站起，钢刃在火光中闪亮，猎人们已围到你四周，准备进攻！

raw_item.translation: 我不能再——我的[P1]灵魂[P2]再也承受不住更多罪孽了。我确信对我来说，一切都已经太迟了。初次遇见你时，我从未想过你会走到这一步。

source: I cannot-- my [i]soul[/i] cannot withstand more sin. I'm sure it's already too late for me. I never expected you to go this far when I first met you.
translation: 我不能再——我的[i]灵魂[/i]再也承受不住更多罪孽了。我确信对我来说，一切都已经太迟了。初次遇见你时，我从未想过你会走到这一步。

raw_item.translation: 阿斯莱夫是个强壮的战士，我需要他和他的斧来防御敌人、保卫氏族。但你也[P1]知道[P2]，由我来掌管，我们的氏族会更安全、更强大。

source: Asleifr is a strong warrior, I need him and his axe to defend the clan from our enemies. But you [i]know[/i] our clan is safer and stronger with me in charge.
translation: 阿斯莱夫是个强壮的战士，我需要他和他的斧来防御敌人、保卫氏族。但你也[i]知道[/i]，由我来掌管，我们的氏族会更安全、更强大。

raw_item.translation: 以托尔之名，这到底是怎么回事？！这些[P1]人[P2]究竟是谁？！

source: What in Thorr's name was that all about?! Who [i]are[/i] these people?!
translation: 以托尔之名，这到底是怎么回事？！这些[i]人[/i]究竟是谁？！

raw_item.translation: 地底之民。抑或是亡者的幽影？

source: The Underground Ones. Or the shadows of the dead?
translation: 地底之民。抑或是亡者的幽影？

raw_item.translation: “便士”是什么？

source: What are "pence"?
translation: “便士”是什么？

raw_item.translation: 咱们走着瞧……

source: We'll see about that...
translation: 咱们走着瞧……

raw_item.translation: 我们不能那样插手。也许有一天可以，但不是现在。

source: We can't get involved like that. Maybe one day, but not now.
translation: 我们不能那样插手。也许有一天可以，但不是现在。

raw_item.translation: 塔洛尔克，你这鬼话到底是从哪儿听来的？！那位老祭司，愿他的灵魂安息，他可从没教过这种东西！

source: Where are you even getting this shite, Talorc?! The old priest, bless his soul, he never taught anything like it!
translation: 塔洛尔克，你这鬼话到底是从哪儿听来的？！那位老祭司，愿他的灵魂安息，他可从没教过这种东西！

raw_item.translation: 对不住，小子。这都是我的错。

source: I'm sorry lad. This is all my fault.
translation: 对不住，小子。这都是我的错。

raw_item.translation: 我[P1]喜欢[P2]这老头。

source: I [i]like[/i] this greybeard.
translation: 我[i]喜欢[/i]这老头。

raw_item.translation: 你迎来的目光里满是难以置信，却又夹杂着一丝宽慰，甚至或许是希望。

source: You recieve a look of disbelief, mingled with a touch of relief and perhaps even hope.
translation: 你迎来的目光里满是难以置信，却又夹杂着一丝宽慰，甚至或许是希望。

raw_item.translation: 你用牙从烤叉上撕下最后一块肉，狠狠咀嚼。你瞥了眼身旁的挑战者，发现努基也刚吃完他那一份。他朝你这边看了看，得意地一笑，双手又伸向第二份。

source: You tear the last chunk of meat from the spit with your teeth and chew furiously. Glancing over at the challenger beside you, you see Nukki finishing his first portion as well. He glances in your direction and smirks, hands reaching for a second helping.
translation: 你用牙从烤叉上撕下最后一块肉，狠狠咀嚼。你瞥了眼身旁的挑战者，发现努基也刚吃完他那一份。他朝你这边看了看，得意地一笑，双手又伸向第二份。

raw_item.translation: 至少那窟窿没把你的靴子留下。

source: At least the hole didn't keep your boot.
translation: 至少那窟窿没把你的靴子留下。

raw_item.translation: 这姑娘最大的敌人就是她自己。她总觉得自己不够好，她那个娘还火上浇油！

source: Girl is her own worst enemy. Always felt inadequate, and that mother of hers isn't helping!
translation: 这姑娘最大的敌人就是她自己。她总觉得自己不够好，她那个娘还火上浇油！

raw_item.translation: [P1]向来更像是战士，而非领袖，不过他也不比大多数人差。这事儿其实不关乎他，而是关乎野心和贪婪。

source: [Player:Father] was always more a warrior than a leader, but he was no worse than most. This isn't really about him, it's about ambition and greed.
translation: [Player:Father]向来更像是战士，而非领袖，不过他也不比大多数人差。这事儿其实不关乎他，而是关乎野心和贪婪。

raw_item.translation: 他看上去无比严肃。

source: He looks absolutely serious.
translation: 他看上去无比严肃。

raw_item.translation: [P1]攥紧了[P2]拳头。[P3]双目惊慌地寻找着出口。

source: [Curious01:Name] clenches [Curious01:his/her] fists. [Curious01:His/Her] eyes frantically search for the exit.
translation: [Curious01:Name]攥紧了[Curious01:his/her]拳头。[Curious01:His/Her]双目惊慌地寻找着出口。

raw_item.translation: 嘿！你把我当瞎眼老太婆了？！还是你以为我胆小得不敢喊抓贼？

source: Hey! Do you take me for a blind hag?! Or did you expect me to be too timid to call out a thief?
translation: 嘿！你把我当瞎眼老太婆了？！还是你以为我胆小得不敢喊抓贼？

raw_item.translation: 你没事吧，凯蒂尔？

source: Will you be all right, Ketill?
translation: 你没事吧，凯蒂尔？

raw_item.translation: 杀她真是件[P1]乐事[P2]。

source: Killing her was a [i]pleasure[/i].
translation: 杀她真是件[i]乐事[/i]。

raw_item.translation: 你觉得[P1]他们[P2]打算对[P3]你[P4]做什么？

source: What do you suppose [i]they[/i] were planning to do to [i]you[/i]?
translation: 你觉得[i]他们[/i]打算对[i]你[/i]做什么？

raw_item.translation: 她的小火堆熄了，这似乎让她想起了什么。她把沾满灰烬的手指伸进身旁地上的挎包，很快掏出一个脏兮兮的瓶子。

source: Her tiny fire has gone out, which seems to remind her of something. She plunges ash-stained fingers into the satchel lying next to her on the ground, and soon retrieves a dirty flask.
translation: 她的小火堆熄了，这似乎让她想起了什么。她把沾满灰烬的手指伸进身旁地上的挎包，很快掏出一个脏兮兮的瓶子。

raw_item.translation: 谁来扶桅杆？

source: Who should hold the mast?
translation: 谁来扶桅杆？

raw_item.translation: 而在遥远的北方，皮克特人的都城，我的“熊”还握着沃登之角——那是我在看清他的残忍之前赐给他的。

source: And far to the north, in the capital of the Picts, my Bear still has Woden's Horn, that I bestowed upon him before I knew his cruelty.
translation: 而在遥远的北方，皮克特人的都城，我的“熊”还握着沃登之角——那是我在看清他的残忍之前赐给他的。

raw_item.translation: 你似乎正走在一条艰难的路上。你是谁？

source: You seem to be travelling a hard path. Who are you?
translation: 你似乎正走在一条艰难的路上。你是谁？

raw_item.translation: {别管那些萤火虫。}我问的是梅林。

source: {Ignore the fireflies.} I was asking about Myrddin.
translation: {别管那些萤火虫。}我问的是梅林。

raw_item.translation: 那男子不屑地挥了挥手，但这位陷阱专家显然在认真考虑。随后她耸了耸肩。

source: The man waves his hand dismissively, but the trapper is clearly considering it. Then she shrugs.
translation: 那男子不屑地挥了挥手，但这位陷阱专家显然在认真考虑。随后她耸了耸肩。

raw_item.translation: 上帝的居所，何等华美。这难道不令你鼓舞吗？在这里，我比在任何地方都更强烈地感受到祂的存在。

source: The house of the Lord, in all its splendor. Does this not inspire you? Here I feel His presence more strongly than anywhere else.
translation: 上帝的居所，何等华美。这难道不令你鼓舞吗？在这里，我比在任何地方都更强烈地感受到祂的存在。

raw_item.translation: 他竖起一根手指，装出一副义愤填膺的样子指着你。

source: He raises a finger and points at you in a pantomime of righteous anger.
translation: 他竖起一根手指，装出一副义愤填膺的样子指着你。

raw_item.translation: 没错。他们要闹起来，我们恐怕就得动真格了。

source: Aye. They kick up a fuss, we may have to get serious.
translation: 没错。他们要闹起来，我们恐怕就得动真格了。

raw_item.translation: 别小看阿斯莱夫！他可比你强壮。

source: Don't underestimate Asleifr! He's stronger than you are.
translation: 别小看阿斯莱夫！他可比你强壮。

raw_item.translation: 康纳尔·麦克·泰格被囚禁了。

source: Conall mac Taidg is in captivity.
translation: 康纳尔·麦克·泰格被囚禁了。

raw_item.translation: 至少先跟埃迪丝谈谈，问问她怎么看？

source: Let's at least talk to Eydis about it and ask what she thinks?
translation: 至少先跟埃迪丝谈谈，问问她怎么看？

raw_item.translation: 你哥哥留里克一向钟情于音乐。你走近时，他抬起头，朝你温暖地一笑。

source: Your elder brother Rurik always had a penchant for music. He looks up and gives you a warm smile as you approach him.
translation: 你哥哥留里克一向钟情于音乐。你走近时，他抬起头，朝你温暖地一笑。

raw_item.translation: 我没法保证什么。

source: I can't promise anything.
translation: 我没法保证什么。

raw_item.translation: 莫坎特走到石前，虔诚地描摹着上面的一些刻痕。

source: Morcant steps up to the stone and traces some of the markings with reverence.
translation: 莫坎特走到石前，虔诚地描摹着上面的一些刻痕。

raw_item.translation: 我在他旁边发现了这只罐子。

source: I found this jug next to him.
translation: 我在他旁边发现了这只罐子。

raw_item.translation: 请原谅我们之前的偏见，[P1] [P2]。你已经证明自己是这座城镇的朋友。

source: Forgive us for our prejudices, [Player:Hlaford/Hlafdia] [Player:Name]. You have proven yourself to be a friend to this town.
translation: 请原谅我们之前的偏见，[Player:Hlaford/Hlafdia] [Player:Name]。你已经证明自己是这座城镇的朋友。

raw_item.translation: 莫科林强挤出一丝笑容，向你回礼

source: Maucolyn greets you back through his forced smile
translation: 莫科林强挤出一丝笑容，向你回礼

raw_item.translation: 关于幽灵的学问可多了——不只是大家都会讲的那些诸神的事。还有森林的幽灵、大地的幽灵。怎么求它们帮忙，怎么才不至于把它们惹得太火。

source: Lots of things about spirits - not just the gods stuff that everyone knows. The spirits of the forest, and the earth. How to ask them for favours. How not to piss them off too badly.
translation: 关于幽灵的学问可多了——不只是大家都会讲的那些诸神的事。还有森林的幽灵、大地的幽灵。怎么求它们帮忙，怎么才不至于把它们惹得太火。

raw_item.translation: 祝你安好，我叫盖乌斯！今天有什么能帮上你这类人的吗？

source: Wes hal, my name is Gaius! How may I assist your kind today?
translation: 祝你安好，我叫盖乌斯！今天有什么能帮上你这类人的吗？

raw_item.translation: 你悄悄坐到内夫娅身旁的木头上。你俩盯着余烬看了一阵，她才开口。

source: You quietly join Nefja on the log. The two of you stare at the embers for a while before she speaks.
translation: 你悄悄坐到内夫娅身旁的木头上。你俩盯着余烬看了一阵，她才开口。

raw_item.translation: 我们当中有些人受伤了。

source: Some of us are injured.
translation: 我们当中有些人受伤了。

raw_item.translation: 你[P1]抱歉？[P2]你跟我说抱歉，这对我有什么用？

source: You're [i]sorry?[/i] What good is that to me, that you're sorry?
translation: 你[i]抱歉？[/i]你跟我说抱歉，这对我有什么用？

raw_item.translation: 找到凯蒂尔的父母。

source: Find Ketill's parents.
translation: 找到凯蒂尔的父母。

raw_item.translation: 我从斯泰因和他的劫掠者那儿买了些奴隶。本来该现在把他们接走，带回老家去，我的买家还在那儿等着。

source: I bought some thralls from Steinn and his raiders. I was supposed to pick them up now and take them back home where my buyers are waiting for them.
translation: 我从斯泰因和他的劫掠者那儿买了些奴隶。本来该现在把他们接走，带回老家去，我的买家还在那儿等着。

raw_item.translation: 回到商人那里，把装备还给他（或者不还）。

source: Return to the trader and give him his equipment back (or not).
translation: 回到商人那里，把装备还给他（或者不还）。

raw_item.translation: 康纳尔·麦克·泰格死了。

source: Conall mac Taidg is dead.
translation: 康纳尔·麦克·泰格死了。

raw_item.translation: 谢谢你。希望我们之间没有结下什么仇怨。

source: Thank you. I hope there is no bad blood between us.
translation: 谢谢你。希望我们之间没有结下什么仇怨。

raw_item.translation: 哦，你当然不记得我了。咱俩也就认识了一天。那时你还不到十岁。

source: Oh, of course you don't remember me. Only knew each other for a day. You were no older than 10.
translation: 哦，你当然不记得我了。咱俩也就认识了一天。那时你还不到十岁。

raw_item.translation: 你是说鼠帮？

source: You mean The Rats?
translation: 你是说鼠帮？

raw_item.translation: 这就是……他？这肯定不是最后一个德鲁伊。

source: Is this... him? Surely this is not the last of the druids.
translation: 这就是……他？这肯定不是最后一个德鲁伊。

raw_item.translation: 那可是相当多的补给……

source: Those are quite a lot of supplies...
translation: 那可是相当多的补给……

raw_item.translation: 也许以后吧。

source: Perhaps later.
translation: 也许以后吧。

raw_item.translation: 这不算什么，托斯特打起来像个小姑娘。其实不对——我敢肯定，内夫娅小时候造成的伤害都比他大得多。

source: It's nothing, Toste hits like a little girl. In fact, no - I'm certain Nefja could do far more damage when she was little.
translation: 这不算什么，托斯特打起来像个小姑娘。其实不对——我敢肯定，内夫娅小时候造成的伤害都比他大得多。

raw_item.translation: 他那双发黄的眼睛眯了起来，握武器的手攥得更紧了。

source: His yellowed eyes narrow and tightens the grip on his weapon.
translation: 他那双发黄的眼睛眯了起来，握武器的手攥得更紧了。

raw_item.translation: 两名守卫开始翻查你的随身物品，奥德凯尔则和另外两人留在后面。

source: Two of the guards begin to search your belongings while Oddkell hangs back with the other two.
translation: 两名守卫开始翻查你的随身物品，奥德凯尔则和另外两人留在后面。

raw_item.translation: 你的船员为你的简洁喝彩欢呼。你就座，大家抓起船桨，很快[P1]那优雅的弧线便平滑地破水而出，驶入海湾，朝着不列颠群岛而去。

source: Your crew laugh and cheer your brevity. You take your seat, everyone grabs an oar, and soon the elegant curves of [Shipname] cut smoothly through the water out into the bay and towards the British Isles.
translation: 你的船员为你的简洁喝彩欢呼。你就座，大家抓起船桨，很快[Shipname]那优雅的弧线便平滑地破水而出，驶入海湾，朝着不列颠群岛而去。

raw_item.translation: 尽管我更愿意向一位能光明正大击败我的[P1]屈膝，但我如今任你处置。

source: Though I would prefer to bow to a [Player:man/woman] who could defeat me fairly, I am at your mercy.
translation: 尽管我更愿意向一位能光明正大击败我的[Player:man/woman]屈膝，但我如今任你处置。

raw_item.translation: 当然，她把你的名字念得完全不成样子，但这也算是尽力了。

source: Of course she completely butchers your name, but it's a valiant effort.
translation: 当然，她把你的名字念得完全不成样子，但这也算是尽力了。

raw_item.translation: 箭矢的锯齿箭尖疾射而入，穿透斯泰因的心脏，又从另一侧爆出，似乎把整颗器官都从他胸腔里扯了出来。

source: The jagged point of an arrow hurtles into Steinn's heart and bursts out the other side, apparently ripping the entire organ out of his chest.
translation: 箭矢的锯齿箭尖疾射而入，穿透斯泰因的心脏，又从另一侧爆出，似乎把整颗器官都从他胸腔里扯了出来。

raw_item.translation: 我们想进那座墓穴。

source: We're looking to get into the grave.
translation: 我们想进那座墓穴。

raw_item.translation: 阿斯莱夫的朋友们扶他站起来，几乎是把他抬上了他们来时所乘的船。等他们回来取他的武器和盾牌时，两人都在你面前的泥地里短暂跪了一下。

source: Asleifr's friends help him stand and all but carry him to the boat they came on. When they return to retrieve his weapon and shield, they both briefly kneel in the mud before you.
translation: 阿斯莱夫的朋友们扶他站起来，几乎是把他抬上了他们来时所乘的船。等他们回来取他的武器和盾牌时，两人都在你面前的泥地里短暂跪了一下。

raw_item.translation: 她再次迎上你的目光，眼里带着恐惧。但她点了点头。

source: She meets your gaze again, and there's fear in her eyes. But she nods.
translation: 她再次迎上你的目光，眼里带着恐惧。但她点了点头。

raw_item.translation: {开始战斗。}

source: {Start the fight.}
translation: {开始战斗。}

raw_item.translation: 你担心会惹恼法兰克帝国？

source: You're worried about pissing off the Frankish Empire?
translation: 你担心会惹恼法兰克帝国？

raw_item.translation: 还有陷阱的事。布置陷阱的时候我不在场，所以不知道都设了些什么，但他们在上面花了不少时间，肯定布置得相当精巧。

source: There is also the matter of the traps. I wasn't there when they were set, so I don't know what they involve, but quite some time was spent on them, so it must be something elaborate.
translation: 还有陷阱的事。布置陷阱的时候我不在场，所以不知道都设了些什么，但他们在上面花了不少时间，肯定布置得相当精巧。

raw_item.translation: 用这种法子杀他[P1]真[P2]是卑劣，但要是角色互换，我怀疑他也不会给我们更好的待遇。

source: It [i]is[/i] a rotten way to kill him, but I doubt we could expect better treatment from him if our roles were reversed.
translation: 用这种法子杀他[i]真[/i]是卑劣，但要是角色互换，我怀疑他也不会给我们更好的待遇。

raw_item.translation: 我能得到什么好处？

source: What's in it for me?
translation: 我能得到什么好处？

raw_item.translation: 很抱歉让你看到这些。

source: I'm sorry you had to see this.
translation: 很抱歉让你看到这些。

raw_item.translation: 如果和平从来就不是一个选项呢？故事需要戏剧性，而戏剧性需要冲突。如果真正的选择是制造哪一种悲剧呢？

source: What if peace were never an option? A story requires drama, and drama requires conflict. What if your real choice is which tragedy to perpetrate?
translation: 如果和平从来就不是一个选项呢？故事需要戏剧性，而戏剧性需要冲突。如果真正的选择是制造哪一种悲剧呢？

raw_item.translation: 所以你杀了阿斯莱夫。我想我也不能怪你——毕竟挑战是他先发起的。

source: So you killed Asleifr. I suppose I can't hold that against you - he was the one who issued the challenge, after all.
translation: 所以你杀了阿斯莱夫。我想我也不能怪你——毕竟挑战是他先发起的。

raw_item.translation: 你用最少的木材修理桅杆，把它修到[P1]能撑住直到风暴过去的程度。

source: Using the bare minimum of wood, you repair the mast to a state where [Holder:Name] can hold it in place until the storm passes.
translation: 你用最少的木材修理桅杆，把它修到[Holder:Name]能撑住直到风暴过去的程度。

raw_item.translation: 这是什么时候的事？

source: When was this?
translation: 这是什么时候的事？

raw_item.translation: 奥塔尔·埃林松呻吟着，试图在冻硬的土地上坐起身。凯蒂尔走到这个被彻底击败的农夫身旁，一脚把他的武器踢开。

source: Ottarr Erlingsson groans as he tries to sit up on the frozen earth. Ketill walks over to the soundly defeated farmer and kicks his weapon away.
translation: 奥塔尔·埃林松呻吟着，试图在冻硬的土地上坐起身。凯蒂尔走到这个被彻底击败的农夫身旁，一脚把他的武器踢开。

raw_item.translation: 你走近时，那年轻女子明显在努力不往你这边看。你只得到一个小小的、怯生生的点头，你把这当作她的摊位开门营业的意思。

source: The young woman puts visible effort into not looking your way as you approach. A tiny timid nod is all you get, which you take to indicate that her stall is open for business.
translation: 你走近时，那年轻女子明显在努力不往你这边看。你只得到一个小小的、怯生生的点头，你把这当作她的摊位开门营业的意思。

raw_item.translation: 你做的事真是[P1]太丢人了[P2]。我不知道自己还能不能原谅你。

source: What you did was [i]disgraceful[/i]. I don't know that I will ever be able to forgive you for it.
translation: 你做的事真是[i]太丢人了[/i]。我不知道自己还能不能原谅你。

raw_item.translation: 内夫娅久久沉默不语，凝视着灰烬。

source: Nefja is silent for a long time, staring into the ashes.
translation: 内夫娅久久沉默不语，凝视着灰烬。

raw_item.translation: 因为我父亲是国王。

source: Because my father is the king.
translation: 因为我父亲是国王。

raw_item.translation: 谢谢你，维京人。我希望那些拾荒者多少还有点良知。

source: Thank you, Viking. I hope they scavengers have some decency after all.
translation: 谢谢你，维京人。我希望那些拾荒者多少还有点良知。

raw_item.translation: 谁在那儿？！

source: Who's there?!
translation: 谁在那儿？！

raw_item.translation: 他们可以再等一会儿。内夫娅想在咱们离开前道别。

source: They can wait a moment longer. Nefja wanted to say goodbye before we leave.
translation: 他们可以再等一会儿。内夫娅想在咱们离开前道别。

raw_item.translation: 我们被抓走两年后，她就被杀了。

source: She was killed two years after we were taken.
translation: 我们被抓走两年后，她就被杀了。

raw_item.translation: 恐惧和偏见在我们的邻居中间蔓延，如果我们继续留在这里，很快就会陷入极大的危险。该是离开的时候了。

source: Fear and prejudice spreads among our neighbours, and soon we will be in great danger if we remain here. It's time we moved on.
translation: 恐惧和偏见在我们的邻居中间蔓延，如果我们继续留在这里，很快就会陷入极大的危险。该是离开的时候了。

raw_item.translation: 你是最后一个离开那幽闭黑暗墓穴的人。当你再次来到清新的空气中，脑海里的迷雾也随之散去。

source: You're the last to leave the claustrophobic darkness of the tomb. The haze lifts from your mind when you emerge into the fresh air once more.
translation: 你是最后一个离开那幽闭黑暗墓穴的人。当你再次来到清新的空气中，脑海里的迷雾也随之散去。

raw_item.translation: 斯库勒没再说一句话，转身大步走开了。

source: Without another word, Skule turns and stalks off.
translation: 斯库勒没再说一句话，转身大步走开了。

raw_item.translation: 他花了一点时间打量四周，突然脸色变得难看起来。

source: He takes a moment to survey his surroundings, and suddenly looks queasy.
translation: 他花了一点时间打量四周，突然脸色变得难看起来。

raw_item.translation: 老妇人眯着眼打量你，随后转过身，摇摇摆摆地走回她的凳子。

source: The grandmother regards you through narrowed eyes, then turns and waddles back to her stool.
translation: 老妇人眯着眼打量你，随后转过身，摇摇摆摆地走回她的凳子。

raw_item.translation: 我相信耶稣基督，上帝唯一的儿子，我们的上帝，祂由圣灵感孕，由圣母玛利亚所生，在本丢·彼拉多手下受难，被钉十字架，受死，埋葬；祂降入阴间。

source: I believe in Jesus Christ, God's only Son, our Lord, who was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died, and was buried; he descended to the dead.
translation: 我相信耶稣基督，上帝唯一的儿子，我们的上帝，祂由圣灵感孕，由圣母玛利亚所生，在本丢·彼拉多手下受难，被钉十字架，受死，埋葬；祂降入阴间。

raw_item.translation: [P1]立刻出发，清点人数，确保每个人都醒着，也都到齐了。

source: [Helper:Name] immediately sets off, counting heads and making sure everyone is awake and collected.
translation: [Helper:Name]立刻出发，清点人数，确保每个人都醒着，也都到齐了。

raw_item.translation: {割断他的绳子。}

source: {Cut his ropes.}
translation: {割断他的绳子。}

raw_item.translation: 说不清祭司是更担心你，还是更担心民兵队。

source: It's unclear if the priest is more worried about you or the militia.
translation: 说不清祭司是更担心你，还是更担心民兵队。

raw_item.translation: 再见。

source: Far vel.
translation: 再见。

raw_item.translation: 现在我们加固约克，防备南方任何反扑。我们的大部分军队会解散——士兵们会乐意回农场收割。

source: Now we fortify Eoforwic against any counter-attack from the south. Most of our army will disband - the men will be glad to return to their farms for the harvest.
translation: 现在我们加固约克，防备南方任何反扑。我们的大部分军队会解散——士兵们会乐意回农场收割。

raw_item.translation: 你肯定能教教村里的年轻男女一两种战斗本事。

source: You could surely teach the young men and women if the village a thing or two about combat.
translation: 你肯定能教教村里的年轻男女一两种战斗本事。

raw_item.translation: 准备

source: Prepare
translation: 准备

raw_item.translation: {献上4000件贵重物品。}我们会给你足够的财宝，让你能带着随从去任何想去的地方；只要不是这里。

source: {Offer 4000 Valuables.} We'll give you enough treasure that you can take your followers and go anywhere you want; as long as it isn't here.
translation: {献上4000件贵重物品。}我们会给你足够的财宝，让你能带着随从去任何想去的地方；只要不是这里。

raw_item.translation: 芬努阿拉对国王热情的欢迎只显得略有些意外。

source: Finnguala looks only mildly surprised by the warmth of the king's welcome.
translation: 芬努阿拉对国王热情的欢迎只显得略有些意外。

raw_item.translation: 经过2小时的准备……

source: 2 hours of preparations later...
translation: 经过2小时的准备……

raw_item.translation: 他们当时就该直接向我们宣誓效忠，而不是无缘无故地硬打一场。他们的骄傲害了他们。

source: They should've simply sworn fealty to us then, instead of putting up a fight for no reason. Their pride was their downfall.
translation: 他们当时就该直接向我们宣誓效忠，而不是无缘无故地硬打一场。他们的骄傲害了他们。

raw_item.translation: 我叫[P1]。我是来自日德兰的领主。

source: My name is [Player:Name]. I am a thegn from Jutland.
translation: 我叫[Player:Name]。我是来自日德兰的领主。

raw_item.translation: 我在哪儿？

source: Where am I?
translation: 我在哪儿？

raw_item.translation: 你凑到雇用我们的钱了吗？

source: Have you raised the money to hire us?
translation: 你凑到雇用我们的钱了吗？

raw_item.translation: 我是怎么逃出你的陷阱的？

source: How did I escape your trap?
translation: 我是怎么逃出你的陷阱的？

raw_item.translation: 就几个星期。希望到了那边能再搜刮到一些。

source: For a few weeks. Hopefully we can scrounge up some more where we're going.
translation: 就几个星期。希望到了那边能再搜刮到一些。

raw_item.translation: 你想干什么？来嘲笑我这把老骨头被诅咒缠身吗？

source: What do you want? Here to mock me for the curse that hounds an old life?
translation: 你想干什么？来嘲笑我这把老骨头被诅咒缠身吗？

raw_item.translation: 祝你安康，[P1]。好久不见。

source: Heill ok sæll [Player:Name]. Long time no see.
translation: 祝你安康，[Player:Name]。好久不见。

raw_item.translation: 那是当然。我和我的手下北上到过北方海岸尽头，南下也到过南方海滨。

source: For sure. My crew and I have been as far up the northern coasts as we have been down the southern shores.
translation: 那是当然。我和我的手下北上到过北方海岸尽头，南下也到过南方海滨。

raw_item.translation: 贡纳尔看起来有些不快。

source: Gunnarr looks put off.
translation: 贡纳尔看起来有些不快。

raw_item.translation: 去吧，和女领主一起吃晚饭。

source: Go ahead and join the Hlafdia for dinner.
translation: 去吧，和女领主一起吃晚饭。

raw_item.translation: {结束战役。}

source: {End the campaign.}
translation: {结束战役。}

raw_item.translation: 在长屋前击败贡纳尔。

source: Defeat Gunnarr in front of the longhouse.
translation: 在长屋前击败贡纳尔。

raw_item.translation: 赞颂之词永不消亡，高贵的名声亦然。

source: Words of praise will never perish, nor a noble name.
translation: 赞颂之词永不消亡，高贵的名声亦然。

raw_item.translation: 他基本上就是个耶阿特人。

source: He's basically a Geat.
translation: 他基本上就是个耶阿特人。

raw_item.translation: 不必装模作样。你从未尊敬过我的父亲。我也不会要求你现在开始。

source: There's no need for pretense. You never respected my father. I will not ask that you begin now.
translation: 不必装模作样。你从未尊敬过我的父亲。我也不会要求你现在开始。

raw_item.translation: 我知道你袭击了那座修道院。拜托，省省吧，否认也没用。奥斯雷德国王也许是个懦夫、一个无知之徒，但我们并非全都如此意志薄弱。

source: I know you attacked that convent. Please, save your breath, there's no use denying it. King Osred may be a coward and an ignorant, but we are not all of us so weak-willed.
translation: 我知道你袭击了那座修道院。拜托，省省吧，否认也没用。奥斯雷德国王也许是个懦夫、一个无知之徒，但我们并非全都如此意志薄弱。

raw_item.translation: 罗斯克娃的脚在草地上漫不经心地蹭来蹭去，她举着酒壶，目光四处游移，就是不看你。

source: Røskva is brushing her foot idly across the grass, holding out the flask while looking everywhere except at you.
translation: 罗斯克娃的脚在草地上漫不经心地蹭来蹭去，她举着酒壶，目光四处游移，就是不看你。

raw_item.translation: 贡纳尔这身基础劫掠者装备，看着像是随手凑来的东西拼凑而成。尽管是临时拼凑，它在战斗中提供的防护却出奇地好。

source: Gunnarr's basic raider outfit looks cobbled together from whatever was at hand. Despite its makeshift nature, it offers surprisingly good protection in combat.
translation: 贡纳尔这身基础劫掠者装备，看着像是随手凑来的东西拼凑而成。尽管是临时拼凑，它在战斗中提供的防护却出奇地好。

raw_item.translation: 那我们就说定了，别来烦我们。

source: Your have our word then, leave us be.
translation: 那我们就说定了，别来烦我们。

raw_item.translation: 就这样，对吧？立石上说过有七块石板——我们全都找到了。

source: That's it, right? The standing stones said there were seven tablets - we have them all.
translation: 就这样，对吧？立石上说过有七块石板——我们全都找到了。

raw_item.translation: 外面闹哄哄的，后来就彻底安静了。[P1]把我拉了起来，动作很轻。

source: There was a lot of commotion, then it got really quiet. [Player:Father] pulled me up, very gently.
translation: 外面闹哄哄的，后来就彻底安静了。[Player:Father]把我拉了起来，动作很轻。

raw_item.translation: 这顶钢头盔看起来曾严重受损，但被巧妙地修补过好几次。它的式样很古老，装饰却依然完好。它一定属于一位地位很高的男子。

source: This steel helmet looks like it was heavily damaged but skillfully repaired several times. Its design is ancient, but its ornamentation remains intact. It must have belonged to a man of high rank.
translation: 这顶钢头盔看起来曾严重受损，但被巧妙地修补过好几次。它的式样很古老，装饰却依然完好。它一定属于一位地位很高的男子。

raw_item.translation: 终于掏出一个能钻过去的洞。已经过了一个小时，[P1]看上去憔悴了不少。

source: At last a hole is cleared big enough to squeeze through. An hour has passed, and [Tired01:Name] is looking a lot worse for wear.
translation: 终于掏出一个能钻过去的洞。已经过了一个小时，[Tired01:Name]看上去憔悴了不少。

raw_item.translation: 岩石上放着两碗说不上是什么的液体，周围摆满的蜡烛多得没人有理由带上船。

source: Two bowls of some unidentifiable liquid sit on the rock surrounded by more candles than anyone should have reason to bring on a ship.
translation: 岩石上放着两碗说不上是什么的液体，周围摆满的蜡烛多得没人有理由带上船。

raw_item.translation: 要是你见过我见过的那些东西……

source: If you had seen the things I've seen...
translation: 要是你见过我见过的那些东西……

raw_item.translation: 对，好吧……是的。那就再见了。

source: Right, well... yes. Far vel then.
translation: 对，好吧……是的。那就再见了。

raw_item.translation: 但这个世界并不公平，而你远远不是对手。我这辈子打过十几场仗。你一点机会都没有。

source: But this is not a just world, and you are sorely outmatched. I've fought a dozen wars in my time. You don't stand a chance.
translation: 但这个世界并不公平，而你远远不是对手。我这辈子打过十几场仗。你一点机会都没有。

raw_item.translation: 谢谢。我在练习。

source: Thanks. I'm practicing.
translation: 谢谢。我在练习。

raw_item.translation: {Attack.} 他们看起来乱糟糟的，应该不会太难。赶紧了结吧。

source: {Attack.} They look disorganised, this shouldn't be too difficult. Let's just get it over with.
translation: {Attack.} 他们看起来乱糟糟的，应该不会太难。赶紧了结吧。

raw_item.translation: 嘿！我妈的炖菜哪里惹到你了？

source: Hey! What do you have against my mother's stew?
translation: 嘿！我妈的炖菜哪里惹到你了？

raw_item.translation: 你又老又灰了，斯库勒。你已经不是从前那个男子了。

source: You're old and grey, Skule. You're no longer the man you used to be.
translation: 你又老又灰了，斯库勒。你已经不是从前那个男子了。

raw_item.translation: 我觉得在他们发现我们之前，还有一点时间准备。

source: I think we have a few moments to prepare before they spot us.
translation: 我觉得在他们发现我们之前，还有一点时间准备。
