source: It does sound whimsical, but Eydis is wise and well grounded. Talking to her wouldn't hurt.
translation: 听着是有点异想天开，不过埃迪丝人聪明，又踏实。跟她聊聊没坏处。

raw_item.translation: 她快不行了。我们走的时候她就已经不行了——也许现在她已经死了。

source: She's dying. She was dying when we left - maybe she's already dead now.
translation: 她快不行了。我们走的时候她就已经不行了——也许现在她已经死了。

raw_item.translation: 条纹帆布下的那个女商人显然在竭力不让自己退缩。她的姿态透着反抗，眼神里却满是恐惧。

source: The trader woman under the striped canvas is clearly doing her level best not to cower. Her posture shows defiance, but her eyes show fear.
translation: 条纹帆布下的那个女商人显然在竭力不让自己退缩。她的姿态透着反抗，眼神里却满是恐惧。

raw_item.translation: 我们婚礼前夜，我撞见他跟一个陪床的女奴在一起。

source: The eve of our wedding, I found him with a bed slave.
translation: 我们婚礼前夜，我撞见他跟一个陪床的女奴在一起。

raw_item.translation: 梅林·埃姆里斯轻得惊人。失去了生命之力，如今他不过是个衰弱的老头子。

source: Myrddin Emrys weighs surprisingly little. Bereft of his life force, now he's just a frail old man.
translation: 梅林·埃姆里斯轻得惊人。失去了生命之力，如今他不过是个衰弱的老头子。

raw_item.translation: 你觉得罗斯克娃怎么样？

source: What do you think about Røskva?
translation: 你觉得罗斯克娃怎么样？

raw_item.translation: 你转身离开，几乎没人理会你的离去；那个不幸的年轻人就留了下来，去承受他那胡乱训练带来的后果。

source: You turn to depart, and are barely acknowledged as you leave the unhappy young man to face the consequences of his haphazard training.
translation: 你转身离开，几乎没人理会你的离去；那个不幸的年轻人就留了下来，去承受他那胡乱训练带来的后果。

raw_item.translation: 布鲁诺礼貌地点了点头。

source: Bruno nods politely.
translation: 布鲁诺礼貌地点了点头。

raw_item.translation: 如果这是塔拉让你干的什么无聊把戏，你可以告诉她，下回挑跑腿的[P1]时得挑准点。

source: If this was some lame trick Tara put you up to, you can tell her she needs to pick her errand-[Player:boys/girls] better in the future.
translation: 如果这是塔拉让你干的什么无聊把戏，你可以告诉她，下回挑跑腿的[Player:boys/girls]时得挑准点。

raw_item.translation: 我们奉命把你押往地牢，在那儿等候审判。

source: We are ordered to bring you to the dungeons where you will await trial.
translation: 我们奉命把你押往地牢，在那儿等候审判。

raw_item.translation: 我终于赢得你的全力支持了吗？

source: Have I finally earned your full support?
translation: 我终于赢得你的全力支持了吗？

raw_item.translation: 吟游诗人会传唱我们的事迹，传很多年！

source: The skalds will sing of our deeds for years to come!
translation: 吟游诗人会传唱我们的事迹，传很多年！

raw_item.translation: 约斯泰因和丹尔对视一眼，同步耸了耸肩，配合得滴水不漏。

source: Josteinn and Danr look at each other, and execute a perfectly synchronised shrug.
translation: 约斯泰因和丹尔对视一眼，同步耸了耸肩，配合得滴水不漏。

raw_item.translation: 那事我能办，可帮忙不是白帮的。

source: I can sort that out, but our aid isn't free.
translation: 那事我能办，可帮忙不是白帮的。

raw_item.translation: 在我看来，我早晚得跟你或者瓦莱里乌斯打一场。我倒宁愿跟瓦莱里乌斯打。

source: It looks to me like I'll have to fight either you or Valerius. I'd rather fight Valerius.
translation: 在我看来，我早晚得跟你或者瓦莱里乌斯打一场。我倒宁愿跟瓦莱里乌斯打。

raw_item.translation: 他可不是一千岁，小子。那种事根本不可能。

source: He's not a thousand years old, son. Such a thing is impossible.
translation: 他可不是一千岁，小子。那种事根本不可能。

raw_item.translation: 忽然间，她满腔的怒火像是泄了个干净，放声哭了起来。

source: Suddenly all the anger seems to drain out of her, and she bursts into tears.
translation: 忽然间，她满腔的怒火像是泄了个干净，放声哭了起来。

raw_item.translation: 欢迎，陌生人。我听说镇上来了一些新面孔，你倒挺符合描述。我叫西格堡，有什么能帮上你的？

source: Wilcume, stranger. I've heard there were new folks in town, and you fit the description. My name's Sigeburg, how may I help you?
translation: 欢迎，陌生人。我听说镇上来了一些新面孔，你倒挺符合描述。我叫西格堡，有什么能帮上你的？

raw_item.translation: 很抱歉再次转达我主人的拒绝，但在你在这儿建立起更好的声望之前，我只能请你离开。

source: I'm very sorry to repeat my master's rejection, but I have to turn you away until you've established a better reputation here.
translation: 很抱歉再次转达我主人的拒绝，但在你在这儿建立起更好的声望之前，我只能请你离开。

raw_item.translation: 新来的商人在营地和海滩之间搭了个摊位。看摊的是一男一女，年纪相仿，一看就是皮克特人。

source: Newly arrived merchants have erected a stall between the camp and the beach. It's staffed by a man and a woman of similar age, and very clearly of Pictish origin.
translation: 新来的商人在营地和海滩之间搭了个摊位。看摊的是一男一女，年纪相仿，一看就是皮克特人。

raw_item.translation: 考斯坦丁的眼中透着冰冷与坚硬。你迎上他的目光，他缓缓点了点头。

source: Caustantin's eyes are cold and hard. You meet his gaze, and he nods slowly.
translation: 考斯坦丁的眼中透着冰冷与坚硬。你迎上他的目光，他缓缓点了点头。

raw_item.translation: 嗯……当然，我想是吧。

source: Well... sure, I suppose.
translation: 嗯……当然，我想是吧。

raw_item.translation: 你说得很有道理。我自己就是领主——我是说，酋长——治下一座独立的村庄，正竭力保住我们的自由。

source: You make a lot of sense. I myself am the thegn - chieftain, I mean - of an independent village struggling to maintain our freedom.
translation: 你说得很有道理。我自己就是领主——我是说，酋长——治下一座独立的村庄，正竭力保住我们的自由。

raw_item.translation: 埃尔林死了。你现在归我管。

source: Erlingr was killed. You belong to me now.
translation: 埃尔林死了。你现在归我管。

raw_item.translation: 凯蒂尔疲倦地摇了摇头。

source: Ketill shakes his head, tired.
translation: 凯蒂尔疲倦地摇了摇头。

raw_item.translation: 除了我，谁也没有资格统治斯凯恩！

source: No one but I has the right to rule Skjern!
translation: 除了我，谁也没有资格统治斯凯恩！

raw_item.translation: 一把油污斑斑、造型古怪的钥匙。它的凹槽被烟灰熏得发黑。

source: A greasy key of unusual design. Its recesses are blackened with deposits of soot.
translation: 一把油污斑斑、造型古怪的钥匙。它的凹槽被烟灰熏得发黑。

raw_item.translation: 至少他还算清醒，你一走进他的余光，他便转过身来看你。只看那伤口一眼就明白了：他撑不过去了。

source: He does at least have the presence of mind to turn and look at you when you enter his peripheral vision. One look at the wound makes one thing clear: he's not going to make it.
translation: 至少他还算清醒，你一走进他的余光，他便转过身来看你。只看那伤口一眼就明白了：他撑不过去了。

raw_item.translation: 我们在这摊琐碎政治的烂泥里白白耗费时间，斯库勒可不会袖手旁观！

source: Skule will not sit idly by while we waste our time in this futile mire of petty politics!
translation: 我们在这摊琐碎政治的烂泥里白白耗费时间，斯库勒可不会袖手旁观！

raw_item.translation: 那座巨大的石厅透着一股神圣的气息。我可能看错了，但我猜它也许是座神庙。

source: That big stone hall has an air of sanctity about it. I could be wrong, but I think it might be a temple.
translation: 那座巨大的石厅透着一股神圣的气息。我可能看错了，但我猜它也许是座神庙。

raw_item.translation: 你看起来并不比上次见你时更壮实。你可以走了。

source: You appear no more bulky than when I saw you last. You're free to leave.
translation: 你看起来并不比上次见你时更壮实。你可以走了。

raw_item.translation: 你找到了你的[P1]。口信是什么？

source: You have found your [Player:man/woman]. What is the message?
translation: 你找到了你的[Player:man/woman]。口信是什么？

raw_item.translation: 你救了我父亲。你赢得了我们的信任。

source: You saved my father. You've earned our trust.
translation: 你救了我父亲。你赢得了我们的信任。

raw_item.translation: [P1]，斯凯恩的领主。

source: [Player:Name], thegn of Skjern.
translation: [Player:Name]，斯凯恩的领主。

raw_item.translation: 我给过你毒药！你不肯要！现在它没了，那东西放不了那么久。我得重新配一批，至少得两天。

source: I offered you a poison! You wouldn't take it! It's gone now, it doesn't keep that long. I have to make a new batch, it'll take at least two days.
translation: 我给过你毒药！你不肯要！现在它没了，那东西放不了那么久。我得重新配一批，至少得两天。

raw_item.translation: 凯蒂尔环视着眼前的惨状。

source: Ketill surveys the carnage.
translation: 凯蒂尔环视着眼前的惨状。

raw_item.translation: 这锯子颤悠悠的锯片当武器实在不怎么样，但紧急时也能当剑使。

source: The wobbly blade of this saw makes for a pretty poor weapon, but it can be wielded like a sword in a pinch.
translation: 这锯子颤悠悠的锯片当武器实在不怎么样，但紧急时也能当剑使。

raw_item.translation: 罗斯克娃的护符

source: Røskva's Talisman
translation: 罗斯克娃的护符

raw_item.translation: 你母亲脸上浮现出惊恐不安的神情。

source: A haunted look comes over your mother.
translation: 你母亲脸上浮现出惊恐不安的神情。

raw_item.translation: 乌尔夫伯特剑

source: Ulfberht Blade
translation: 乌尔夫伯特剑

raw_item.translation: 唉，谁管他们允许什么！照你心里想的去做就是了！

source: Oh who gives a toss what they'd allow! Just do what your heart tells you!
translation: 唉，谁管他们允许什么！照你心里想的去做就是了！

raw_item.translation: 她咬紧牙关，眼神变得冷硬。

source: Her jaw clenches and her eyes harden.
translation: 她咬紧牙关，眼神变得冷硬。

raw_item.translation: 皮克特维亚的覆灭

source: The Fall of Pictavia
translation: 皮克特维亚的覆灭

raw_item.translation: 有些麻袋和另外一些东西已经救不回来了。

source: Some of the sacks and a few other things are beyond saving.
translation: 有些麻袋和另外一些东西已经救不回来了。

raw_item.translation: 你说出"抢"这个字时，她明显瑟缩了一下。

source: She flinches visibly when you speak the word "rob".
translation: 你说出"抢"这个字时，她明显瑟缩了一下。

raw_item.translation: 斯凯恩的百姓奋起反击，可劫掠者人多势众。一栋房子被烧成灰烬，诺斯人扬长而去。

source: The people of Skjern fought back, but the raiders overwhelmed them. A house was burned to the ground, and the Northmen escaped.
translation: 斯凯恩的百姓奋起反击，可劫掠者人多势众。一栋房子被烧成灰烬，诺斯人扬长而去。

raw_item.translation: 他看上去确实是真心感到抱歉。

source: He does look genuinely apologetic.
translation: 他看上去确实是真心感到抱歉。

raw_item.translation: 他带着怀疑的神色打量着你。随后他竖起食指，转过身，走向他那群同伴。

source: He fixes you with a skeptical look. Then he holds up his index finger, turns, and walks over to the rest of his pack.
translation: 他带着怀疑的神色打量着你。随后他竖起食指，转过身，走向他那群同伴。

raw_item.translation: 我自己对付得了他。

source: I can handle him myself.
translation: 我自己对付得了他。

raw_item.translation: 她从腰带上解下一个小袋子，按进你手里。

source: She loosens a small pouch from her belt and presses it into your hand.
translation: 她从腰带上解下一个小袋子，按进你手里。

raw_item.translation: 这些石头讲述着一位古代国王的事迹，他曾为一个叫阿尔比恩的国度征战并战死。对这位国王，人们的说法不一，有称他英雄的，也有称他魔鬼的，看来立起这些石头的人对他的评价恐怕相当矛盾。

source: The stones speak of an ancient king who fought and died for a nation known as Albion. The king is variously referred to as a hero and an adversary, and it seems the people who erected these stones may have had a fairly ambiguous opinion of him.
translation: 这些石头讲述着一位古代国王的事迹，他曾为一个叫阿尔比恩的国度征战并战死。对这位国王，人们的说法不一，有称他英雄的，也有称他魔鬼的，看来立起这些石头的人对他的评价恐怕相当矛盾。

raw_item.translation: 你介意我去你的岛上看看吗？

source: Do you mind if I explore your island?
translation: 你介意我去你的岛上看看吗？

raw_item.translation: 宽凿

source: Wide Chisel
translation: 宽凿

raw_item.translation: 塔楼入口更宽敞些，我们需要腾挪的空间。

source: The tower entrance is more spacious, we need room to manoeuvre.
translation: 塔楼入口更宽敞些，我们需要腾挪的空间。

raw_item.translation: 他微微把头往后一仰，朝阿斯莱夫那边。

source: He throws his head back slightly towards Asleifr.
translation: 他微微把头往后一仰，朝阿斯莱夫那边。

raw_item.translation: 我们有几个盟友似乎已经突破防线了。

source: A few of our allies appear to have broken through the lines.
translation: 我们有几个盟友似乎已经突破防线了。

raw_item.translation: 我不想杀这些人。看看有没有别的出路。

source: I don't want to kill any of these people. Let's see if there's another way out.
translation: 我不想杀这些人。看看有没有别的出路。

raw_item.translation: 不行！你不能！你必须留在这里！你不能去，太危险了！

source: No! You can't! You have to stay here! You can't go, it's dangerous!
translation: 不行！你不能！你必须留在这里！你不能去，太危险了！

raw_item.translation: [P1]恳求地看着你，几乎带着绝望。

source: [ObjectOfAffection:Name] gives you an imploring look, bordering on desperate.
translation: [ObjectOfAffection:Name]恳求地看着你，几乎带着绝望。

raw_item.translation: 这只是个建议。虽然那会是冷血谋杀，但我还是觉得这比牺牲我们自己人要好。

source: It was just a suggestion. Though it would be cold-blooded murder, I still find it preferable to sacrificing one of our own.
translation: 这只是个建议。虽然那会是冷血谋杀，但我还是觉得这比牺牲我们自己人要好。

raw_item.translation: 找到那个穿蓝衣的强盗，取回传家宝，交还给农夫。

source: Find the bandit in blue, retrieve the heirloom, and return it to the farmer.
translation: 找到那个穿蓝衣的强盗，取回传家宝，交还给农夫。

raw_item.translation: 啊！妈的！

source: Ah! Shite!
translation: 啊！妈的！

raw_item.translation: 发生什么了？

source: What happened?
translation: 发生什么了？

raw_item.translation: 凯蒂尔费力地理解并翻译着。

source: Ketill strains to understand and translate.
translation: 凯蒂尔费力地理解并翻译着。

raw_item.translation: 又是一阵欢呼和掌声。随后，埃塞尔雷德开始念他的盟友名单，盛赞郡长、准郡长、郡长以及准郡长的功绩，最后终于轮到了你。

source: There is another outbreak of cheers and applause. Presently, Æthelred starts down his list of allies, laying out with great praise the contributions of ealdormen, soon-to-be ealdormen, gerefas and soon-to-be gerefas, until at last he reaches you.
translation: 又是一阵欢呼和掌声。随后，埃塞尔雷德开始念他的盟友名单，盛赞郡长、准郡长、郡长以及准郡长的功绩，最后终于轮到了你。

raw_item.translation: 我们不是雇佣兵。我们是盟友。

source: We're not mercenaries. We're allies.
translation: 我们不是雇佣兵。我们是盟友。

raw_item.translation: 找到那位老隐士居住的山洞。

source: Find the cave where the old hermit lives.
translation: 找到那位老隐士居住的山洞。

raw_item.translation: “海鸥在潮水之上翱翔……”嗯，不对。“鸟儿尖叫着高高飞起……”呃！烂透了。

source: "And with the soaring gulls above the tide..." hmm, no. "And with the screeching birds a-soaring high..." AUGH! Rubbish.
translation: “海鸥在潮水之上翱翔……”嗯，不对。“鸟儿尖叫着高高飞起……”呃！烂透了。

raw_item.translation: 他们根本不是我们的对手，但我们饶了他们一命。

source: They were no match for us, but we spared them.
translation: 他们根本不是我们的对手，但我们饶了他们一命。

raw_item.translation: 她甜甜一笑，抬手把一缕金发从脸上拨开。不知怎的，这个动作最后变成了她纤细的手按在[P1]胸口上，而他对此绝非毫无察觉。

source: Smiling sweetly, she reaches up to brush a strand of golden hair away from her face. Somehow the gesture ends with her slender hand on [ObjectOfAffection:Name]'s chest, which is in no way lost on him.
translation: 她甜甜一笑，抬手把一缕金发从脸上拨开。不知怎的，这个动作最后变成了她纤细的手按在[ObjectOfAffection:Name]胸口上，而他对此绝非毫无察觉。

raw_item.translation: 看着这具尸体，它的光芒似乎暗淡了几秒，露出一张饥饿男子的脸。他嘴和手周围结着干涸的血痂，衣服破烂不堪，身上遍布旧伤和瘀痕。

source: Looking at the body, its glow seems to diminish for a few seconds to reveal the face of a starved man. Dried blood is caked around his mouth and hands and his clothes are completely tattered and torn. Old bruises and wounds cover most of his body.
translation: 看着这具尸体，它的光芒似乎暗淡了几秒，露出一张饥饿男子的脸。他嘴和手周围结着干涸的血痂，衣服破烂不堪，身上遍布旧伤和瘀痕。

raw_item.translation: {调查骚动。}

source: {Investigate the commotion.}
translation: {调查骚动。}

raw_item.translation: 很高兴能把它还给它那所谓的合法主人。

source: Happy to get it back to what passes for its rightful owner.
translation: 很高兴能把它还给它那所谓的合法主人。

raw_item.translation: 那女人离你最近。你走回她身边，她明显紧张起来。你随手挥了挥左手，趁她的眼睛盯着那只手时，你右手举起了刀。

source: The woman is nearest to you. You walk back to her, and she tenses up visibly. You wave your left hand in a casual gesture, and while her eyes are on that hand, you bring your knife up in your right.
translation: 那女人离你最近。你走回她身边，她明显紧张起来。你随手挥了挥左手，趁她的眼睛盯着那只手时，你右手举起了刀。

raw_item.translation: 你没有当雅尔的胆量。

source: You don't have the stomach to be Jarl.
translation: 你没有当雅尔的胆量。

raw_item.translation: 我会把德鲁伊带来给你。

source: I'll bring you the druid.
translation: 我会把德鲁伊带来给你。

raw_item.translation: 你需要什么吗？不然我就回去采毛地黄了。

source: Do you need something? Otherwise I'll just get back to picking foxglove.
translation: 你需要什么吗？不然我就回去采毛地黄了。

raw_item.translation: 恐怕西居尔德国王现在分身乏术。他必须确保麾下领主全力支持，以应对法兰克人日后的任何进犯——你肯定明白：要是查理曼打过来，我们就是第一道防线。国王心里装着的，是我们的利益。

source: I'm afraid King Sigurdr is preoccupied. He must ensure the full support of his thegns against any future Frankish incursions - I'm sure you understand: if Charlemagne attacks, we will be the first line of defence. The King has our best interests in mind.
translation: 恐怕西居尔德国王现在分身乏术。他必须确保麾下领主全力支持，以应对法兰克人日后的任何进犯——你肯定明白：要是查理曼打过来，我们就是第一道防线。国王心里装着的，是我们的利益。

raw_item.translation: [P1]这[P2]才是我活着的意义。

source: [i]This[/i] is what I live for.
translation: [i]这[/i]才是我活着的意义。

raw_item.translation: 她思忖片刻。

source: She thinks for a moment.
translation: 她思忖片刻。

raw_item.translation: 然而，你来不及细想这意味着什么。下一刻，他们已举起武器攻来。

source: You have little time to contemplate the implications, however. In the next moment, they raise their weapons to attack.
translation: 然而，你来不及细想这意味着什么。下一刻，他们已举起武器攻来。

raw_item.translation: 南下约克，求见诺森布里亚国王。

source: Ride south to Eoforwic and seek an audience with the king of Northumbria.
translation: 南下约克，求见诺森布里亚国王。

raw_item.translation: 找个懂那堆兽皮的人问问。

source: Find someone who knows about the piled hides.
translation: 找个懂那堆兽皮的人问问。

raw_item.translation: 就是他！维京人把巫师带来了！

source: It's him! The Vikings have brought the sorcerer!
translation: 就是他！维京人把巫师带来了！

raw_item.translation: 啊，你有战士对战斗的品味。你确实该归入我的英灵战士之列。

source: Ah, you have a warrior's taste for battle. Truly, you belong among my Einherjar.
translation: 啊，你有战士对战斗的品味。你确实该归入我的英灵战士之列。

raw_item.translation: 怎么样？

source: Well?
translation: 怎么样？

raw_item.translation: 我对你有一种奇怪的感觉。在我弄明白之前，别走开。

source: I've got a weird feeling about you. Don't go anywhere until I figure it out.
translation: 我对你有一种奇怪的感觉。在我弄明白之前，别走开。

raw_item.translation: 我们在海外的活儿干完了。可以准备收成了。

source: Our work across the sea is done. We're ready for harvest.
translation: 我们在海外的活儿干完了。可以准备收成了。

raw_item.translation: 你[P1]杀了[P2]和平者贡纳尔？那个巨人终于被杀了？若果真如此，你和你的战士一定无人能敌。

source: You [i]killed[/i] Gunnarr the Peaceful? That giant was finally slain? If that's true, you and your warriors must have no equal.
translation: 你[i]杀了[/i]和平者贡纳尔？那个巨人终于被杀了？若果真如此，你和你的战士一定无人能敌。

raw_item.translation: 阿斯莱夫站起身来，甩掉手上的泥。他疲惫地抬起武器，对准了你。

source: Asleifr stands up, shaking mud from his hands. He raises his weapon with a tired hand and levels it at you.
translation: 阿斯莱夫站起身来，甩掉手上的泥。他疲惫地抬起武器，对准了你。

raw_item.translation: 让我看看你的货。

source: Let me look at your wares.
translation: 让我看看你的货。

raw_item.translation: 抱歉。你自己处理吧。我在船上等着。

source: I'm sorry. Handle it yourself. I'll wait on the ship.
translation: 抱歉。你自己处理吧。我在船上等着。

raw_item.translation: 不知老婆在做什么吃的……

source: Wonder what the wife is cooking...
translation: 不知老婆在做什么吃的……

raw_item.translation: 你这个自私又恶毒的[P1]！我完全有权在这里，面对杀我儿子的凶手！

source: You selfish, spiteful [Player:man/woman]! I have every right to be here, to face my son's killer!
translation: 你这个自私又恶毒的[Player:man/woman]！我完全有权在这里，面对杀我儿子的凶手！

raw_item.translation: 我有问题要问你。

source: I have questions for you.
translation: 我有问题要问你。

raw_item.translation: 凯蒂尔深吸一口气。

source: Ketill takes a deep breath.
translation: 凯蒂尔深吸一口气。

raw_item.translation: 你这话是什么意思？

source: What do you mean by that?
translation: 你这话是什么意思？

raw_item.translation: 对不起。我本该在这里保护你的。

source: I'm sorry. I should've been here to protect you.
translation: 对不起。我本该在这里保护你的。

raw_item.translation: 告诉我你需要什么。

source: Tell me what you need.
translation: 告诉我你需要什么。

raw_item.translation: 我耗费了大量资源才把这个人带来。但愿开口讨点报酬不算太粗俗。

source: I expended great resources to bring this man here. I hope it's not too crass to ask for a reward of some kind.
translation: 我耗费了大量资源才把这个人带来。但愿开口讨点报酬不算太粗俗。

raw_item.translation: 我哪儿也不去。

source: I'm not going anywhere.
translation: 我哪儿也不去。

raw_item.translation: 还有……多谢你帮忙。

source: And hey... thanks for your help.
translation: 还有……多谢你帮忙。

raw_item.translation: 幸好有你在，我们才能免受那样的袭击。

source: We're lucky we have you to keep us safe from attacks like that.
translation: 幸好有你在，我们才能免受那样的袭击。

raw_item.translation: 哦哦，这正合适。你对我够意思，朋友。

source: Ohhh, this'll do nicely. You've done right by me, friend.
translation: 哦哦，这正合适。你对我够意思，朋友。

raw_item.translation: 奥斯雷德虽然提高了嗓门，但他这番愤怒的表演听起来底气并不怎么足。

source: Though Osred raises his voice, he doesn't sound particularly confident in his own display of outrage.
translation: 奥斯雷德虽然提高了嗓门，但他这番愤怒的表演听起来底气并不怎么足。

raw_item.translation: [P1]，de mar a tha thu？欢迎投身战事。

source: [Player:Name], de mar a tha thu? Welcome to the war effort.
translation: [Player:Name]，de mar a tha thu？欢迎投身战事。

raw_item.translation: 一旦我们接受了死亡，那就是我们死去的时候。别向那片黑暗屈服，[P1]。

source: The moment we accept our death, that is when we die. Don't give in to that darkness, [Player:Name].
translation: 一旦我们接受了死亡，那就是我们死去的时候。别向那片黑暗屈服，[Player:Name]。

raw_item.translation: 我付不起。

source: I can't afford that.
translation: 我付不起。

raw_item.translation: 一——一艘战船？噢天哪。

source: A-- a warship? Oh dear.
translation: 一——一艘战船？噢天哪。

raw_item.translation: 然后去哪？做什么？我总不能就这么收拾东西，在道路上过一辈子。

source: And go where? Do what? I can't just pick up and live a life on the roads.
translation: 然后去哪？做什么？我总不能就这么收拾东西，在道路上过一辈子。

raw_item.translation: 芬妮。只是别想把功劳抢走。

source: Fine. Just don't try to take the credit.
translation: 芬妮。只是别想把功劳抢走。

raw_item.translation: 你说得对。家乡的人还指望我们呢。

source: You're right. People at home are counting on us.
translation: 你说得对。家乡的人还指望我们呢。

raw_item.translation: 办妥了。

source: It is done.
translation: 办妥了。

raw_item.translation: 我可能在考庞见过类似的东西。也许我们该去集市上打听打听？

source: I may have seen something like it up in Kaupang. Perhaps we should ask around in the market?
translation: 我可能在考庞见过类似的东西。也许我们该去集市上打听打听？

raw_item.translation: {放了她。}啊，算了。

source: {Release her.} Ah, forget it.
translation: {放了她。}啊，算了。

raw_item.translation: 然后那混蛋就走了，死了……你要是见到他，告诉他英吉马尔可没忘了他的轻慢！

source: Then the bastard went and died... when you see him, tell him Ingimarr did not forget his slight!
translation: 然后那混蛋就走了，死了……你要是见到他，告诉他英吉马尔可没忘了他的轻慢！

raw_item.translation: 她挠了挠手腕。

source: She scratches her wrist.
translation: 她挠了挠手腕。

raw_item.translation: 你发现梅林盘腿坐在他那木台子的边缘，正用蜡烛慢慢烤着某种草药。

source: You find Myrddin sitting crosslegged on the edge of his wood platform, slowly roasting some manner of herb above a candle.
translation: 你发现梅林盘腿坐在他那木台子的边缘，正用蜡烛慢慢烤着某种草药。

raw_item.translation: 你会看到我们这边才占着理。

source: You'll see we're in the right here.
translation: 你会看到我们这边才占着理。

raw_item.translation: 所以，如果我替你解决这件事，你就会支持埃塞尔雷德，他再支持我。好极了。

source: So if I solve this for you, you'll give your support to Æthelred, so he'll give his support to me. Fantastic.
translation: 所以，如果我替你解决这件事，你就会支持埃塞尔雷德，他再支持我。好极了。

raw_item.translation: 嗯。那我们得保持警惕。他可能还会有机会袭击我们。

source: Hmm. Then we must be on our guard. He may get another chance to strike at us.
translation: 嗯。那我们得保持警惕。他可能还会有机会袭击我们。

raw_item.translation: 对不起。这真是太蠢了。我只是想……

source: I'm sorry. This was really stupid. I just thought...
translation: 对不起。这真是太蠢了。我只是想……

raw_item.translation: 尽管我们之间有分歧，我还是把他当作近乎朋友的人。我下不了手杀他。

source: I considered him as near to a friend as our differences permitted. I couldn’t kill him.
translation: 尽管我们之间有分歧，我还是把他当作近乎朋友的人。我下不了手杀他。

raw_item.translation: 只不过你不是基督徒，对吧？他们说你信奉古老的神祇，那些神与基督日益扩散的光芒为敌，还驱使你们去寻求暴烈的死亡。

source: Except you're not Christian, are you? They say you worship ancient gods that fight against the spreading light of Christ and compel you to seek violent deaths.
translation: 只不过你不是基督徒，对吧？他们说你信奉古老的神祇，那些神与基督日益扩散的光芒为敌，还驱使你们去寻求暴烈的死亡。

raw_item.translation: [P1]的牢房前有六名守卫。装备轻便。

source: Six guards in front of [Player:Name]'s cell. Lightly armed.
translation: [Player:Name]的牢房前有六名守卫。装备轻便。

raw_item.translation: 帐篷外，你的亲卫队成员干着杂活的声响令人安心，穿透了营地的寂静。

source: Outside the tent, the reassuring sounds of your hirdmen going about their chores penetrate the silence of the camp.
translation: 帐篷外，你的亲卫队成员干着杂活的声响令人安心，穿透了营地的寂静。

raw_item.translation: {接受吧。}谢谢你，但你不必为我担心。在外面，我们都会互相照应的。

source: {Accept it.} Thank you, but you mustn't worry about me. We all have each other's backs out there.
translation: {接受吧。}谢谢你，但你不必为我担心。在外面，我们都会互相照应的。

raw_item.translation: 就当我没问。最好让大家都知道你回来了。

source: Forget I asked. Better let everyone know you're back.
translation: 就当我没问。最好让大家都知道你回来了。

raw_item.translation: 然而，当你被带到他面前时，他眼中有着 unmistakable 的恐惧。

source: And yet, as you are brought before him, there is an unmistakable fear in his eyes.
translation: 然而，当你被带到他面前时，他眼中有着 unmistakable 的恐惧。

raw_item.translation: 你只能忍着了，[P1]。

source: You'll just have to suck it up, [Victim:Name].
translation: 你只能忍着了，[Victim:Name]。

raw_item.translation: 我的一些亲卫队成员受了伤。你愿意给他们治吗？

source: Some of my hirdmen have been injured. Will you treat them?
translation: 我的一些亲卫队成员受了伤。你愿意给他们治吗？

raw_item.translation: 我们得去见国王。你的那些武器还是收在鞘里，对大家都好。

source: We need to see the king. It's best for everyone if those weapons of yours remain sheathed.
translation: 我们得去见国王。你的那些武器还是收在鞘里，对大家都好。

raw_item.translation: 你会变成乌鸦的食物！

source: You'll be crow food!
translation: 你会变成乌鸦的食物！

raw_item.translation: 那就更有理由不跟着去了。

source: All the more reason not to tag along.
translation: 那就更有理由不跟着去了。

raw_item.translation: 那些小杂种骗了我们。

source: Those little shits lied to us.
translation: 那些小杂种骗了我们。

raw_item.translation: 工匠们迅速收拾好行装，让[P1]道了[P2]别。

source: The craftsmen pack their gear quickly and let [CraftsmenEscort:Name] say [CraftsmenEscort:his/her] goodbyes.
translation: 工匠们迅速收拾好行装，让[CraftsmenEscort:Name]道了[CraftsmenEscort:his/her]别。

raw_item.translation: 我也一样——到让我羞愧的程度。但这羞愧只属于我，我不会和你分担。

source: As did I - to an extent that shames me. But the shame is all mine, and I will not share it with you.
translation: 我也一样——到让我羞愧的程度。但这羞愧只属于我，我不会和你分担。

raw_item.translation: 你坐下加入亲兵队的晚宴时，[P1]抬起头来。

source: [Questioner:Name] looks up as you sit down to join your hird for dinner.
translation: 你坐下加入亲兵队的晚宴时，[Questioner:Name]抬起头来。

raw_item.translation: 没错！

source: Right!
translation: 没错！

raw_item.translation: 谢谢。

source: Thank you.
translation: 谢谢。

raw_item.translation: 够了！卫兵，到你们国王身边来！别留一个维京人活口！

source: Enough! Guards, to your king! Leave no Vikings alive!
translation: 够了！卫兵，到你们国王身边来！别留一个维京人活口！

raw_item.translation: 我一直想进去，可父亲不让——他谁都不让进。

source: I've always wanted to go in, but father won't let me - he won't let any of us in.
translation: 我一直想进去，可父亲不让——他谁都不让进。

raw_item.translation: 就为了大摇大摆走回约克被捕？我看不会。谁是我的控告人？

source: Only to stride casually back into Eoforwic to be arrested? I think not. Who is my accuser?
translation: 就为了大摇大摆走回约克被捕？我看不会。谁是我的控告人？

raw_item.translation: 巫师！你太过分了！

source: Sorcerer! You've gone too far!
translation: 巫师！你太过分了！

raw_item.translation: 我怎么能相信这话？我们面前有大事，现在我却不得不怀疑还能不能与你继续合作。

source: How can I believe that? Grave matters lie before us, now I'm forced to question whether you can be trusted with further collaboration.
translation: 我怎么能相信这话？我们面前有大事，现在我却不得不怀疑还能不能与你继续合作。

raw_item.translation: 我们该问问托尔芬，看他能不能胜任建造长船的任务。

source: We should ask Torfinn if he's up to the task of building a longship.
translation: 我们该问问托尔芬，看他能不能胜任建造长船的任务。

raw_item.translation: 如果你向我宣誓效忠，就可以养精蓄锐，留着攻打时用。

source: If you swear fealty to me, you can save your strength for the invasion.
translation: 如果你向我宣誓效忠，就可以养精蓄锐，留着攻打时用。

raw_item.translation: 又回到家了，感觉怪怪的，哪怕只是待一阵子。倒让那边所见所做的一切，都有点像一场梦。

source: It's weird to be home again, even just for a time. It makes everything we've seen and done over there just sort of seem like a dream.
translation: 又回到家了，感觉怪怪的，哪怕只是待一阵子。倒让那边所见所做的一切，都有点像一场梦。

raw_item.translation: 比约格迪丝几乎跳起来，冲过去抓起药品。

source: Bjørgdis nearly jumps to her feet and rushes over to seize the medicine.
translation: 比约格迪丝几乎跳起来，冲过去抓起药品。

raw_item.translation: 你的上帝这会儿总该出手了吧。你身上血都快流干了，可等不起他。

source: Surely your god must intervene any moment now. You don't have much blood left in you, you can hardly afford to wait for him.
translation: 你的上帝这会儿总该出手了吧。你身上血都快流干了，可等不起他。

raw_item.translation: {把商人守卫的尸体交给他。}

source: {Present him with the corpse of the trader guard.}
translation: {把商人守卫的尸体交给他。}

raw_item.translation: 我有种不祥的预感。

source: I have a bad feeling about this.
translation: 我有种不祥的预感。

raw_item.translation: 康纳尔付不起你工钱了。为我而战吧，我会给你报酬。

source: Conall can pay you no longer. Fight for me instead, and I'll reward you for it.
translation: 康纳尔付不起你工钱了。为我而战吧，我会给你报酬。

raw_item.translation: {献上480件贵重物品。} 给你们俩每人12便士。

source: {Offer 480 Valuables.} 12 pence each to both of you.
translation: {献上480件贵重物品。} 给你们俩每人12便士。

raw_item.translation: 我们搁浅的时候……他留了下来，想保住船。

source: When we ran aground... he stayed behind and tried to save the ship.
translation: 我们搁浅的时候……他留了下来，想保住船。

raw_item.translation: 莫坎特眨了一下眼，又眨了一下。然后他笑了起来。那不是开心的笑，笑得他浑身抽搐，很快便哭了。但有一点可以肯定——他要跟你们走。

source: Morcant blinks once, twice. Then he starts laughing. It's not a happy sort of laughter, it convulses his entire body, and soon enough he's crying. But he's coming with you, that's for sure.
translation: 莫坎特眨了一下眼，又眨了一下。然后他笑了起来。那不是开心的笑，笑得他浑身抽搐，很快便哭了。但有一点可以肯定——他要跟你们走。

raw_item.translation: 你从井里拽出一只半腐旧兽皮裹成的包裹。你把它割开，里面的东西洒落在地面那层踩得嘎吱作响的落叶上：一小堆虽少却值钱的珠宝，还有一把早已风光不再的剑。

source: Out of the well, you haul a bundle made from a half-rotted old pelt. You cut it open, and it spills its contents on the crunching leaves covering the ground: a small but valuable stash of jewellery, and a sword that has seen better days.
translation: 你从井里拽出一只半腐旧兽皮裹成的包裹。你把它割开，里面的东西洒落在地面那层踩得嘎吱作响的落叶上：一小堆虽少却值钱的珠宝，还有一把早已风光不再的剑。

raw_item.translation: 你要是打算去会会那些亡命徒，介意我跟你一起去吗？

source: If you're going to confront those outlaws, do you mind if I come with you?
translation: 你要是打算去会会那些亡命徒，介意我跟你一起去吗？

raw_item.translation: 我们有伤者需要治疗。

source: We have injured in need of treatment.
translation: 我们有伤者需要治疗。

raw_item.translation: 你觉得阿斯莱夫这人怎么样？

source: How do you feel about Asleifr?
translation: 你觉得阿斯莱夫这人怎么样？

raw_item.translation: 一旦你倒下、珀斯归我，下一个就是莱奥弗里克和埃塞尔雷德。在我统治你们两国之前，这事不算完。

source: Once you fall and Perth is ours, Leofric and Æthelred are next. This isn't over until I rule both your kingdoms.
translation: 一旦你倒下、珀斯归我，下一个就是莱奥弗里克和埃塞尔雷德。在我统治你们两国之前，这事不算完。

raw_item.translation: 这故事从斯卡伯勒村传到了我们王廷。说的是我们王国一些商人被困异乡，被迫干起了强盗的勾当。

source: The story had travelled to our court from the village of Scarborough. It told of stranded merchants from our kingdom who were forced to act as bandits.
translation: 这故事从斯卡伯勒村传到了我们王廷。说的是我们王国一些商人被困异乡，被迫干起了强盗的勾当。

raw_item.translation: 哦，天哪。你真该看看你那张脸。

source: Oh man. You should see your face.
translation: 哦，天哪。你真该看看你那张脸。

raw_item.translation: 不太对劲！去看着湖那边！

source: Not all right! Go and watch the lake!
translation: 不太对劲！去看着湖那边！

raw_item.translation: 提尔护身符

source: Tyr Talisman
translation: 提尔护身符

raw_item.translation: 她把一根手指按在你唇上，露出一个隐隐带着猫科动物般狡黠的微笑。然后她伸手向后，拿起另一只碗，递给你。它闻着又甜又冲——隐约有浆果的气味。

source: She places a finger on your lips and gives you a faintly feline smile. Then she reaches back, picks up the other bowl, and hands it to you. It smells sweet and sharp at the same time - a hint of berries.
translation: 她把一根手指按在你唇上，露出一个隐隐带着猫科动物般狡黠的微笑。然后她伸手向后，拿起另一只碗，递给你。它闻着又甜又冲——隐约有浆果的气味。

raw_item.translation: 就这么偷偷溜下她可不对。

source: It's not right to just sneak out on her like that.
translation: 就这么偷偷溜下她可不对。

raw_item.translation: 根据凯尔特神话，卢格神用投石索石弹杀死了他的祖父——强击者巴洛尔。不管这件东西是否真是那件武器，它做工精良，实在不像这么个简陋物件该有的样子。

source: According to Celtic mythology, the god Lugh used the Cloich Tabaill to slay his grandfather, Balor the Strong-Smiter. Whether or not this is in fact that weapon, it's a remarkable piece of craftsmanship for such a simple thing.
translation: 根据凯尔特神话，卢格神用投石索石弹杀死了他的祖父——强击者巴洛尔。不管这件东西是否真是那件武器，它做工精良，实在不像这么个简陋物件该有的样子。

raw_item.translation: 要是我们开始偷邻居的东西，迟早会被抓住。俗话说，别在吃饭的地方拉屎。

source: If we start stealing from our neighbours, we'll soon get caught. It's a bad idea to shit where you eat, as it were.
translation: 要是我们开始偷邻居的东西，迟早会被抓住。俗话说，别在吃饭的地方拉屎。

raw_item.translation: 跟我说说你的家乡吧。

source: Tell me about your home.
translation: 跟我说说你的家乡吧。

raw_item.translation: {扭动箭杆。}我答应过给你一个痛快，可没答应让你不疼。

source: {Twist the arrow.} I promised you a quick death, but not a painless one.
translation: {扭动箭杆。}我答应过给你一个痛快，可没答应让你不疼。

raw_item.translation: 遵命，[P1]雅尔[P2]。别忘了玩得开心！

source: As you command, [i]Jarl[/i]. Don't forget to have fun!
translation: 遵命，[i]雅尔[/i]。别忘了玩得开心！

raw_item.translation: 另一个人插嘴，指着墙那头、指向废墟里面。

source: One of the others interject, pointing past the wall into the ruins.
translation: 另一个人插嘴，指着墙那头、指向废墟里面。

raw_item.translation: 老族长身子晃了晃，但随后他从心底深处寻回了一丝力量，挺直了腰，直直地看进你的眼睛。

source: The old patriarch sways, but then he finds an ounce of strength somewhere deep inside himself, straightens up, and looks you straight in the eyes.
translation: 老族长身子晃了晃，但随后他从心底深处寻回了一丝力量，挺直了腰，直直地看进你的眼睛。

raw_item.translation: 那就是我的名字。我知道你为什么来找我——为了赏金任务。

source: That's my name. I know why you've come for me - the bounty.
translation: 那就是我的名字。我知道你为什么来找我——为了赏金任务。

raw_item.translation: 你们的束缚已断。你们自由了，回去过你们的日子吧。

source: Your bonds are broken. Be free, and return to your lives.
translation: 你们的束缚已断。你们自由了，回去过你们的日子吧。

raw_item.translation: 也许你的谋划对我来说太深奥了。就连奥丁本人恐怕也难搞懂你的道理。我只希望这不是软弱的表示。

source: Perhaps your schemes are simply too advanced for me. Odinn himself might struggle to grasp your reasoning. I only hope this is not an expression of weakness.
translation: 也许你的谋划对我来说太深奥了。就连奥丁本人恐怕也难搞懂你的道理。我只希望这不是软弱的表示。

raw_item.translation: 有人在找战士雇？

source: Someone's looking to hire warriors?
translation: 有人在找战士雇？

raw_item.translation: 去约克参加埃塞尔雷德的胜利宴会。

source: Attend Æthelred's victory feast in Eoforwic.
translation: 去约克参加埃塞尔雷德的胜利宴会。

raw_item.translation: 行行行，我杀了他就是！

source: All right, all right, I'll kill him!
translation: 行行行，我杀了他就是！

raw_item.translation: 北方人费了极大的力气，勉强用胳膊肘撑起身子。他稳住急促的呼吸，直直地看进你的眼睛。

source: Through tremendous effort, the Northman raises himself unto his elbows. He steadies his ragged breath and looks you straight in the eyes.
translation: 北方人费了极大的力气，勉强用胳膊肘撑起身子。他稳住急促的呼吸，直直地看进你的眼睛。

raw_item.translation: 原谅我。

source: Forgive me.
translation: 原谅我。

raw_item.translation: 那是艘战船吗？！哇！

source: Is that a warship?! Wow!
translation: 那是艘战船吗？！哇！

raw_item.translation: 我们不是土匪！我们是经商的船员，流落在这儿，完全不是我们的错。

source: We're not bandits! We're merchant sailors, marooned here through no fault of our own.
translation: 我们不是土匪！我们是经商的船员，流落在这儿，完全不是我们的错。

raw_item.translation: 他举起双手，像是要护住自己。

source: He holds up his hands as though to shield himself.
translation: 他举起双手，像是要护住自己。

raw_item.translation: 我听说你手上有件属于她的东西。

source: I'm told you have something that belongs to her.
translation: 我听说你手上有件属于她的东西。

raw_item.translation: 两人都笑着打招呼。

source: They both smile in greeting.
translation: 两人都笑着打招呼。

raw_item.translation: 我把那逃跑的家伙带回家了。

source: I've brought home the runaway.
translation: 我把那逃跑的家伙带回家了。

raw_item.translation: 我接受。你的条件比我们奢望的还要优惠。

source: I accept. Your offer is more generous than anything we could have hoped for.
translation: 我接受。你的条件比我们奢望的还要优惠。

raw_item.translation: 你是在筹划新的劫掠吗？

source: Are you planning a new raid?
translation: 你是在筹划新的劫掠吗？

raw_item.translation: 他们既掌管人间的律法，也掌管诸神的律法——他们主持神明的仪式，也在人间伸张正义。

source: They were guardians of the laws of men as well as gods - they presided over the rituals of the divine, and they upheld justice among men.
translation: 他们既掌管人间的律法，也掌管诸神的律法——他们主持神明的仪式，也在人间伸张正义。

raw_item.translation: 那就去吧，你这个心软的大块头。

source: Well go on then, you big softie.
translation: 那就去吧，你这个心软的大块头。

raw_item.translation: 你从土里拔起几株认得出有药效的植物，收好留着以后用。

source: You rip from the soil a number of plants which you recognize as having curative uses and save them for later.
translation: 你从土里拔起几株认得出有药效的植物，收好留着以后用。

raw_item.translation: 守军一定全都退到旧城墙的保护后面去了。

source: All the defenders must have pulled back behind the protection of the old walls.
translation: 守军一定全都退到旧城墙的保护后面去了。

raw_item.translation: 雇来的杀手。

source: Hired killers.
translation: 雇来的杀手。

raw_item.translation: 你该多学学你姐妹。

source: You should be more like your sister.
translation: 你该多学学你姐妹。

raw_item.translation: 巴格斯特将至

source: The Barghest Cometh
translation: 巴格斯特将至

raw_item.translation: 他为什么袭击我们？

source: Why did he attack us?
translation: 他为什么袭击我们？

raw_item.translation: {你自己去挑战他。}我四杯就干光了两桶！

source: {Challenge him yourself.} And I've emptied two casks in four!
translation: {你自己去挑战他。}我四杯就干光了两桶！

raw_item.translation: 我会没事的。

source: I'll be fine.
translation: 我会没事的。

raw_item.translation: 对不起，艾芙。我需要诺森布里亚站在我这边。

source: I'm sorry Aife. I need Northumbria on my side.
translation: 对不起，艾芙。我需要诺森布里亚站在我这边。

raw_item.translation: 油脂罐

source: Grease Pot
translation: 油脂罐

raw_item.translation: {留下。}

source: {Stay.}
translation: {留下。}

raw_item.translation: 你认识他吗？

source: Do you know him?
translation: 你认识他吗？

raw_item.translation: 她[i]咯咯[/i]笑了起来，一时间像是变了个人。

source: She [i]giggles[/i], and for a moment she appears transformed.
translation: 她[i]咯咯[/i]笑了起来，一时间像是变了个人。

raw_item.translation: 我本想朝他们走去，可双脚陷进泥里，拔不出来了。后来一只渡鸦又落到了妈身上，她尖叫起来。

source: I wanted to walk towards them, but my feet sank into the mud and I got stuck. Then a raven landed on mom too, and she screamed.
translation: 我本想朝他们走去，可双脚陷进泥里，拔不出来了。后来一只渡鸦又落到了妈身上，她尖叫起来。

raw_item.translation: 唉，说到好奇——艾芙跟我说她主动提出要跟你走，你倒好，直接把她回绝了。你是不是觉得她不像个战士？那是你的损失。

source: Ach, speaking of curiosity - Aife told me she'd offered to join you, and you only went and turned her down. Didn't figure her for much of a warrior, eh? Your loss.
translation: 唉，说到好奇——艾芙跟我说她主动提出要跟你走，你倒好，直接把她回绝了。你是不是觉得她不像个战士？那是你的损失。

raw_item.translation: 他指向一旁，似乎[Pointman:he/she]发现了什么。

source: Pointing off to the side, it seems [Pointman:he/she]'s spotted something.
translation: 他指向一旁，似乎[Pointman:he/she]发现了什么。

raw_item.translation: 你回来了。到底还是决定买条船吗？

source: You've returned. Have you decided to buy a boat after all?
translation: 你回来了。到底还是决定买条船吗？

raw_item.translation: 在那边小心点，[Player:Name]。

source: Be careful out there, [Player:Name].
translation: 在那边小心点，[Player:Name]。

raw_item.translation: 他垂下眼帘。

source: He casts his eyes down.
translation: 他垂下眼帘。

raw_item.translation: 意思是陌生人。我不认识你，就不会帮你。现在滚出去。

source: Meaning strangers. I don't know you, I'm not helping you. Now get out.
translation: 意思是陌生人。我不认识你，就不会帮你。现在滚出去。

raw_item.translation: 康纳尔一死，冒出了许多新机会。我一下子有好多计划要安排！

source: Conall's death has opened many new opportunities. I suddenly have many plans to make!
translation: 康纳尔一死，冒出了许多新机会。我一下子有好多计划要安排！

raw_item.translation: 好，我继续忙了。回头再聊。

source: All right, I'll get back to it. Let's talk again later.
translation: 好，我继续忙了。回头再聊。

raw_item.translation: 伟大而宽厚的雅尔……还有……别的事吗？

source: Great and magnanimous Jarl... was there... something more?
translation: 伟大而宽厚的雅尔……还有……别的事吗？

raw_item.translation: 这念头真吓人——谁知道他和他的随从如今在哪儿，又在盘算什么。

source: That's a scary thought - who knows where he and his followers might be now, and what they're up to.
translation: 这念头真吓人——谁知道他和他的随从如今在哪儿，又在盘算什么。

raw_item.translation: 赫里沃德，因涉嫌邪术异教信仰而被通缉。有人见他出没于约克东北的沼泽。赏金：活捉1440贵重物品，死人1040。

source: Hereward, wanted for sorcorous heathenry. Known to visit the swamp north-east of Eoforwic. Reward: 1440 Valuables alive, 1040 dead.
translation: 赫里沃德，因涉嫌邪术异教信仰而被通缉。有人见他出没于约克东北的沼泽。赏金：活捉1440贵重物品，死人1040。

raw_item.translation: [Helper:Name]按住[Toothache:Name]，[Cutter:Name]则拔出[Cutter:his/her]撒克斯短刀。

source: [Helper:Name] pins down [Toothache:Name] while [Cutter:Name] draws [Cutter:his/her] seax.
translation: [Helper:Name]按住[Toothache:Name]，[Cutter:Name]则拔出[Cutter:his/her]撒克斯短刀。

raw_item.translation: 你示意[Sneaky:Name]跟上，两人一起伏身顺着土坡朝哨兵摸去。可你刚爬到坡顶，脚就在松动的碎石上一滑，碎石哗啦啦地顺着坡洒向哨兵。

source: You signal for [Sneaky:Name] to follow you, and together you begin to creep down the earth ramp towards the sentries. No sooner have you reached the top of the ramp, however, than your foot skids on loose pebbles, sending a spray down the ramp towards the sentries.
translation: 你示意[Sneaky:Name]跟上，两人一起伏身顺着土坡朝哨兵摸去。可你刚爬到坡顶，脚就在松动的碎石上一滑，碎石哗啦啦地顺着坡洒向哨兵。

raw_item.translation: 他们当中最高大的那个朝你指来。

source: The largest among them points toward you.
translation: 他们当中最高大的那个朝你指来。

raw_item.translation: 那就这么定了——我们冲进去，抢到信，再撤回来。

source: Then it's a plan - we charge in, grab the letter, and pull back.
translation: 那就这么定了——我们冲进去，抢到信，再撤回来。

raw_item.translation: 更糟的是，[Sick:Name]因为长时间暴露在恶劣天气里，染上了某种病。

source: Worse still, [Sick:Name] comes down with some manner of illness due to being exposed to the elements for so long.
translation: 更糟的是，[Sick:Name]因为长时间暴露在恶劣天气里，染上了某种病。

raw_item.translation: 那就继续说回槲寄生吧。对我们来说，没有几样东西比这植物更神圣了。这附近极难见到，但多亏基利安，我知道近处有一棵木质坚硬的橡木号，上面就长着它。

source: Then let us remain on the subject of mistletoe. Few things are more sacred to us than this plant. It's extremely rare in these parts, but thanks to Cillian I know of one good hard-timbered oak nearby whereupon it grows.
translation: 那就继续说回槲寄生吧。对我们来说，没有几样东西比这植物更神圣了。这附近极难见到，但多亏基利安，我知道近处有一棵木质坚硬的橡木号，上面就长着它。

raw_item.translation: 天哪，真是——！你能不能认真点？！

source: Oh for--! Would you take this seriously?!
translation: 天哪，真是——！你能不能认真点？！

raw_item.translation: 他又低下了头。

source: He bows his head again.
translation: 他又低下了头。

raw_item.translation: 诺托尔夫久久盯着你，显然在权衡利弊。他的心上人搂住了他的胳膊。

source: Nottolfr gives you a long stare, clearly considering the case for and against. His sweetheart wraps her arms around him.
translation: 诺托尔夫久久盯着你，显然在权衡利弊。他的心上人搂住了他的胳膊。

raw_item.translation: 继续保持。

source: Keep up the good work.
translation: 继续保持。

raw_item.translation: 我们可担不起这种仁慈！要是奥斯雷德知道我们在哪，还有我们有多少人……唉，算了。拿上你的钱走吧。

source: We can't afford that kind of mercy! If Osred learns where we are, and how big our force is... gah, whatever. Take your money and go.
translation: 我们可担不起这种仁慈！要是奥斯雷德知道我们在哪，还有我们有多少人……唉，算了。拿上你的钱走吧。

raw_item.translation: {试一个。}

source: {Try one.}
translation: {试一个。}

raw_item.translation: 看来我们别无选择了。

source: Looks like we have no choice.
translation: 看来我们别无选择了。

raw_item.translation: 战斗赢了，可斯泰因已经没法活着宣誓效忠了。他手下的幸存者踉跄着站起身，随后跪在你面前。他们的生死全在你一念之间。

source: The fight is won, but Steinn is no longer alive to swear fealty. His surviving men stagger to their feet and then kneel before you. They are at your mercy.
translation: 战斗赢了，可斯泰因已经没法活着宣誓效忠了。他手下的幸存者踉跄着站起身，随后跪在你面前。他们的生死全在你一念之间。

raw_item.translation: 谢谢你！真高兴这儿总算[P1]有人[P2]肯干点见血的活儿了！

source: Thank you! Glad [i]somebody[/i] around here is willing to do some bloody work!
translation: 谢谢你！真高兴这儿总算[i]有人[/i]肯干点见血的活儿了！

raw_item.translation: 一切就这么简单，这么容易：你要么[P1]战斗[P2]，要么被遗忘。

source: It's all so simple, so easy: you will [i]fight[/i], or you will be forgotten.
translation: 一切就这么简单，这么容易：你要么[i]战斗[/i]，要么被遗忘。

raw_item.translation: 她无力地想把从辫子里散出来、像芦苇一样支棱着的几缕头发拢回去。

source: She makes a weak attempt to control the strands that have escaped her braid and stand out of it like reeds.
translation: 她无力地想把从辫子里散出来、像芦苇一样支棱着的几缕头发拢回去。

raw_item.translation: 跟你做生意很愉快。

source: Pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 跟你做生意很愉快。

raw_item.translation: 我做不到。

source: I can't.
translation: 我做不到。

raw_item.translation: 啊，祝你安康，我亲爱的[P1]。你这气度像是贵族出身。也许你的家园正需求奴隶？

source: Ah, heill ok sæll my good [Player:man/woman]. You have the bearing of a high-born. Are you in need of thralls for your homestead, perchance?
translation: 啊，祝你安康，我亲爱的[Player:man/woman]。你这气度像是贵族出身。也许你的家园正需求奴隶？

raw_item.translation: 我爱你，妈妈。{她转向埃芙拉，轻轻拽了拽她的辫子}。还有你，你这烦人的小丫头。

source: I love you mom. {She turns to Eyfura and pulls her braid lightly}. And you too, you insufferable brat.
translation: 我爱你，妈妈。{她转向埃芙拉，轻轻拽了拽她的辫子}。还有你，你这烦人的小丫头。

raw_item.translation: 祭司和民兵队领袖仍不理睬你。

source: The priest and the militia leader continue to ignore you.
translation: 祭司和民兵队领袖仍不理睬你。

raw_item.translation: 多少？！

source: How much?!
translation: 多少？！

raw_item.translation: 该看看埃塞尔雷德配不配得上他总穿的那件漂亮锁子甲了。

source: Time to see if Æthelred is worth that fancy coat of mail he always wears.
translation: 该看看埃塞尔雷德配不配得上他总穿的那件漂亮锁子甲了。

raw_item.translation: 基利安一边思索，一边挠了挠鼻子。

source: Cillian scratches his nose while he thinks.
translation: 基利安一边思索，一边挠了挠鼻子。

raw_item.translation: 他一看见你，眼睛就亮了起来，说话时嘴里还喷出几块苹果渣。

source: His eyes light up as he sees you, and bits of apple fly from his mouth as he speaks.
translation: 他一看见你，眼睛就亮了起来，说话时嘴里还喷出几块苹果渣。

raw_item.translation: 这由不得我选——我们没时间了。

source: It's not my choice - we're out of time.
translation: 这由不得我选——我们没时间了。

raw_item.translation: 我不想让你们俩任何一个人的血沾上我的良心。

source: I won't have either of your blood on my conscience.
translation: 我不想让你们俩任何一个人的血沾上我的良心。

raw_item.translation: 在离尸体不远处，你在一丛荆棘里发现了一个匆忙扔下的挎包。虽说风吹雨打，里面的东西却保存完好：品质上乘的零件和材料。

source: A ways from the corpse, concealed within a thorny shrub, you find a satchel thrown in haste. Though wind and weather have taken their toll, the contents are preserved within: parts and materials of fine quality.
translation: 在离尸体不远处，你在一丛荆棘里发现了一个匆忙扔下的挎包。虽说风吹雨打，里面的东西却保存完好：品质上乘的零件和材料。

raw_item.translation: 你可能会发现，西居尔德·环王会觊觎那个头衔，但没有人能理直气壮地质疑你的所有权。

source: You may find that Sigurdr Hringr will covet that title for himself, but none can rightfully dispute your claim to it.
translation: 你可能会发现，西居尔德·环王会觊觎那个头衔，但没有人能理直气壮地质疑你的所有权。

raw_item.translation: 你平安无事，我真是太高兴了！

source: I'm so glad you're safe!
translation: 你平安无事，我真是太高兴了！

raw_item.translation: 我就知道信任你没错——我一见到你时就知道了。

source: I knew I was right to trust you - I knew as soon as I saw you.
translation: 我就知道信任你没错——我一见到你时就知道了。

raw_item.translation: 瓦达让目光审视地扫过王庭卫队。没有人举起武器为死去的国王复仇。瓦达收刀入鞘，放松下来。

source: Wada lets his eyes glide analytically across the royal guards. No weapons are raised to avenge the fallen king. Wada sheathes his dagger and relaxes.
translation: 瓦达让目光审视地扫过王庭卫队。没有人举起武器为死去的国王复仇。瓦达收刀入鞘，放松下来。

raw_item.translation: 你站在一片平地上——一片灰蒙蒙的平原，一直延伸到视野尽头。你累了。睡意像一道影子，渗入你身体占据的空间，将你取代，直到你疲惫得几乎算不上活着。

source: You stand on a plane - a plain, a greyness that extends to the end of vision. You are tired. Sleep fills you like a shadow slipping into the space that your body occupies, supplanting you until you're more tired than you're alive.
translation: 你站在一片平地上——一片灰蒙蒙的平原，一直延伸到视野尽头。你累了。睡意像一道影子，渗入你身体占据的空间，将你取代，直到你疲惫得几乎算不上活着。

raw_item.translation: 你还没来得及防御，他便笨重地转过身，大步走开了。

source: Before you have a chance to defend yourself, he turns ponderously and stalks away.
translation: 你还没来得及防御，他便笨重地转过身，大步走开了。

raw_item.translation: {把手搭在他肩上。}

source: {Place your hand on his shoulder.}
translation: {把手搭在他肩上。}

raw_item.translation: 你重新走进大厅时，里面一片死寂。唐科尔凯俯身伏在女儿的尸体上。多姆纳尔站在他父亲身旁，用手捂住了嘴。

source: The hall is utterly silent when you re-enter. Donncoirce is bent over the body of his daughter. Domnall stands besides his father with his mouth covered by his hand.
translation: 你重新走进大厅时，里面一片死寂。唐科尔凯俯身伏在女儿的尸体上。多姆纳尔站在他父亲身旁，用手捂住了嘴。

raw_item.translation: 再次感谢你邀请我们来这里。活儿多得是，这倒是真的！

source: Thanks again for inviting us here. There's plenty of work, that's for sure!
translation: 再次感谢你邀请我们来这里。活儿多得是，这倒是真的！

raw_item.translation: {婉拒。}我宁可不要——我不想让任何东西在战斗中模糊我的知觉。

source: {Decline.} I'd rather not - I don't want anything to cloud my awareness in battle.
translation: {婉拒。}我宁可不要——我不想让任何东西在战斗中模糊我的知觉。

raw_item.translation: [P1]已同意雇佣我们。我们将每人获得一百厄尔图格白银。在[P2]的领导下，我们将以奥克尼群岛为基地，对不列颠群岛发动全面入侵。

source: [Player:Name] has agreed to hire us. We will be paid one hundred ørtug of silver each. Under [Player:his/her] leadership, we will use Orkneyjar as the basis of a full-scale invasion of the British Isles.
translation: [Player:Name]已同意雇佣我们。我们将每人获得一百厄尔图格白银。在[Player:his/her]的领导下，我们将以奥克尼群岛为基地，对不列颠群岛发动全面入侵。

raw_item.translation: 奇怪，他们抓走了唐科尔凯，却没抓芬努阿拉。你知道为什么吗？

source: Odd that they took Donncoirce and not Finnguala. Do you know why?
translation: 奇怪，他们抓走了唐科尔凯，却没抓芬努阿拉。你知道为什么吗？

raw_item.translation: 今天，你为军团立下了大功。我会在我麾下重整罗慕路斯信徒，带领我们走向辉煌的未来。

source: On this day, you've done a great thing for the Legion. I will reform the followers of Romulus beneath me, and lead us into a glorious future.
translation: 今天，你为军团立下了大功。我会在我麾下重整罗慕路斯信徒，带领我们走向辉煌的未来。

raw_item.translation: 整支商队就在那里凭空消失了。整座城市都在传提灯人、吃人的女巫之类的鬼话。

source: Entire trade caravans simply vanish in there. The whole city is awash in rumours of lantern-men, man-eating witches, and other such nonsense.
translation: 整支商队就在那里凭空消失了。整座城市都在传提灯人、吃人的女巫之类的鬼话。

raw_item.translation: 我们永远欠你的情，陌生人！我们这就收拾行装。等你解决了桥上的那些家伙，我们就过桥。

source: We'll be forever in your debt, strangers! We'll start packing. As soon as you've dealt with the ones on the bridge, we'll cross it.
translation: 我们永远欠你的情，陌生人！我们这就收拾行装。等你解决了桥上的那些家伙，我们就过桥。

raw_item.translation: 维京人。尽管你的族人烧杀抢掠，我们还是欢迎你。如果你是为黄金或荣耀而来，我向你保证，我们两样都没有。

source: Viking. We bid you wilcume, despite the ravaging of your kinsmen. If you've come for gold or glory, I assure you we have neither.
translation: 维京人。尽管你的族人烧杀抢掠，我们还是欢迎你。如果你是为黄金或荣耀而来，我向你保证，我们两样都没有。

raw_item.translation: 凯尔的笑容如明月，嗓音如丝绒。

source: Kyre's smile is like the moon, her voice like velvet.
translation: 凯尔的笑容如明月，嗓音如丝绒。

raw_item.translation: 那个女战士在宝座旁暗中窥伺，身上还留着你与她交手时的痕迹。

source: The warrior woman skulks next to the throne, still wearing the marks of your encounter.
translation: 那个女战士在宝座旁暗中窥伺，身上还留着你与她交手时的痕迹。

raw_item.translation: 返回珀斯，把梅林引见给考斯坦丁。

source: Return to Perth and introduce Myrddin to Caustantin.
translation: 返回珀斯，把梅林引见给考斯坦丁。

raw_item.translation: 他定了定神，眼里仍惊恐得泛着泪光。

source: He gathers himself, eyes still watering with terror.
translation: 他定了定神，眼里仍惊恐得泛着泪光。

raw_item.translation: 谢谢，但这太多了。我只需要一点点优势。

source: Thank you, but it's too much. I only need a small advantage.
translation: 谢谢，但这太多了。我只需要一点点优势。

raw_item.translation: 解毒剂

source: Antidote
translation: 解毒剂

raw_item.translation: 听起来这买卖对咱们双方都不错。船用木材品质好，应该很容易脱手。

source: Sounds like a good deal for us both. Ship wood is good quality, should be easy to sell.
translation: 听起来这买卖对咱们双方都不错。船用木材品质好，应该很容易脱手。

raw_item.translation: 他看了你一会儿，才开口回答。

source: He watches you for a moment before replying.
translation: 他看了你一会儿，才开口回答。

raw_item.translation: 一只大鸟尖叫着疯狂拍打翅膀，对着[P1]又抓又扑。[P2]拼命抵挡这突如其来的攻击，踉跄着向后退去，一脚踩空跌下了边缘。

source: Shieking and flapping madly, a large bird claws and buffets madly at [Klutz:Name]. [Klutz:He/She] desperately tries to fend off the sudden attack and staggers backwards, stumbling blindly off the edge.
translation: 一只大鸟尖叫着疯狂拍打翅膀，对着[Klutz:Name]又抓又扑。[Klutz:He/She]拼命抵挡这突如其来的攻击，踉跄着向后退去，一脚踩空跌下了边缘。

raw_item.translation: 我一直忙得团团转，不过进展顺利。回头再聊。

source: I'm being kept busy, but it's going well. Let's talk later.
translation: 我一直忙得团团转，不过进展顺利。回头再聊。

raw_item.translation: 我听说你一直在抢村庄，还有那些进出村子的人。

source: I'm told you've been robbing from the village and from those who enter or leave it.
translation: 我听说你一直在抢村庄，还有那些进出村子的人。

raw_item.translation: 这么说，这是座神庙。

source: So it's a temple.
translation: 这么说，这是座神庙。

raw_item.translation: 不过，我已经做出了选择。我选择追随你，不是因为你命令我这么做，而是因为……因为我相信我能给你带来好的影响！

source: Nevertheless I've made one. I choose not to follow you because you say I must, but because... because I believe I will be a good influence on you!
translation: 不过，我已经做出了选择。我选择追随你，不是因为你命令我这么做，而是因为……因为我相信我能给你带来好的影响！

raw_item.translation: 劫掠修道院，洗劫教会。

source: Raid the convent and loot the church.
translation: 劫掠修道院，洗劫教会。

raw_item.translation: 几个农场雇工交换了一下眼色，随后悄悄退了开去。他们的主人只顾盯着你，似乎没有察觉。

source: Several of the farm hands exchange looks and then stealthily back away. Too intent on keeping an eye on you, their master doesn't seem notice.
translation: 几个农场雇工交换了一下眼色，随后悄悄退了开去。他们的主人只顾盯着你，似乎没有察觉。

raw_item.translation: 幸会。你接委托吗？

source: Well met. Do you take commissions?
translation: 幸会。你接委托吗？

raw_item.translation: 他把矛柄重重地杵在一块古老的地砖上。

source: He knocks the end of his spear firmly against an ancient floor tile.
translation: 他把矛柄重重地杵在一块古老的地砖上。

raw_item.translation: 他几乎翻了个白眼。

source: He all but rolls his eyes.
translation: 他几乎翻了个白眼。

raw_item.translation: 一朵深色小花，采自你家园附近的墓地。它的茎叶黏糊糊的。

source: A small dark flower plucked in the burial site near your homestead. The leaves of its stem are sticky.
translation: 一朵深色小花，采自你家园附近的墓地。它的茎叶黏糊糊的。

raw_item.translation: 托尔指引我的武器！

source: Thorr guides my weapon!
translation: 托尔指引我的武器！

raw_item.translation: 考斯坦丁付你钱不就是干这个的吗？

source: That's what Caustantin pays you for, innit?
translation: 考斯坦丁付你钱不就是干这个的吗？

raw_item.translation: 我们去了！袭击中我损失了过半的人手。另一边的诺森布里亚人也试过，结果一样。

source: We did! Lost more than half my people in the attack. The Northumbrians on the other side, they tried too. Same result.
translation: 我们去了！袭击中我损失了过半的人手。另一边的诺森布里亚人也试过，结果一样。

raw_item.translation: 你的亲兵队排成一列，一个接一个跳过去。

source: Your hird lines up to make the jump one by one.
translation: 你的亲兵队排成一列，一个接一个跳过去。

raw_item.translation: 她优雅地翻身下马，牵着马朝你其余马匹拴着的地方走去。她看上去很疲惫。

source: She swings herself elegantly off the horse and begins to pull it towards the place where the rest of your horses are tied up. She looks tired.
translation: 她优雅地翻身下马，牵着马朝你其余马匹拴着的地方走去。她看上去很疲惫。

raw_item.translation: 您太客气了，陛下。

source: You are too kind, your majesty.
translation: 您太客气了，陛下。

raw_item.translation: 禁忌贡品

source: Forbidden Tribute
translation: 禁忌贡品

raw_item.translation: 你没事吧？

source: Are you all right?
translation: 你没事吧？

raw_item.translation: 祝你们安好！

source: Beannachd leibh!
translation: 祝你们安好！

raw_item.translation: 胜利宴会！

source: The victory feast!
translation: 胜利宴会！

raw_item.translation: 是什么让他们如此危险？

source: What makes them so dangerous?
translation: 是什么让他们如此危险？

raw_item.translation: 是塔拉派我来的。

source: Tara sent me.
translation: 是塔拉派我来的。

raw_item.translation: 他似乎在心里琢磨着这名字念起来是什么滋味。

source: He seems to test how the name feels in his mouth.
translation: 他似乎在心里琢磨着这名字念起来是什么滋味。

raw_item.translation: {留下。}

source: {Stay.}
translation: {留下。}

raw_item.translation: 这样大概最好。那个疯癫的老太婆说不定根本不让你走。

source: That's probably for the best. The crazy old crone might not let you leave.
translation: 这样大概最好。那个疯癫的老太婆说不定根本不让你走。

raw_item.translation: 戈德威夫心不在焉地用一根手指绕着匕首镶宝石的柄打转。

source: Godwif absentmindedly circles the jewelled hilt of a dagger with a finger.
translation: 戈德威夫心不在焉地用一根手指绕着匕首镶宝石的柄打转。

raw_item.translation: 阿斯莱夫直立了好一会儿，随后晃了晃，倒了下去。一小摊血混进了泥里。

source: Asleifr remains upright for a long moment, then he sways and collapses. A small pool of his blood mixes with the mud.
translation: 阿斯莱夫直立了好一会儿，随后晃了晃，倒了下去。一小摊血混进了泥里。

raw_item.translation: 我同意。我会把奎恩和她的匪帮赶走。

source: I agree. I will drive Quen and her bandits away.
translation: 我同意。我会把奎恩和她的匪帮赶走。

raw_item.translation: 这话说得有些轻描淡写，实际上两个男人花了好几分钟才把石头从入口推开到足够你挤过去的程度。

source: Those words somewhat understate the effort involved, as it takes two of the men several minutes to push the stone far enough away from the entrance that you can squeeze through.
translation: 这话说得有些轻描淡写，实际上两个男人花了好几分钟才把石头从入口推开到足够你挤过去的程度。

raw_item.translation: 让她去吧，妈。内夫娅注定要干一番大事，不该困在这种日子里。

source: Let her go, mom. Nefja is meant for bigger things than this life.
translation: 让她去吧，妈。内夫娅注定要干一番大事，不该困在这种日子里。

raw_item.translation: 嘿，你！滚出去！这儿不欢迎外人！

source: Hey, you! Get out of here! Visitors aren't welcome!
translation: 嘿，你！滚出去！这儿不欢迎外人！

raw_item.translation: 好，那就动手吧。

source: Yes, let's do this.
translation: 好，那就动手吧。

raw_item.translation: 我们会让陛下的王廷知道，他们该准备迎接你到来了。

source: We will let His Majesty's court know that they should anticipate your arrival soon.
translation: 我们会让陛下的王廷知道，他们该准备迎接你到来了。

raw_item.translation: 你离开时，胡尔达在你身后喊道。

source: Hulda shouts after you as you leave.
translation: 你离开时，胡尔达在你身后喊道。

raw_item.translation: 当然。[P1]没什么危险的。

source: Sure. The [Shipname] is quite harmless.
translation: 当然。[Shipname]没什么危险的。

raw_item.translation: 一个你从斯卡拉格里姆亲兵队里认出的弓箭手朝你走来。

source: An archer you recognise from Skallagrimr's hird approaches you.
translation: 一个你从斯卡拉格里姆亲兵队里认出的弓箭手朝你走来。

raw_item.translation: 你愿意为[P1]冒生命危险？

source: You are willing to risk your life for [Player:Name]?
translation: 你愿意为[Player:Name]冒生命危险？

raw_item.translation: 内夫娅望着战后的场面，神情里夹杂着鄙夷与悲伤。

source: Nefja regards the aftermath of the fight with a mixture of disdain and sadness.
translation: 内夫娅望着战后的场面，神情里夹杂着鄙夷与悲伤。

raw_item.translation: 啮足者

source: Footbiter
translation: 啮足者

raw_item.translation: 赫罗德盖尔达从没让我失望过，可你知道，我从不会把所有鸡蛋放在一个篮子里。

source: Hrodgærda has never disappointed me, but you know I never put all my eggs in one basket.
translation: 赫罗德盖尔达从没让我失望过，可你知道，我从不会把所有鸡蛋放在一个篮子里。

raw_item.translation: 埃塞尔雷德让我们来找你，展示他信仰的力量。

source: Æthelred has asked us to come to you and demonstrate the strength of his faith.
translation: 埃塞尔雷德让我们来找你，展示他信仰的力量。

raw_item.translation: 那恐怕他日子不多了。也没什么能做的。

source: Then his days run short, I'm afraid. There is little to be done.
translation: 那恐怕他日子不多了。也没什么能做的。

raw_item.translation: 他给我的印象确实有点……可悲。不过他挑的货色不错，东西看着也挺好。

source: He does strike me as somewhat... pathetic. But his selection is good and his wares look fine enough.
translation: 他给我的印象确实有点……可悲。不过他挑的货色不错，东西看着也挺好。

raw_item.translation: 到手了！他一点都没起疑。你得趁他醒来前赶快！

source: I have it! He doesn't suspect a thing. You must hurry before he wakes!
translation: 到手了！他一点都没起疑。你得趁他醒来前赶快！

raw_item.translation: 那大个子试探性地笑了笑。

source: The big man smiles tentatively.
translation: 那大个子试探性地笑了笑。

raw_item.translation: 平日里要早起吃饭，赴宴之前先填饱肚子。

source: Always rise to an early meal, but eat your fill before a feast.
translation: 平日里要早起吃饭，赴宴之前先填饱肚子。

raw_item.translation: 得了吧，我们说话之前我早就把他们派出去了！他们走得慢又不怪我！说实话，我还以为他们早就放弃了。

source: Come now, I sent them long before we spoke! It's not my fault that they're slow! Frankly, I assumed they'd given up.
translation: 得了吧，我们说话之前我早就把他们派出去了！他们走得慢又不怪我！说实话，我还以为他们早就放弃了。

raw_item.translation: 那些想从古代国王那里偷东西、却不肯献上贡品之人的遗骸。

source: The remains of those who tried to steal from the ancient king without paying their dues.
translation: 那些想从古代国王那里偷东西、却不肯献上贡品之人的遗骸。

raw_item.translation: 西格丽德走回利奥特和凯蒂尔身边，又说了几句道别的话，再次拥抱了他们。终于，该说的话似乎都说完了，凯蒂尔从两位导师身边抽身，回到你这里。

source: Sigridr walks back to Ljotr and Ketill for a few more parting words and another hug. At last it looks like everything that needed saying has been said, and Ketill extracts himself from his mentors to join you again.
translation: 西格丽德走回利奥特和凯蒂尔身边，又说了几句道别的话，再次拥抱了他们。终于，该说的话似乎都说完了，凯蒂尔从两位导师身边抽身，回到你这里。

raw_item.translation: 嗯……我想说的就是这些。谢谢你愿意听我说。还有……谢谢你——谢谢你一开始就给了我一个机会。

source: Well... that was all I wanted to say. Thank you for lending me your ear. And... thanks - for giving me a chance in the first place.
translation: 嗯……我想说的就是这些。谢谢你愿意听我说。还有……谢谢你——谢谢你一开始就给了我一个机会。

raw_item.translation: 旧弓

source: Old Bow
translation: 旧弓

raw_item.translation: 你听说过血鹰刑吗？那其实是一种处决方式，但用来劝人开口也非常有效。

source: Have you ever heard of the blood eagle? It's actually a method of execution, but it can be a very effective form of persuasion too.
translation: 你听说过血鹰刑吗？那其实是一种处决方式，但用来劝人开口也非常有效。

raw_item.translation: 敢惹我的人没有能活下来的。你似乎也这么想。

source: Nobody fucks with me and lives. You seem to be similarly inclined.
translation: 敢惹我的人没有能活下来的。你似乎也这么想。

raw_item.translation: 干得好，小子。就这样一直干到这边完事为止。我得去跟领主谈谈，不过马上就回来。

source: Good work, kid. Just keep at it like that until this side is done. I have to talk to the thegn, but I'll be right back.
translation: 干得好，小子。就这样一直干到这边完事为止。我得去跟领主谈谈，不过马上就回来。

raw_item.translation: 万分敬仰的[P1]，[P2]光临我们简陋的帐篷！我叫格尼普利，今天能为您做些什么？

source: Highly ethteemed [Player:warrior/thieldmaiden], [Player:Velkominn/Velkomin] to our humble tent! My name is Gnypli, how may I therve you today?
translation: 万分敬仰的[Player:warrior/thieldmaiden]，[Player:Velkominn/Velkomin]光临我们简陋的帐篷！我叫格尼普利，今天能为您做些什么？

raw_item.translation: 他茫然地盯着你。

source: He stares at you blankly.
translation: 他茫然地盯着你。

raw_item.translation: {保持隐蔽。}我们不知道他们是谁。得当心点。

source: {Stay hidden.} We don't know who they are. We should be careful.
translation: {保持隐蔽。}我们不知道他们是谁。得当心点。

raw_item.translation: {把号角扔开。}你是想毒死我吗？！懦夫！

source: {Fling the horn away.} Are you trying to poison me?! Coward!
translation: {把号角扔开。}你是想毒死我吗？！懦夫！

raw_item.translation: 她咧嘴一笑。

source: A grin splits her lips.
translation: 她咧嘴一笑。

raw_item.translation: 你走进空地时，好几双凌厉的眼睛抬头看向你。手都摸索着伸向武器，大多数人警惕地站起身来。

source: Several sets of hard eyes look up at you as you enter the clearing. Hands find their way toward weapons and most of them begin to rise, warily.
translation: 你走进空地时，好几双凌厉的眼睛抬头看向你。手都摸索着伸向武器，大多数人警惕地站起身来。

raw_item.translation: 而你就是斯库勒的狂战士。

source: And you're Skule's berserker.
translation: 而你就是斯库勒的狂战士。

raw_item.translation: 希望这对你的旅途有所帮助。

source: I hope that will aid you on your travels.
translation: 希望这对你的旅途有所帮助。

raw_item.translation: 也许正如你所说。我不会告诉你我怎么想。重要的是你自己从这些故事中悟出的意义。

source: Perhaps it is as you say. I will not tell you what I think. What's important is the meaning that you yourself derive from the stories.
translation: 也许正如你所说。我不会告诉你我怎么想。重要的是你自己从这些故事中悟出的意义。

raw_item.translation: 看来反倒是我们要帮你了！

source: Looks like we'll be helping you instead!
translation: 看来反倒是我们要帮你了！

raw_item.translation: 我派威尔弗里德的儿子们去找狼群，把那帮畜生赶走。我最小的女儿埃雷斯也跟他们去了——她自以为是女猎人，可我知道她是看上威尔弗里德家的一个儿子了。

source: I sent Wilfrid's boys out to find the pack and chase those beasts off. My youngest daughter Eres went with them - she fancies herself a huntress, but I know she's sweet on one of Wilfrid's sons.
translation: 我派威尔弗里德的儿子们去找狼群，把那帮畜生赶走。我最小的女儿埃雷斯也跟他们去了——她自以为是女猎人，可我知道她是看上威尔弗里德家的一个儿子了。

raw_item.translation: 我猜你是个猎人？

source: I take it you're a hunter?
translation: 我猜你是个猎人？

raw_item.translation: 就算他们赢了，对声望的损害也已经造成了。现在所有人都看得到斯凯恩有多虚弱、多暴露破绽，西居尔德·环王会在阿尔庭议会上站在我们这边。

source: Even if they had won, the damage to their reputation would have been done. Now that everyone can see how weak and exposed Skjern is, Sigurdr Hringr will side with us at the Althing.
translation: 就算他们赢了，对声望的损害也已经造成了。现在所有人都看得到斯凯恩有多虚弱、多暴露破绽，西居尔德·环王会在阿尔庭议会上站在我们这边。

raw_item.translation: 我想你确实会。

source: I expect you do.
translation: 我想你确实会。

raw_item.translation: 随你便吧，[P1]僧侣[P2]。

source: Have it your way, [i]monk[/i].
translation: 随你便吧，[i]僧侣[/i]。

raw_item.translation: 搜索这片区域。

source: {Search the area.}
translation: 搜索这片区域。

raw_item.translation: 只要你下手足够小心，就能让受害者活上相当长一段时间——长到足够问出你想知道的任何答案。

source: If you do it carefully enough, you can keep the victim alive for quite some time - long enough to get any answer you seek.
translation: 只要你下手足够小心，就能让受害者活上相当长一段时间——长到足够问出你想知道的任何答案。

raw_item.translation: 从珀斯凯尔的“熊”那里取得沃登之角。

source: Obtain Woden's Horn from Kyre's "Bear" in Perth.
translation: 从珀斯凯尔的“熊”那里取得沃登之角。

raw_item.translation: 以150件贵重物品购买矛。我用15厄尔图格银买这柄矛。

source: {Buy spear for 150 Valuables.} I'll take the spear for 15 ørtug of silver.
translation: 以150件贵重物品购买矛。我用15厄尔图格银买这柄矛。

raw_item.translation: 喂！那可不是你能拿的！

source: Oi! That's not yours to take!
translation: 喂！那可不是你能拿的！

raw_item.translation: 他们当然会——要是他们支持我，就能控制我。

source: Of course they do - if they support me, they can control me.
translation: 他们当然会——要是他们支持我，就能控制我。

raw_item.translation: 你最好了。谢谢你为我们做这件事。

source: You're the best. Thank you for doing this for us.
translation: 你最好了。谢谢你为我们做这件事。

raw_item.translation: 那听起来一点也不像盖尔达。要是那头母獾真想让你死，我们压根就不会有这场谈话。

source: That doesn't sound like Gærda at all. If that she-badger wanted you dead, we wouldn't be having this conversation in the first place.
translation: 那听起来一点也不像盖尔达。要是那头母獾真想让你死，我们压根就不会有这场谈话。

raw_item.translation: 眼下我就不打扰你准备了。

source: I'll leave you to your preparations for now.
translation: 眼下我就不打扰你准备了。

raw_item.translation: 太好了。祝你们安好，朋友们。

source: Brilliant. Beannachd leibh my friends.
translation: 太好了。祝你们安好，朋友们。

raw_item.translation: [P1]。我叫斯瓦娜，是这座神庙的女祭司。这是你第一次来吗？

source: [Player:Velkominn/Velkomin]. My name is Svana, I'm a gydja here at the temple. Is this your first time visiting?
translation: [Player:Velkominn/Velkomin]。我叫斯瓦娜，是这座神庙的女祭司。这是你第一次来吗？

raw_item.translation: 可惜，看来没人买账。那大个子男子伸手去抓他的武器。

source: Unfortunately, it looks like nobody's buying it. The large man reaches for his weapon.
translation: 可惜，看来没人买账。那大个子男子伸手去抓他的武器。

raw_item.translation: 这些人在战争中已经遭受了巨大损失。现在他们全都要聚在一个地方喝个烂醉。要是我们在宴席上对他们动手，他们几乎毫无防备。

source: These people have already suffered great losses in the war. Now they're all going to gather in one place and get drunk. If we were to turn on them during the feast, they would be all but defenceless.
translation: 这些人在战争中已经遭受了巨大损失。现在他们全都要聚在一个地方喝个烂醉。要是我们在宴席上对他们动手，他们几乎毫无防备。

raw_item.translation: 过来，我能帮你！

source: Come here, I can help!
translation: 过来，我能帮你！

raw_item.translation: 它今天没点上灯。那些混蛋故意不点灯，好把船引诱到死路上去！我们还没被冲上岸，他们就已经在卷走我们的载货了！

source: It wasn't lit on this day. Those bastards left it unlit to lure ships to their doom! They were already making off with our cargo before we washed ashore!
translation: 它今天没点上灯。那些混蛋故意不点灯，好把船引诱到死路上去！我们还没被冲上岸，他们就已经在卷走我们的载货了！

raw_item.translation: 八个罐子裂了，但其中一个经过火烤硬化的，从柱子上掉下来时还完好无损。他们走在前面，但古老的巨人用眼睛追随着他的敌人。

source: Eight pots split, but one of them, fire-hardened, fell down whole from the post. They walked ahead, but the ancient giant followed his enemy with his eyes.
translation: 八个罐子裂了，但其中一个经过火烤硬化的，从柱子上掉下来时还完好无损。他们走在前面，但古老的巨人用眼睛追随着他的敌人。

raw_item.translation: 那才算真正的统治者——一个把王国的未来置于自己功业之上的人？但愿如此。

source: A true ruler then - a man who puts the future of his kingdom above his own legacy? I hope so.
translation: 那才算真正的统治者——一个把王国的未来置于自己功业之上的人？但愿如此。

raw_item.translation: 她尴尬地咯咯笑了几声。

source: She giggles awkwardly.
translation: 她尴尬地咯咯笑了几声。

raw_item.translation: 别管他了，他再也构不成威胁。我们得去找留里克。

source: Leave him, he's no threat any longer. We need to find Rurik.
translation: 别管他了，他再也构不成威胁。我们得去找留里克。

raw_item.translation: 你是哪里人？

source: Where are you from?
translation: 你是哪里人？

raw_item.translation: 照亮周围区域，让攻击邻近敌人更容易。对准易燃物体可以点火。

source: Illuminates its immediate surroundings, making it easier to hit adjacent enemies. Target flammable objects to start a fire.
translation: 照亮周围区域，让攻击邻近敌人更容易。对准易燃物体可以点火。

raw_item.translation: 孩子们回到圈里，继续自己的练习。这里总有人在训练，你要是想安全地试试新招式，随时回来。

source: The kids get back in the ring and resume their own practice. There are always people training here, come back at any time if you want to try a new move in a safe environment.
translation: 孩子们回到圈里，继续自己的练习。这里总有人在训练，你要是想安全地试试新招式，随时回来。

raw_item.translation: 是的，我——呃……

source: Yes, I-uh...
translation: 是的，我——呃……

raw_item.translation: 我们现在没时间处理这个，再耽搁下去德鲁伊的学徒可能会死。等这事结束了，我们随时能回来。

source: We don't have time for this right now, the druid's apprentice might die if we delay any further. We can always come back when this is over.
translation: 我们现在没时间处理这个，再耽搁下去德鲁伊的学徒可能会死。等这事结束了，我们随时能回来。

raw_item.translation: 你的人从来没信任过我。没有什么可背叛的。

source: Your people never trusted me. There was nothing to betray.
translation: 你的人从来没信任过我。没有什么可背叛的。

raw_item.translation: {示意[P1]在你解决年轻人的同时杀掉那个老头。} 我要给你看这个信物。主教说你会明白的。

source: {Signal to [Partner:Name] to kill the old man while you take out the young.} I am to show you this token. The bishop said you would understand.
translation: {示意[Partner:Name]在你解决年轻人的同时杀掉那个老头。} 我要给你看这个信物。主教说你会明白的。

raw_item.translation: 此刻的能量逐渐充盈整顶帐篷，那股令人头晕目眩的嗡嗡涌动压过了所有恐惧和疑虑。

source: The energy of the moment grows to fill the tent, a heady buzzing rush that drowns out all fears and doubts.
translation: 此刻的能量逐渐充盈整顶帐篷，那股令人头晕目眩的嗡嗡涌动压过了所有恐惧和疑虑。

raw_item.translation: 他对着你这样的人落败，我并不意外。他的傲慢似乎总在招祸。

source: I'm not surprised he fared poorly against somebody like you. His arrogance always seemed to invite disaster.
translation: 他对着你这样的人落败，我并不意外。他的傲慢似乎总在招祸。

raw_item.translation: 你要是投降，我就放你走！大概吧。

source: If you give up, I'll let you go! Probably.
translation: 你要是投降，我就放你走！大概吧。

raw_item.translation: 让我把话说清楚。你把毒药给我。我把它下给康纳尔和他的手下。等他死了，我给你信号，你把外面的人全杀了。大致就是这样吧？

source: Let me just be absolutely clear. You give me the poison. I serve it to Conall and his men. When he's dead, I give you the signal, and you kill everyone out here. That about the size of it?
translation: 让我把话说清楚。你把毒药给我。我把它下给康纳尔和他的手下。等他死了，我给你信号，你把外面的人全杀了。大致就是这样吧？

raw_item.translation: 是啊，或者[P1]只是想要个能跟着[P2]到处走的战利品。

source: Yeah, or [Player:Name] just wants a trophy that can follow [Player:him/her] around.
translation: 是啊，或者[Player:Name]只是想要个能跟着[Player:him/her]到处走的战利品。

raw_item.translation: [P1]推了推门，门微微松动。

source: [Curious:Name] pushes against the gate, and it gives slightly.
translation: [Curious:Name]推了推门，门微微松动。

raw_item.translation: 好，我开始准备。最坏的结果也就是你得照常跟他打一场。

source: Good, I'll start preparing. The worst thing that can happen is that you'll have to fight him like normal.
translation: 好，我开始准备。最坏的结果也就是你得照常跟他打一场。

raw_item.translation: 我早就料到会这样。据我对你们族人的了解，你们把力量看得高于一切。

source: I expected as much. From what I know of your people, you value might above all else.
translation: 我早就料到会这样。据我对你们族人的了解，你们把力量看得高于一切。

raw_item.translation: 另一个匪徒凑过去，在她耳边低语了几句。她显得吃了一惊，随后便告退离开了你们的谈话。他们全都走到听不见的地方，小小地聚在一起商议。

source: One of the other bandits leans in to whisper something in her ear. She looks startled, then she excuses herself from your conversation. They all have a small convention out of earshot.
translation: 另一个匪徒凑过去，在她耳边低语了几句。她显得吃了一惊，随后便告退离开了你们的谈话。他们全都走到听不见的地方，小小地聚在一起商议。

raw_item.translation: 她只是在那里站了一会儿，谄媚地笑着，等着你继续说下去。她显然已经跟不上谈话了。

source: She just stands there for a bit, smiling obsequiously and waiting for you to go on. She's clearly lost track of the conversation.
translation: 她只是在那里站了一会儿，谄媚地笑着，等着你继续说下去。她显然已经跟不上谈话了。

raw_item.translation: 和平与暴政，从外面看也许难以分辨，但对那些生活在威胁之下的人来说，这区别或许并不那么细微。

source: Peace and tyranny can be difficult to tell apart from the outside, but to those who live under threat, perhaps the difference isn't so subtle.
translation: 和平与暴政，从外面看也许难以分辨，但对那些生活在威胁之下的人来说，这区别或许并不那么细微。

raw_item.translation: 罗斯克娃对着炖菜笑出了声。

source: Røskva smiles into her stew.
translation: 罗斯克娃对着炖菜笑出了声。

raw_item.translation: 你被指控袭击并洗劫了蒙克切斯特镇，杀害了王国许多平民。

source: You stand accused of attacking and pillaging the town of Monkchester and murdering many citizens of this kingdom.
translation: 你被指控袭击并洗劫了蒙克切斯特镇，杀害了王国许多平民。

raw_item.translation: 那不算什么。这里的守军简直不堪一击。你那边情况如何？

source: It was nothing. The garrison here was pathetic. How did things fare on your end?
translation: 那不算什么。这里的守军简直不堪一击。你那边情况如何？

raw_item.translation: 旧的训练场还被城外农场来的孩子们占着，领头的是埃迪丝最小的儿子。

source: The old training ring is still occupied by kids from the outlying farms, led by Eydis' youngest son.
translation: 旧的训练场还被城外农场来的孩子们占着，领头的是埃迪丝最小的儿子。

raw_item.translation: 那个叫约维塔的女人阴沉着脸迎接你。

source: The woman called Iovita greets you with a dark scowl.
translation: 那个叫约维塔的女人阴沉着脸迎接你。

raw_item.translation: [P1]似乎放心了些。

source: [Spooked01:Name] seems reassured.
translation: [Spooked01:Name]似乎放心了些。

raw_item.translation: 她扯着嗓子大喊，惊得附近几只鸡扑腾起来。

source: She hollers loudly, startling a few nearby chickens.
translation: 她扯着嗓子大喊，惊得附近几只鸡扑腾起来。

raw_item.translation: 还没结束。你得解决掉他手下那些人，不然我就死定了。

source: It's not over yet. You must deal with his men, or I'm done for.
translation: 还没结束。你得解决掉他手下那些人，不然我就死定了。

raw_item.translation: 祝你安好。

source: Wes hal.
translation: 祝你安好。

raw_item.translation: 像他们说的，瞎得像只蝙蝠——这是我年老时染上的病闹的。不过别让这事影响你对我货物的看法。

source: Blind as a bat, as they say - caused by a disease that came to me in my old age. But don't let it affect your opinion of my merchandise.
translation: 像他们说的，瞎得像只蝙蝠——这是我年老时染上的病闹的。不过别让这事影响你对我货物的看法。

raw_item.translation: 你愿意讲个关于诸神的故事吗？

source: Will you share a story about the gods?
translation: 你愿意讲个关于诸神的故事吗？

raw_item.translation: 你的祭品会存放在神庙里，直到春天的布洛特祭祀，届时会被加入献祭。当然，你要是能亲自参加布洛特祭祀就最好了。

source: Your offering will be stored in the temple until the spring blót, where it will be added to the sacrifice. Of course it's best if you can attend the blót yourself.
translation: 你的祭品会存放在神庙里，直到春天的布洛特祭祀，届时会被加入献祭。当然，你要是能亲自参加布洛特祭祀就最好了。

raw_item.translation: 行吧。我让你用码头，但你得付标准费用。成交？

source: All right. I'll let you use the pier, but you have to pay the standard fee. Deal?
translation: 行吧。我让你用码头，但你得付标准费用。成交？

raw_item.translation: [P1]，让你的人做好准备。奥斯雷德来这里是个大错——他会以为我们死守不出，所以会试图包围我们，但他料不到你会出手。

source: [Player:Name], prepare your people. Osred has made a terrible mistake in coming here - he'll be expecting us to stay on the defensive, so he'll try to surround us, but he won't expect you.
translation: [Player:Name]，让你的人做好准备。奥斯雷德来这里是个大错——他会以为我们死守不出，所以会试图包围我们，但他料不到你会出手。

raw_item.translation: 亡命徒们对你的提议感到意外，彼此低声商议了几句。

source: Surprised by your offer, the outlaws briefly confer with each other.
translation: 亡命徒们对你的提议感到意外，彼此低声商议了几句。

raw_item.translation: 他脸上的笑容渐渐褪去，取而代之的是一副悲伤的神情。

source: His smile gives way to an expression of sadness.
translation: 他脸上的笑容渐渐褪去，取而代之的是一副悲伤的神情。
