source: Leave
translation: 离开

raw_item.translation: 反正看样子你装备齐全，足够对付这家伙了。

source: It looks like you're plenty equipped to deal with this one anyway.
translation: 反正看样子你装备齐全，足够对付这家伙了。

raw_item.translation: 我不会让你女儿出任何事。我向你保证。

source: I won't let anything happen to your daughter. You have my word.
translation: 我不会让你女儿出任何事。我向你保证。

raw_item.translation: 那家伙心思阴暗。总是不合群，总是独来独往。不过她倒是把胡尔达照顾得很好。可惜她不得不看着那老姑娘的心智就这样垮掉。真是可惜。

source: Got a dark mind, that one. Always the outsider, always stuck to herself. Took good care of Hulda though. Shame she had to see the old girl's mind fall apart like that. Real shame.
translation: 那家伙心思阴暗。总是不合群，总是独来独往。不过她倒是把胡尔达照顾得很好。可惜她不得不看着那老姑娘的心智就这样垮掉。真是可惜。

raw_item.translation: 道路畅通！视野内没有威胁。没什么可看的。哦等等，不对——有陷阱。

source: Path clear! No threat in sight. Nothing to see here. Oh wait, no - trap.
translation: 道路畅通！视野内没有威胁。没什么可看的。哦等等，不对——有陷阱。

raw_item.translation: 她把一只手臂深深探进背包，掏出一个小罐子。

source: She sticks an arm deep into her knapsack and pulls out a small jar.
translation: 她把一只手臂深深探进背包，掏出一个小罐子。

raw_item.translation: 抓住那个一直偷你东西的小崽子。

source: Catch the little brat who's been stealing from you.
translation: 抓住那个一直偷你东西的小崽子。

raw_item.translation: 等你有空时，到你叔叔家附近的森林来见我，我们挑些木材，然后开工！

source: Meet me in the forest near your uncle's house when you have time, and we'll pick out some timber and get started!
translation: 等你有空时，到你叔叔家附近的森林来见我，我们挑些木材，然后开工！

raw_item.translation: 莱奥弗里克有点不确定地笑了笑。

source: Leofric smiles a bit uncertainly.
translation: 莱奥弗里克有点不确定地笑了笑。

raw_item.translation: 你们这群混蛋，一个个都是。

source: Bastards, the lot of you.
translation: 你们这群混蛋，一个个都是。

raw_item.translation: 我以为我们该为和耶灵的世仇建立联盟。你在斯凯恩就是这么说的。

source: I thought we were supposed to build alliances for our feud with Jelling. That's what you said back in Skjern.
translation: 我以为我们该为和耶灵的世仇建立联盟。你在斯凯恩就是这么说的。

raw_item.translation: 他礼貌地低下头。

source: He bows his head politely.
translation: 他礼貌地低下头。

raw_item.translation: 凯蒂尔又对着酒瓶深深喝了一口，皱起了脸。

source: Ketill takes another deep drink from the flask and screws up his face.
translation: 凯蒂尔又对着酒瓶深深喝了一口，皱起了脸。

raw_item.translation: [P1] 搭箭上弦，拉开 [P2] 弓，瞄准。

source: [Archer:Name] nocks and draws [Archer:his/her] bow and takes aim.
translation: [Archer:Name] 搭箭上弦，拉开 [Archer:his/her] 弓，瞄准。

raw_item.translation: 吃了三大份之后，[P1] 似乎已经神志恍惚。[P2] 嘴巴还在一张一合地咀嚼，可 [P3] 嘴里早已空无一物。

source: After three massive helpings, [Eater:Name] seems to be in a haze. [Eater:His/Her] jaw works and chews though there is nothing more in [Eater:his/her] mouth.
translation: 吃了三大份之后，[Eater:Name] 似乎已经神志恍惚。[Eater:His/Her] 嘴巴还在一张一合地咀嚼，可 [Eater:his/her] 嘴里早已空无一物。

raw_item.translation: 三人围拢过来，确认梅林确实死了。塔洛尔克看上去很满意。杜布格拉斯和艾丹交换了一下羞愧的眼神。

source: All three gather around to confirm that Myrddin is indeed dead. Talorc looks satisfied. Dubglas and Aedan exchange shameful looks.
translation: 三人围拢过来，确认梅林确实死了。塔洛尔克看上去很满意。杜布格拉斯和艾丹交换了一下羞愧的眼神。

raw_item.translation: 这也能给我们时间去周边氏族召集援兵。我们的邻居靠我们远征带回来的财富大大兴旺了起来。如果留里克篡了你的位，他们可要损失不少。

source: That will also give us time to gather reinforcements from the surrounding clans. Our neighbours have prospered greatly from the wealth our expedition has brought back. They stand to lose much if Rurik usurps you.
translation: 这也能给我们时间去周边氏族召集援兵。我们的邻居靠我们远征带回来的财富大大兴旺了起来。如果留里克篡了你的位，他们可要损失不少。

raw_item.translation: 所以你现在就是掌管奥克尼群岛的那位[P1]了，是吗？我可不觉得这会对我这种人有什么改变。

source: So you're the [Player:man/woman] in charge of Orkneyjar now, is that right? I don't assume that'll change anything for the likes of me.
translation: 所以你现在就是掌管奥克尼群岛的那位[Player:man/woman]了，是吗？我可不觉得这会对我这种人有什么改变。

raw_item.translation: 什么？还有别人配得上这个头衔吗？

source: What? Who else could possibly be worthy of the title?
translation: 什么？还有别人配得上这个头衔吗？

raw_item.translation: 他扭头瞥了一眼那头牲口。它正忙着在院子里拱来拱去找吃的，哼哼个不停。

source: He glances over his shoulder at the animal. It grunts busily as it roots around the yard for something edible.
translation: 他扭头瞥了一眼那头牲口。它正忙着在院子里拱来拱去找吃的，哼哼个不停。

raw_item.translation: 确实如此。要是我能把你永远留在这里，我大概会忍不住——可总不该把野兽关进笼子。

source: It certainly was. If I could hold you here forever, I might be tempted to - but one ought not to cage a wild animal.
translation: 确实如此。要是我能把你永远留在这里，我大概会忍不住——可总不该把野兽关进笼子。

raw_item.translation: 有些旅人在他房子附近的森林里扎了营。我们跟他们打了一场，但被打败了。他们准是出于怨恨杀了格里穆尔夫。

source: Some travellers had made camp in the forest near his house. We fought them, but were beaten. They must have killed Grimulfr out of spite.
translation: 有些旅人在他房子附近的森林里扎了营。我们跟他们打了一场，但被打败了。他们准是出于怨恨杀了格里穆尔夫。

raw_item.translation: 希望你对这笔交易满意。还有别的事吗？

source: I hope you're happy with the trade. Will there be anything else?
translation: 希望你对这笔交易满意。还有别的事吗？

raw_item.translation: 那你可要小心点，如果你打算去跟他们当面对质。

source: Be careful then, if you plan to confront them.
translation: 那你可要小心点，如果你打算去跟他们当面对质。

raw_item.translation: 我们跟斯卡基一伙。是他派我们带信来的。

source: We're with Skakki. He sent us here with a message.
translation: 我们跟斯卡基一伙。是他派我们带信来的。

raw_item.translation: 莫坎特回到原位又跪了下来。你转身走开时，只听见他祷告的头几个神秘字眼。

source: Morcant returns to his spot and kneels again. You catch the first few mysterious words of his prayers as you walk away.
translation: 莫坎特回到原位又跪了下来。你转身走开时，只听见他祷告的头几个神秘字眼。

raw_item.translation: 把所有人召集起来。确保每个人都平安无事，一个不少。

source: Gather all our people. Make sure everyone is safe and accounted for.
translation: 把所有人召集起来。确保每个人都平安无事，一个不少。

raw_item.translation: 老妇人打量着你，眼里带着几分估量。你在诺森布里亚的声望也许能让你在讨价还价时占些上风。

source: The old woman looks at you with evaluation in her eyes. Your reputation across Northumbria may give you an edge in the haggling.
translation: 老妇人打量着你，眼里带着几分估量。你在诺森布里亚的声望也许能让你在讨价还价时占些上风。

raw_item.translation: 我来自阿格德尔，那是北方诸国里离你家乡最近的一个——至少我是这么听说的。

source: I hail from Agder, the closest of the northern kingdoms to where you're from - or so I've heard.
translation: 我来自阿格德尔，那是北方诸国里离你家乡最近的一个——至少我是这么听说的。

raw_item.translation: 奥丁之门

source: Odinn's Door
translation: 奥丁之门

raw_item.translation: 凯蒂尔装作全神贯注于早上的杂活，但你瞥见他脸上掠过一丝笑意。

source: Ketill feigns intense focus on his morning chores, but you glimpse a smile on his face.
translation: 凯蒂尔装作全神贯注于早上的杂活，但你瞥见他脸上掠过一丝笑意。

raw_item.translation: 没人质疑你的战斗本领，[P1]，我们只是在履行戈德威夫在这桩约定里该做的那一份！

source: No-one is questioning your combat prowess [Player:Hlaford/Hlafdia], we're simply upholding Godwif's side of your arrangement!
translation: 没人质疑你的战斗本领，[Player:Hlaford/Hlafdia]，我们只是在履行戈德威夫在这桩约定里该做的那一份！

raw_item.translation: 我们只是来取你的财宝。乖乖躲在这儿别动，你或许还能活命。

source: We're just here for your treasure. Stay hidden here, and you may live.
translation: 我们只是来取你的财宝。乖乖躲在这儿别动，你或许还能活命。

raw_item.translation: 那个拦路强盗——你能跟我说说吗？

source: That highwayman - what can you tell me?
translation: 那个拦路强盗——你能跟我说说吗？

raw_item.translation: 内夫娅站起身，在束腰外衣上擦了擦手。她看上去忧心忡忡。

source: Nefja stands up and brushes her hands on her tunic. She looks worried.
translation: 内夫娅站起身，在束腰外衣上擦了擦手。她看上去忧心忡忡。

raw_item.translation: 约斯泰因，[P1]你[P2]是哪儿的人？

source: Where are [i]you[/i] from, Josteinn?
translation: 约斯泰因，[i]你[/i]是哪儿的人？

raw_item.translation: 和哈尔夫丹谈谈。

source: Speak with Halfdanr.
translation: 和哈尔夫丹谈谈。

raw_item.translation: 屋里被弄得一团糟，所有家具都被掀翻或弄倒，没一件好好立着。

source: The house is trashed, all furniture upturned or tipped over in some way.
translation: 屋里被弄得一团糟，所有家具都被掀翻或弄倒，没一件好好立着。

raw_item.translation: 你想悄悄把货揣进兜里，可摊位上的孩子当场逮住了你。

source: You try to pocket the goods discretely, but the kid in the stall catches you in the act.
translation: 你想悄悄把货揣进兜里，可摊位上的孩子当场逮住了你。

raw_item.translation: 这下可有好戏看了。

source: This should be interesting.
translation: 这下可有好戏看了。

raw_item.translation: 您真是宽宏大量，陛下。我一定尽心竭力为您效劳。

source: You are most gracious, your majesty. I will endeavour to serve you well.
translation: 您真是宽宏大量，陛下。我一定尽心竭力为您效劳。

raw_item.translation: 是的，他确实说了。我们要在附近的一片林间空地跟他碰头。

source: Yes he did. We're to meet him in a glade nearby.
translation: 是的，他确实说了。我们要在附近的一片林间空地跟他碰头。

raw_item.translation: 他重重坐了下去，移开了视线。

source: He sinks hard and averts his eyes.
translation: 他重重坐了下去，移开了视线。

raw_item.translation: 谢谢您，陛下。全靠[P1]，我才能走到这里。

source: Thank you, your majesty. It's only thanks to [Player:Name] that I made it here.
translation: 谢谢您，陛下。全靠[Player:Name]，我才能走到这里。

raw_item.translation: 这里就行——我们避开了旁人的窥探，而且这座旧堡垒的墙壁也给我们的会面添了几分分量，你不觉得吗？

source: This will do - we're away from prying eyes, and the walls of the old fortress lend some weight to our meeting, wouldn't you agree?
translation: 这里就行——我们避开了旁人的窥探，而且这座旧堡垒的墙壁也给我们的会面添了几分分量，你不觉得吗？

raw_item.translation: 怎么？我说话结巴了吗？

source: Well? Did I stutter?
translation: 怎么？我说话结巴了吗？

raw_item.translation: 你回来了。有什么消息吗？

source: So you returned. Any news?
translation: 你回来了。有什么消息吗？

raw_item.translation: 谢谢你……他不会走太远的。只要他没受伤就好……

source: Thank you... he wouldn't have gone too far from here. As long as he is not hurt...
translation: 谢谢你……他不会走太远的。只要他没受伤就好……

raw_item.translation: 地方这么窄，打得倒是挺凶。想不想趁他们还没发现我们，先干掉几个？

source: That's a big fight for such cramped quarters. Want to try picking a few of them off before they know we're here?
translation: 地方这么窄，打得倒是挺凶。想不想趁他们还没发现我们，先干掉几个？

raw_item.translation: 那就打一架，谁赢了归谁！

source: Fight you for it!
translation: 那就打一架，谁赢了归谁！

raw_item.translation: 确实——斯凯恩只须向征召军提供一艘满员战船，这显然不成问题。请——别再试图搅乱这场会议了！

source: Indeed - Skjern is only obliged to contribute one fully crewed ship to the leidangr army, and that's clearly no problem. Please - no more attempts to derail these proceedings!
translation: 确实——斯凯恩只须向征召军提供一艘满员战船，这显然不成问题。请——别再试图搅乱这场会议了！

raw_item.translation: 趁那对恋人完全听不见，艾芙悄悄凑到你身边。

source: Aife sidles up to you while you're well out of earshot of the lovebirds.
translation: 趁那对恋人完全听不见，艾芙悄悄凑到你身边。

raw_item.translation: 你？我们的[P1]？皮克特人既骄傲又强悍！你坐在考斯坦丁的王位上撑不过[P2]一周[P3]。

source: You? Our [Player:king/queen]? The Picts are a proud and strong people! You wouldn't last a [i]week[/i] on Caustantin's throne.
translation: 你？我们的[Player:king/queen]？皮克特人既骄傲又强悍！你坐在考斯坦丁的王位上撑不过[i]一周[/i]。

raw_item.translation: 他们年纪够大了，我不在时能照看农场——要是出了麻烦，还有他们的姑母和叔祖帮忙。

source: They're old enough to look after the farm in my absence - and they've got their aunt and grand-uncle to help them if there's trouble.
translation: 他们年纪够大了，我不在时能照看农场——要是出了麻烦，还有他们的姑母和叔祖帮忙。

raw_item.translation: 我们击溃了主力，但他们的领袖绕到后面，从东边偷偷溜了进来。我们在长屋外逮住了他，他手里还攥着抢来的东西。

source: We beat the main force, but their leader had circled around and snuck in from the east. We caught him outside the longhouse, loot in hand.
translation: 我们击溃了主力，但他们的领袖绕到后面，从东边偷偷溜了进来。我们在长屋外逮住了他，他手里还攥着抢来的东西。

raw_item.translation: 随后她又把注意力转回你身上。

source: Then she returns her attention to you.
translation: 随后她又把注意力转回你身上。

raw_item.translation: 那是……一段很私人的往事。也许有一天我会讲给你听。

source: That's... a very personal story. Perhaps I'll tell you one day.
translation: 那是……一段很私人的往事。也许有一天我会讲给你听。

raw_item.translation: 唉，我们这是自己撞枪口上了。

source: Well, we walked right into that one.
translation: 唉，我们这是自己撞枪口上了。

raw_item.translation: 考斯坦丁仍在艰难地统一各氏族，并与达尔里阿达缔结同盟，但皮克特兰已经构成了迫在眉睫的威胁。

source: Caustantin is still struggling to unite the clans and forge an alliance with Dal Riata, but already Pictland poses a looming threat.
translation: 考斯坦丁仍在艰难地统一各氏族，并与达尔里阿达缔结同盟，但皮克特兰已经构成了迫在眉睫的威胁。

raw_item.translation: 他把它当掉了。

source: He pawned it.
translation: 他把它当掉了。

raw_item.translation: 我想在出发前跟她寻个快活。

source: I think I might have my way with her before we depart.
translation: 我想在出发前跟她寻个快活。

raw_item.translation: 不成。没有你的帮忙，我们自己也能应付。

source: No deal. We'll make do without your help.
translation: 不成。没有你的帮忙，我们自己也能应付。

raw_item.translation: 这船确实漂亮。托尔芬的手艺为我们所有人争了光。

source: It's a beautiful ship indeed. Torfinn's craftsmanship has brought honour to us all.
translation: 这船确实漂亮。托尔芬的手艺为我们所有人争了光。

raw_item.translation: 铲子

source: Shovel
translation: 铲子

raw_item.translation: 无法无天的女巫

source: Lawless Witch
translation: 无法无天的女巫

raw_item.translation: 一套出奇坚固的护甲，由已治愈的兽皮制成。能很好地抵御刀剑和长矛，但面对箭头就没什么用了。

source: A suit of surprisingly sturdy armour made of cured hide. Designed to protect well against blades and spears, but won't help much against an arrowhead.
translation: 一套出奇坚固的护甲，由已治愈的兽皮制成。能很好地抵御刀剑和长矛，但面对箭头就没什么用了。

raw_item.translation: 是的，我明白了。我有充分的证据证明你们是个贪婪的民族。一个[P1]残忍[P2]的民族，对他人的苦难漠不关心。我只希望在我死后，我的同胞还能继续和你们战斗下去。

source: Yes, I understand. I have ample evidence that yours is a greedy people. A [i]cruel[/i] people with no concern for others. I can only hope that my countrymen will keep fighting you long after I'm dead.
translation: 是的，我明白了。我有充分的证据证明你们是个贪婪的民族。一个[i]残忍[/i]的民族，对他人的苦难漠不关心。我只希望在我死后，我的同胞还能继续和你们战斗下去。

raw_item.translation: 他们争吵哪座山丘更合适。争吵中，杀人凶手罗慕路斯杀死了他的兄弟。随后他建立了罗马城，而罗马城孕育了建造这些城墙的罗马帝国。

source: They quarrelled over which hill was best suited. During the quarrel, Romulus the murderer killed his brother. Then he founded the city of Rome, which gave birth to the Empire that built these walls.
translation: 他们争吵哪座山丘更合适。争吵中，杀人凶手罗慕路斯杀死了他的兄弟。随后他建立了罗马城，而罗马城孕育了建造这些城墙的罗马帝国。

raw_item.translation: 英灵战士冲锋

source: Charge of the Einherjar
translation: 英灵战士冲锋

raw_item.translation: 你一直没解释我父亲是怎么死的。

source: You never explained how my father died.
translation: 你一直没解释我父亲是怎么死的。

raw_item.translation: {Kill him.}很好。

source: {Kill him.} Very well.
translation: {Kill him.}很好。

raw_item.translation: 不过另一方面，过去这里作为会面地点倒也算有点用处。也许可以把它变成我们自己的地方议会——这肯定能给那些偏远家族传递一个好信号。

source: On the other hand, it's been sort of useful as a meeting place in the past. Perhaps it could be turned into a landsmoot of our own - it would certainly send a good signal to the outlying families.
translation: 不过另一方面，过去这里作为会面地点倒也算有点用处。也许可以把它变成我们自己的地方议会——这肯定能给那些偏远家族传递一个好信号。

raw_item.translation: 我们得赶紧离开这儿！再这么吵下去，连自己都救不了！

source: We need to get out of here fast! We won't even save ourselves if we keep bickering!
translation: 我们得赶紧离开这儿！再这么吵下去，连自己都救不了！

raw_item.translation: 巨魔树疗剂

source: Troll Tree Remedy
translation: 巨魔树疗剂

raw_item.translation: 战士小心地把装备放在旁边一根木头上，抽出斧头，动起手来。活儿干得很快，但看着并不好受。等他做完，格雷蒂尔身上已经没留下任何能辨认身份的特征了。

source: The warrior carefully places his equipment on a nearby log, draws his axe, and gets to work. It's quick, but it's not pleasant to watch. When he's done, there are no identifying marks left on Grettir's body.
translation: 战士小心地把装备放在旁边一根木头上，抽出斧头，动起手来。活儿干得很快，但看着并不好受。等他做完，格雷蒂尔身上已经没留下任何能辨认身份的特征了。

raw_item.translation: 两名商人和几个雇来的守卫在小村外围一片刚砍倒的树之间搭了个小营地。

source: Two traders and a couple of hired guards have made a small camp among some recently felled trees on the outskirts of the hamlet.
translation: 两名商人和几个雇来的守卫在小村外围一片刚砍倒的树之间搭了个小营地。

raw_item.translation: 我肯定很快还会再来的。

source: I'm sure I'll be around again soon.
translation: 我肯定很快还会再来的。

raw_item.translation: 那些偷东西的哈夫丹家族又想夺走我们仅剩的一点东西。又来！

source: Those thieving Halfdansons are trying to take away what little we have. Again!
translation: 那些偷东西的哈夫丹家族又想夺走我们仅剩的一点东西。又来！

raw_item.translation: 他费了一会儿劲，想找个法子解释清楚。

source: He struggles for a moment to think of a way to explain it.
translation: 他费了一会儿劲，想找个法子解释清楚。

raw_item.translation: 我想我很久以前可能跟我父亲来过这里。

source: I think I may have come here with my father a long time ago.
translation: 我想我很久以前可能跟我父亲来过这里。

raw_item.translation: 唯一活着撑下来的那个兄弟慢慢站起身。他望着死去的兄弟们，眼中满是茫然的震惊。

source: The only brother who made it through alive is slowly getting to his feet. He looks at his dead brothers with distant shock in his eyes.
translation: 唯一活着撑下来的那个兄弟慢慢站起身。他望着死去的兄弟们，眼中满是茫然的震惊。

raw_item.translation: 你是马格努斯·凯尔坦之子吗？

source: Are you Magnus mac Certain?
translation: 你是马格努斯·凯尔坦之子吗？

raw_item.translation: 回到莫科林的房子里找他领取报酬。

source: Return to Maucolyn in his house to collect your reward.
translation: 回到莫科林的房子里找他领取报酬。

raw_item.translation: 我保证会把你女儿完好无损地带回家。

source: I'll bring your daughter home in good condition, I promise.
translation: 我保证会把你女儿完好无损地带回家。

raw_item.translation: 那么，恕我失陪，我得走了。还有职责在身。

source: Now if you'll forgive me, I must take my leave. My duties await.
translation: 那么，恕我失陪，我得走了。还有职责在身。

raw_item.translation: 说实话，我觉得我们的族人几乎和我一样松了一口气，因为你接下了这个担子。

source: To tell you the truth, I think our clansmen are almost as relieved as I am that you took on the mantle.
translation: 说实话，我觉得我们的族人几乎和我一样松了一口气，因为你接下了这个担子。

raw_item.translation: 守卫把手按在武器柄上。商人紧张起来。

source: The guard puts a hand on the hilt of his weapon. The trader tenses.
translation: 守卫把手按在武器柄上。商人紧张起来。

raw_item.translation: 我先从加固我们的防御开始。

source: I'll start by expanding our defences.
translation: 我先从加固我们的防御开始。

raw_item.translation: 够了！放他走。

source: Enough! Let him go.
translation: 够了！放他走。

raw_item.translation: 去霍尔姆冈岛与阿斯莱夫决斗。

source: Meet Asleifr for your duel on Holmgang Island.
translation: 去霍尔姆冈岛与阿斯莱夫决斗。

raw_item.translation: 你别也跟着扯这些迷信的鬼话。

source: Don't you start with this superstitious rubbish too.
translation: 你别也跟着扯这些迷信的鬼话。

raw_item.translation: 进入约克时，你有一种强烈的似曾相识之感。你面前站着一群武装人员，打着奥斯雷德国王二世的旗号。

source: Entering Eoforwic, you experience a strong sense of deja vu. Before you stands a group of armed men bearing the colours of King Osred II.
translation: 进入约克时，你有一种强烈的似曾相识之感。你面前站着一群武装人员，打着奥斯雷德国王二世的旗号。

raw_item.translation: 呃，这个……很抱歉你有这种感受。我猜你不会来看看我卖的东西了？

source: Well, uhm... sorry you feel that way. I guess you won't be taking a look at what I'm selling then?
translation: 呃，这个……很抱歉你有这种感受。我猜你不会来看看我卖的东西了？

raw_item.translation: 最好这是我最后一次见到你的家人。

source: This had better be the last I see of your family.
translation: 最好这是我最后一次见到你的家人。

raw_item.translation: 妈妈的农场真该好好打理一下了。栅栏有两处都坏了！原牛居然还没跑出去，真是奇迹。

source: Mom's farm could really use some love. The fence is broken in two places! It's a wonder the aurochs haven't wandered out yet.
translation: 妈妈的农场真该好好打理一下了。栅栏有两处都坏了！原牛居然还没跑出去，真是奇迹。

raw_item.translation: 盟友？那我们为自己在这片土地上打下一块地盘的事怎么办？

source: Allies? What happened to carving out a piece of this land for ourselves?
translation: 盟友？那我们为自己在这片土地上打下一块地盘的事怎么办？

raw_item.translation: 哦，我亲爱的[P1]。你竟要问这个，真让我难过。德鲁伊曾是所有这些土地的统治者，如果我没记错的话，也是你们土地的统治者！不过话说回来，这也不能排除……

source: Oh, my dear [Player:lad/lass]. It pains me that you must ask. The druids used to be the rulers of all these lands, and yours too if I'm not mistaken! Which should not be ruled out, mind you...
translation: 哦，我亲爱的[Player:lad/lass]。你竟要问这个，真让我难过。德鲁伊曾是所有这些土地的统治者，如果我没记错的话，也是你们土地的统治者！不过话说回来，这也不能排除……

raw_item.translation: 既然你找到了更多这种石头，也许可以再试着翻译一下。

source: Now that you've found more of these stones, you might take another stab at the translation.
translation: 既然你找到了更多这种石头，也许可以再试着翻译一下。

raw_item.translation: {Leave.}

source: {Leave.}
translation: {Leave.}

raw_item.translation: 欢迎！欢迎！很高兴你能来，毕竟你可是贵宾之一！

source: Welcome! Welcome! Glad you made it, you are after all among the guests of honour!
translation: 欢迎！欢迎！很高兴你能来，毕竟你可是贵宾之一！

raw_item.translation: 她张开双臂，朝房间两侧的两座神龛比了比。

source: She opens her arms in a gesture that encompasses the two shrines at the sides of the room.
translation: 她张开双臂，朝房间两侧的两座神龛比了比。

raw_item.translation: {Accept deal.} 这看起来挺公道。

source: {Accept deal.} That seems fair.
translation: {Accept deal.} 这看起来挺公道。

raw_item.translation: 又多了一个理由，说明你不配当我们的领主。

source: Yet another reason why you do not deserve to be our thegn.
translation: 又多了一个理由，说明你不配当我们的领主。

raw_item.translation: 木雕人偶

source: Wood Figurine
translation: 木雕人偶

raw_item.translation: 你父亲知道你在这儿败坏他的名声吗？

source: Does your father know you're here, destroying his name?
translation: 你父亲知道你在这儿败坏他的名声吗？

raw_item.translation: 让我告诉你我需要什么。

source: Let me tell you what I need.
translation: 让我告诉你我需要什么。

raw_item.translation: [P1]打了个嗝，晃了晃身子，随即猛地挣扎着要从桌边脱身。[P3]勉强挪了几步，便弯下腰干呕起来，吐出一滩散发着恶臭的胆汁和残渣。

source: [Eater:Name]'s hiccups, sways for a moment, and then suddenly scrambles frantically to disentangle [Eater:him/her]self from the table. [Eater:He/She] Manages a few steps before doubling over and retching, spilling sick in a stinking puddle of bile and and reeking mush.
translation: [Eater:Name]打了个嗝，晃了晃身子，随即猛地挣扎着要从桌边脱身。[Eater:He/She]勉强挪了几步，便弯下腰干呕起来，吐出一滩散发着恶臭的胆汁和残渣。

raw_item.translation: 听好了，神父。[P1]你[P2]请我们来的。我们来这儿是为了保护你免受异教徒侵扰，我们只关心这个。

source: Listen here, Father. [i]You[/i] asked us to be here. We came to protect you from the heathens, and that's our only concern.
translation: 听好了，神父。[i]你[/i]请我们来的。我们来这儿是为了保护你免受异教徒侵扰，我们只关心这个。

raw_item.translation: 德鲁伊重重地叹了口气。

source: The druid sighs heavily.
translation: 德鲁伊重重地叹了口气。

raw_item.translation: 尽管风浪考验着你的长船，但它的容量高于同等大小的多数船只，所以一切都安然无恙。风暴平息后，似乎没有任何东西被大海夺走。

source: Although the waters test your longship, having a higher capacity than most ships its equal, everything stays in place. As the storm subsides, nothing appears to have been lost to the sea.
translation: 尽管风浪考验着你的长船，但它的容量高于同等大小的多数船只，所以一切都安然无恙。风暴平息后，似乎没有任何东西被大海夺走。

raw_item.translation: 这又是怎么回事？

source: What's all this now?
translation: 这又是怎么回事？

raw_item.translation: 唉，她……今天不怎么清醒。我算是没告诉她我要走。

source: Oh, she's... not really there today. I kind of didn't tell her I was leaving.
translation: 唉，她……今天不怎么清醒。我算是没告诉她我要走。

raw_item.translation: 我们确实在英吉尔森林之战中为埃塞尔雷德作战。他给我们的报酬很丰厚。

source: We did fight for Æthelred in the battle of Yngilwood. He paid us well for our services.
translation: 我们确实在英吉尔森林之战中为埃塞尔雷德作战。他给我们的报酬很丰厚。

raw_item.translation: 你把他撂倒在地离开时，诺森布里亚国王在你身后骂骂咧咧，满口恶言。等战斗结束后，得由别人来决定怎么处置他。

source: The King of Northumbria splutters curses and invective after you as you leave him on the floor. Someone else must decide what to do with him when the fighting is over.
translation: 你把他撂倒在地离开时，诺森布里亚国王在你身后骂骂咧咧，满口恶言。等战斗结束后，得由别人来决定怎么处置他。

raw_item.translation: 墙的问题，对。

source: The wall problem, aye.
translation: 墙的问题，对。

raw_item.translation: 你说得对，但我不想冒任何风险。

source: You're right, but I'm not taking any chances.
translation: 你说得对，但我不想冒任何风险。

raw_item.translation: 这地方有什么让你不安的？

source: What about this place bothers you?
translation: 这地方有什么让你不安的？

raw_item.translation: 后面那个身材高大、体格结实的男子把手搭在矮个男子的肩上。

source: The tall, densely built man in the back puts a hand on the shorter man's shoulder.
translation: 后面那个身材高大、体格结实的男子把手搭在矮个男子的肩上。

raw_item.translation: 我们是饿着肚子的旅人。你有鱼卖吗？

source: We are hungry travellers. Do you have fish to sell?
translation: 我们是饿着肚子的旅人。你有鱼卖吗？

raw_item.translation: 我明白——这本来就是个疯狂的主意。祝你明天在外头好运。

source: I understand - it was a crazy idea anyway. I wish you luck out there tomorrow.
translation: 我明白——这本来就是个疯狂的主意。祝你明天在外头好运。

raw_item.translation: 你的亲卫队成员阴沉地笑了笑。

source: Your hirdmen chuckle darkly.
translation: 你的亲卫队成员阴沉地笑了笑。

raw_item.translation: 我发誓——以奥丁之名！

source: I swear it - by Odinn!
translation: 我发誓——以奥丁之名！

raw_item.translation: 还没等泪水夺眶而出，他就拿起一把铲子，动手挖起那男孩的坟来。

source: Before the tears get the better of him, he picks up a shovel and gets to work digging the boy's grave.
translation: 还没等泪水夺眶而出，他就拿起一把铲子，动手挖起那男孩的坟来。

raw_item.translation: 艾布琳笑了。

source: Aiblinn laughs.
translation: 艾布琳笑了。

raw_item.translation: 不够好，抱歉。

source: Not good enough, sorry.
translation: 不够好，抱歉。

raw_item.translation: 要是有需要，我会回来的。

source: I'll be back if I need anything.
translation: 要是有需要，我会回来的。

raw_item.translation: 揍那帮乳臭未干的软蛋，我揍得挺过瘾。他们要是再回来，我很乐意再揍一遍。

source: I enjoyed beating up those fresh-faced milksops. I would gladly do it again were they to return.
translation: 揍那帮乳臭未干的软蛋，我揍得挺过瘾。他们要是再回来，我很乐意再揍一遍。

raw_item.translation: 想通了这一点，你或许就找到了知足常乐的关键。

source: In that realisation, you just may have found the key to contentment.
translation: 想通了这一点，你或许就找到了知足常乐的关键。

raw_item.translation: 捕网陷阱

source: Net Trap
translation: 捕网陷阱

raw_item.translation: 被你搜刮一番后，草药园看上去大不如前。剩下的草药东一块西一块，乱糟糟的。没人照管的话，它们多半会枯萎。

source: The herb garden looks worse for wear after you raided it. The remains are patchy and messed. Without tending, they will likely wither.
translation: 被你搜刮一番后，草药园看上去大不如前。剩下的草药东一块西一块，乱糟糟的。没人照管的话，它们多半会枯萎。

raw_item.translation: 你在这儿住得还习惯吗？

source: Are you settling in here?
translation: 你在这儿住得还习惯吗？

raw_item.translation: {看住奴隶。}我们不能让那些囚犯受到伤害。

source: {Secure the thralls.} We can't let those prisoners come to harm.
translation: {看住奴隶。}我们不能让那些囚犯受到伤害。

raw_item.translation: 他那坚定不移的威严神色，短暂地动摇了一下。

source: His expression of unwavering authority briefly wavers.
translation: 他那坚定不移的威严神色，短暂地动摇了一下。

raw_item.translation: 我会想办法弄到一些毒药，然后就回来。

source: I'll try to get a hold of some poison, then I'll be back.
translation: 我会想办法弄到一些毒药，然后就回来。

raw_item.translation: [P1]伸长[P2]脖子，打量悬崖上方那座石砌建筑。

source: [Greedy:Name] cranes [Greedy:his/her] neck to take in the stone building above the cliffs.
translation: [Greedy:Name]伸长[Greedy:his/her]脖子，打量悬崖上方那座石砌建筑。

raw_item.translation: 沿北方道路旅行的旅人是这么说的。诺斯人趁夜发动了袭击，但据说烽火没有点起来！

source: So say reports from travellers along the road north. Northmen struck at night, but they say the beacons weren't lit!
translation: 沿北方道路旅行的旅人是这么说的。诺斯人趁夜发动了袭击，但据说烽火没有点起来！

raw_item.translation: 我们把营地拿下了。快走吧，你们自由了。

source: We've taken out the camp. Leave quickly, you're free.
translation: 我们把营地拿下了。快走吧，你们自由了。

raw_item.translation: 想打倒阿斯莱夫，光靠一个老太婆的汤药可不够。

source: It'll take more than an old hag's brew to beat Asleifr.
translation: 想打倒阿斯莱夫，光靠一个老太婆的汤药可不够。

raw_item.translation: 前往奥克尼群岛，与斯卡拉格里姆谈谈。

source: Travel to Orkneyjar and speak to Skallagrimr.
translation: 前往奥克尼群岛，与斯卡拉格里姆谈谈。

raw_item.translation: 皮克特人打得不错，但根本不是我们的对手！

source: The Picts fought well, but they were no match for us!
translation: 皮克特人打得不错，但根本不是我们的对手！

raw_item.translation: 格里穆尔夫还在那儿一下一下地修那道栅栏。

source: Grimulfr is still hammering away at that fence.
translation: 格里穆尔夫还在那儿一下一下地修那道栅栏。

raw_item.translation: 你的防御工事要想挡住长船，可差得太远了。

source: Your defences are woefully inadequate to stop a longship.
translation: 你的防御工事要想挡住长船，可差得太远了。

raw_item.translation: 他对这个世界的看法软弱又可悲。我毫不怀疑，一旦你决定对诺森布里亚动手，他会立刻背叛我们。

source: His view of the world is meak and pathetic. I have no doubt he'll turn on us in a heartbeat if you decide to act against Northumbria.
translation: 他对这个世界的看法软弱又可悲。我毫不怀疑，一旦你决定对诺森布里亚动手，他会立刻背叛我们。

raw_item.translation: 你得到的唯一反应就是一个礼貌的微笑。

source: A polite smile is the only reaction you get.
translation: 你得到的唯一反应就是一个礼貌的微笑。

raw_item.translation: 全都拿走。我们会想办法神不知鬼不觉地把东西运出去。

source: Take everything. We'll find ways to sneak it out of here unnoticed.
translation: 全都拿走。我们会想办法神不知鬼不觉地把东西运出去。

raw_item.translation: 你母亲露出一抹悲伤的微笑。

source: Your mother smiles sadly.
translation: 你母亲露出一抹悲伤的微笑。

raw_item.translation: {捅她一刀。}我可没有。

source: {Stab her.} Well I'm not.
translation: {捅她一刀。}我可没有。

raw_item.translation: {抛出绳索。}

source: {Throw rope.}
translation: {抛出绳索。}

raw_item.translation: 什么？！你怎么回事？！

source: What?! What's wrong with you?!
translation: 什么？！你怎么回事？！

raw_item.translation: 我会回去找其他人，把发生的事告诉他们。我们会把你从那里救出来，我保证。

source: I'll travel back to the others and let them know what's happened.  We'll get you out of there, I promise.
translation: 我会回去找其他人，把发生的事告诉他们。我们会把你从那里救出来，我保证。

raw_item.translation: 在此集结的军队，在北海无人能敌。

source: The army assembled here is without peer on the North Sea.
translation: 在此集结的军队，在北海无人能敌。

raw_item.translation: 主与你们同在，陌生人。我是莫坎特修士。我毕生都在钻研上帝造物那难以言喻的美。

source: Dominus vobiscum, stranger. I am brother Morcant. I have given my life to studying the ineffible beauty of God's work.
translation: 主与你们同在，陌生人。我是莫坎特修士。我毕生都在钻研上帝造物那难以言喻的美。

raw_item.translation: 你听我说，这可不是我自愿的。他们来了以后就把我抢得一干二净——哦，当然不算抢劫，康纳尔是“国王”什么的，但结果都一样：我的麦酒全没了，现在我自家人都在挨饿。

source: Not by choice, mind you. They've been robbing me blind since they came here - oh it's not robbery of course, Conall being "king" and such, but the end result is all my ale's gone and now my own family's going hungry.
translation: 你听我说，这可不是我自愿的。他们来了以后就把我抢得一干二净——哦，当然不算抢劫，康纳尔是“国王”什么的，但结果都一样：我的麦酒全没了，现在我自家人都在挨饿。

raw_item.translation: 奥德凯尔……

source: Oddkell...
translation: 奥德凯尔……

raw_item.translation: 我甚至和后面沼泽里那位和气的老女巫谈过，想帮她卖些她配的药。

source: I've even talked to that lovely old witch in the bog back there, about the possibility of selling some of her medicinal remedies for her.
translation: 我甚至和后面沼泽里那位和气的老女巫谈过，想帮她卖些她配的药。

raw_item.translation: 随时乐意效劳！今天就这些了？

source: Always a pleasure! Will that be all for today?
translation: 随时乐意效劳！今天就这些了？

raw_item.translation: 看来我们彼此心照不宣了。

source: Sounds like we understand each other.
translation: 看来我们彼此心照不宣了。

raw_item.translation: 拿着这个。

source: Take this.
translation: 拿着这个。

raw_item.translation: 带上这个，用它向你遇到的人传播上帝之道。哦，还有，你可以告诉埃塞尔雷德，我会支持他争夺王冠——前提是他能赢下来。

source: Carry this with you, and use it to spread the Word of God to those you meet. Oh, and you may tell Æthelred that I will support his claim to the crown - if he can win it.
translation: 带上这个，用它向你遇到的人传播上帝之道。哦，还有，你可以告诉埃塞尔雷德，我会支持他争夺王冠——前提是他能赢下来。

raw_item.translation: 她看上去和那些孩子哪个都不像。这会不会是武器师傅的女儿？

source: She doesn't look related to any of those kids. Could this be the arms master's daughter?
translation: 她看上去和那些孩子哪个都不像。这会不会是武器师傅的女儿？

raw_item.translation: 过了好一会儿才清点完毕，但似乎什么都没少。

source: It takes a while before everything is accounted for, but nothing seems to be missing.
translation: 过了好一会儿才清点完毕，但似乎什么都没少。

raw_item.translation: 她嘴角浮起一丝犹疑的微笑。

source: An uncertain smile crosses her lips.
translation: 她嘴角浮起一丝犹疑的微笑。

raw_item.translation: 谢谢您，陛下。能来到这里是我的莫大荣幸。

source: Thank you, your majesty. It's a great privilege to be here.
translation: 谢谢您，陛下。能来到这里是我的莫大荣幸。

raw_item.translation: 得了，布鲁诺。好好想想……

source: Come now, Bruno. Think this through...
translation: 得了，布鲁诺。好好想想……

raw_item.translation: {选一个人来把它割掉。}

source: {Choose someone to cut it out.}
translation: {选一个人来把它割掉。}

raw_item.translation: 我一直以为……我会死得……有意义……

source: I always thought... I would die... for a purpose...
translation: 我一直以为……我会死得……有意义……

raw_item.translation: 我去问问胡尔达。也许她知道该怎么治。

source: I'll ask Hulda about this. Perhaps she has some idea how to treat it.
translation: 我去问问胡尔达。也许她知道该怎么治。

raw_item.translation: 啊，太久没弄了。希望我还记得。你想知道什么？

source: Ah, been so long. Hope I can remember. What do you need to know?
translation: 啊，太久没弄了。希望我还记得。你想知道什么？

raw_item.translation: 你要让那个投毒者加入我们？

source: You're letting the poisoner join us?
translation: 你要让那个投毒者加入我们？

raw_item.translation: 他眨了眨眼。

source: He winks.
translation: 他眨了眨眼。

raw_item.translation: 他傲慢地扬起下巴。

source: He raises his chin haughtily.
translation: 他傲慢地扬起下巴。

raw_item.translation: 那年轻男子似乎吃了一惊，神色紧张起来。

source: The young man seems taken aback, a nervous look falling over him.
translation: 那年轻男子似乎吃了一惊，神色紧张起来。

raw_item.translation: 你还是个年轻的[P1]，[P2]——心急又没耐性。等你年纪大了就会明白，有些事急不得。

source: You're a young [Player:man/woman], [Player:Name] - eager and impatient. One thing you learn with age is that some things should not be rushed.
translation: 你还是个年轻的[Player:man/woman]，[Player:Name]——心急又没耐性。等你年纪大了就会明白，有些事急不得。

raw_item.translation: 我正把它放下来呢，你这蠢货。

source: I'm taking it down, you oaf.
translation: 我正把它放下来呢，你这蠢货。

raw_item.translation: 埃迪丝沉重地点了点头。

source: Eydis nods heavily.
translation: 埃迪丝沉重地点了点头。

raw_item.translation: 耐心点，约维塔。

source: Patience, Iovita.
translation: 耐心点，约维塔。

raw_item.translation: 让我给你瞧瞧，我们那儿是怎么收拾劫掠者的。

source: Let me show you what we do to looters in my country.
translation: 让我给你瞧瞧，我们那儿是怎么收拾劫掠者的。

raw_item.translation: 你被召回奥克尼群岛，去见雅尔的副手斯卡拉格里姆。你的作为已引起注意，斯卡拉格里姆前来向你提出一项条件。

source: You are requested to return to Orkneyjar and meet the Jarl's bannerman Skallagrimr. Your progress has not gone unnoticed, and Skallagrimr has come to extend an offer.
translation: 你被召回奥克尼群岛，去见雅尔的副手斯卡拉格里姆。你的作为已引起注意，斯卡拉格里姆前来向你提出一项条件。

raw_item.translation: 一群没用的蠢驴！你们本该是我最好的战士，可你们竟让异教徒劫掠者悄无声息地溜进了我的大厅？！

source: Useless donkeys! You're supposed to be my best soldiers, and yet you let heathen raiders slip undetected into my hall?!
translation: 一群没用的蠢驴！你们本该是我最好的战士，可你们竟让异教徒劫掠者悄无声息地溜进了我的大厅？！

raw_item.translation: 你也该一起加入进攻。我们并肩作战，胜算会大得多。

source: You should join the attack as well. Together we stand a much better chance.
translation: 你也该一起加入进攻。我们并肩作战，胜算会大得多。

raw_item.translation: 返回珀斯，把梅林引见给考斯坦丁。

source: Return to Perth and introduce Myrddin to Caustantin.
translation: 返回珀斯，把梅林引见给考斯坦丁。

raw_item.translation: 多年来我一直渴望来南方低地。如今终于到了这里，而且……说实话，它真没让我失望！

source: I've been aching to come to the lowlands for years. Now I'm finally here, and... well, it actually lives up to expectation!
translation: 多年来我一直渴望来南方低地。如今终于到了这里，而且……说实话，它真没让我失望！

raw_item.translation: 埃里克·血斧（疯狂）

source: Eirikr Blodøx (Insane)
translation: 埃里克·血斧（疯狂）

raw_item.translation: “幸运者”莱夫是一位发现了北美洲的冰岛探险家。尽管他的后继者们在定居上进展不顺，莱夫自己的远征却极为成功而和平。如果你选择此设置，好运也会眷顾你的远征。

source: Leifr "the Lucky" was an Icelandic explorer who discovered North America. Though his successors' attempts to settle went poorly, Leifr's own expeditions were highly successful and peaceful. If you choose this setting, luck will favour your expedition as well.
translation: “幸运者”莱夫是一位发现了北美洲的冰岛探险家。尽管他的后继者们在定居上进展不顺，莱夫自己的远征却极为成功而和平。如果你选择此设置，好运也会眷顾你的远征。

raw_item.translation: “无骨者”伊瓦尔是9世纪末入侵不列颠的大异教徒军领袖之一。如果你选择此设置，你可能会面临重大挑战，但最终很可能获胜。

source: Ivarr "the Boneless" was one of the leaders of the Great Heathen Army that invaded Britain in the late 9th century. If you pick this setting, you may face major challenges, but you are likely to prevail in the end.
translation: “无骨者”伊瓦尔是9世纪末入侵不列颠的大异教徒军领袖之一。如果你选择此设置，你可能会面临重大挑战，但最终很可能获胜。

raw_item.translation: “毛裤”拉格纳尔是一位传奇维京人，曾劫掠并勒索法兰西与英格兰。他赢得了势力和财富，但最终死于敌人之手，落得血腥下场。你将遭遇强烈抵抗，但你的胜利也会因此更加甜蜜。

source: Ragnarr "Shaggy-Breeches" was a legendary Viking who raided and blackmailed France and England. He won power and wealth, but ultimately met a bloody death at the hands of his enemies. You will be met with great resistance, but your victory will be all the sweeter for it.
translation: “毛裤”拉格纳尔是一位传奇维京人，曾劫掠并勒索法兰西与英格兰。他赢得了势力和财富，但最终死于敌人之手，落得血腥下场。你将遭遇强烈抵抗，但你的胜利也会因此更加甜蜜。

raw_item.translation: “血斧”埃里克是一位挪威劫掠者，曾在10世纪短暂统治诺森布里亚，后被背叛并杀害。你不会遇到任何仁慈。你的敌人将坚韧不屈，你的考验将数不胜数。最可能的结果是残酷的失败。

source: Eirikr "Bloodaxe" was a Norwegian raider who briefly ruled Northumbria in the 10th century before he was betrayed and killed. You will find no mercy. Your enemies will be relentless and your trials numerous. Gruelling defeat is the most likely outcome.
translation: “血斧”埃里克是一位挪威劫掠者，曾在10世纪短暂统治诺森布里亚，后被背叛并杀害。你不会遇到任何仁慈。你的敌人将坚韧不屈，你的考验将数不胜数。最可能的结果是残酷的失败。

raw_item.translation: 毒药取自大自然最不讨喜的植物，用来让别人感觉非常糟糕。

translation: 毒药取自大自然最不讨喜的植物，用来让别人感觉非常糟糕。

raw_item.translation: 木杆简简单单，却极其有用，尤其是用来做陷阱。

translation: 木杆简简单单，却极其有用，尤其是用来做陷阱。

translation: 陶罐用来储存液体。它们很脆，一扔就会碎。

raw_item.translation: 药粉用于调制大多数能在战斗中提升表现的药剂。

translation: 药粉用于调制大多数能在战斗中提升表现的药剂。

translation: 绳索用途众多，其中之一就是给你的敌人设下陷阱。

raw_item.translation: 细绳最常用来做衣服，也适用于精细的机关。

translation: 细绳最常用来做衣服，也适用于精细的机关。

raw_item.translation: 松焦油是极佳的木材防腐剂，也是海上用的密封剂。它还烧得挺旺。

source: Pine tar is a great wood preservative and a sealant for maritime use. It also burns quite well.
translation: 松焦油是极佳的木材防腐剂，也是海上用的密封剂。它还烧得挺旺。

raw_item.translation: 小瓶比陶罐结实，能安全地储存少量液体。

translation: 小瓶比陶罐结实，能安全地储存少量液体。

raw_item.translation: 你父亲最后一次航行是前往不列颠群岛。他的船员回来的不到一半。

source: Your father's last journey was bound for the British Isles. Less than half of his crew returned.
translation: 你父亲最后一次航行是前往不列颠群岛。他的船员回来的不到一半。

raw_item.translation: 战斗时要小心避开借机攻击。离开与敌人相邻的六角格，会让那名敌人获得一次免费攻击。

source: Be careful to avoid attacks of opportunity during combat. Moving out of a hex adjacent to an enemy will give that enemy a free attack.
translation: 战斗时要小心避开借机攻击。离开与敌人相邻的六角格，会让那名敌人获得一次免费攻击。

raw_item.translation: 战斗中，你可以按键盘上的数字键来激活/停用技能。

source: In combat, you can activate/deactivate your abilities by pressing the numerical keys on your keyboard.
translation: 战斗中，你可以按键盘上的数字键来激活/停用技能。

raw_item.translation: 交谈时要留意自己的选择，许多选项都会改变你的声望。

source: During conversations, be mindful of your choices, as many options will change your reputation.
translation: 交谈时要留意自己的选择，许多选项都会改变你的声望。

raw_item.translation: 你的亲卫队成员的士气会影响他们的物理抗性和精神抗性，所以尽量让大家都保持愉快。

source: The morale of your hirdmen affects their physical and mental resistances, so try to keep everybody happy.
translation: 你的亲卫队成员的士气会影响他们的物理抗性和精神抗性，所以尽量让大家都保持愉快。

raw_item.translation: 当你的亲卫队成员在战斗中倒地时，他们倒地的时间越长，受伤的风险就越高。

source: When your hirdmen become incapacitated during combat, the longer they stay down, the higher the risk of an injury.
translation: 当你的亲卫队成员在战斗中倒地时，他们倒地的时间越长，受伤的风险就越高。

raw_item.translation: 负伤不会让亲卫队成员无法行动，但他们在战斗内外都会受到惩罚。

source: Sustaining injuries does not put hirdmen out of action, but they will incur penalties in and out of combat.
translation: 负伤不会让亲卫队成员无法行动，但他们在战斗内外都会受到惩罚。

raw_item.translation: 如果在游戏过程中找不到你的角色，按 F 键将镜头对准他们。

source: If you lose track of your characters during gameplay, press F to center the camera on them.
translation: 如果在游戏过程中找不到你的角色，按 F 键将镜头对准他们。

raw_item.translation: 扈从战士就是与你同行、并肩作战的人。而你的侍卫则是那些关系格外亲近、深受你信任的战士。

source: A hirdman is anyone who travels with you and fights beside you. Your huscarls are those especially close and trusted warriors that serve you.
translation: 扈从战士就是与你同行、并肩作战的人。而你的侍卫则是那些关系格外亲近、深受你信任的战士。

raw_item.translation: 装备在战斗中可能会损坏，扎营时需要修理。

source: Equipment can be damaged during combat and will need to be repaired when you make camp.
translation: 装备在战斗中可能会损坏，扎营时需要修理。

raw_item.translation: 侧翼伤害加成会完全无视目标的伤害减免，因此夹击对重甲敌人尤其有效。

source: Flanking bonus damage bypasses the target's Damage Reduction completely, making flanking attacks particularly powerful against well armoured enemies.
translation: 侧翼伤害加成会完全无视目标的伤害减免，因此夹击对重甲敌人尤其有效。

raw_item.translation: 每个角色可以携带两套物品，在攻击前可以自由切换。这对弓箭手尤其重要。

source: Each character can carry two sets of items and can freely switch between them until they attack. This is particularly important for archers.
translation: 每个角色可以携带两套物品，在攻击前可以自由切换。这对弓箭手尤其重要。

raw_item.translation: 旅行需要时间，而时间是一种终将耗尽的资源。请仔细规划你的行程。

source: Travel takes time, and time is a resource that will run out eventually. Plan your travels carefully.
translation: 旅行需要时间，而时间是一种终将耗尽的资源。请仔细规划你的行程。

raw_item.translation: 营地在每次到访之间会保留下来。好好打理你的营地——之后你可能还会用到它。

source: Campsites persist between each visit. Take good care of your camp - you may need to use it again later.
translation: 营地在每次到访之间会保留下来。好好打理你的营地——之后你可能还会用到它。

raw_item.translation: 商人的存货每周会随着新货运抵达而补充。

source: Traders' stocks are replenished every week when a new shipment comes in.
translation: 商人的存货每周会随着新货运抵达而补充。

raw_item.translation: 留意石冢。每找到一处，可获得 1 技能点。

source: Keep an eye out for cairns. Finding them gives you 1 SP each.
translation: 留意石冢。每找到一处，可获得 1 技能点。

raw_item.translation: 基督徒扩张的威胁从南方的法兰克王国逼近丹麦。

source: The threat of Christian expansion encroaches upon Denmark from the Frankish Realm to the south.
translation: 基督徒扩张的威胁从南方的法兰克王国逼近丹麦。

raw_item.translation: 如果需要降低一点挑战性——或者提高一点，你随时可以更改难度。

source: You can change the difficulty at any time if you need a bit less challenge - or a little more.
translation: 如果需要降低一点挑战性——或者提高一点，你随时可以更改难度。

raw_item.translation: 斯堪的纳维亚的异教氏族与不列颠群岛的基督教王国素来鲜有往来……直到如今。

source: The pagan clans of Scandinavia have had little contact with the Christian kingdoms of the British Isles... until now.
translation: 斯堪的纳维亚的异教氏族与不列颠群岛的基督教王国素来鲜有往来……直到如今。

raw_item.translation: “征召军”（leidangr）每4年可征募一次。每个“船区”（skipreida）都必须为征召提供一艘船及船员。

source: The "leidangr" (levy) army can be conscripted every 4 years. Each "skipreida" (ship district) must send one ship with crew for the levy.
translation: “征召军”（leidangr）每4年可征募一次。每个“船区”（skipreida）都必须为征召提供一艘船及船员。

raw_item.translation: 了解你亲卫队成员的强项与弱点。察觉低的人当不好弓箭手。感知低的医者毫无用处。

source: Know the strengths and weaknesses of your hirdmen. Someone with low Perception will make a poor archer. A healer with low Sense is useless.
translation: 了解你亲卫队成员的强项与弱点。察觉低的人当不好弓箭手。感知低的医者毫无用处。

raw_item.translation: 北日耳曼异教信仰中的男性宗教领袖被称为“戈迪祭司”（godi）。与之对应的女性头衔是“女祭司”（gydja）。

source: A male religious leader in the North Germanic pagan faith was called a "godi". The equivalent female title is "gydja".
translation: 北日耳曼异教信仰中的男性宗教领袖被称为“戈迪祭司”（godi）。与之对应的女性头衔是“女祭司”（gydja）。

raw_item.translation: 如果你让左手物品栏空着，你的暴击率将获得3个百分点的加成。

source: If you leave your left-hand item slot empty, you will gain a 3 percent-point bonus to your Critical Chance.
translation: 如果你让左手物品栏空着，你的暴击率将获得3个百分点的加成。

raw_item.translation: 维京长船的特点是吃水浅，这使它们速度极快，能够航行于河流并在海滩登陆。

source: Viking longships were characterised by their shallow draft, which made them very fast and permitted river navigation and beach landings.
translation: 维京长船的特点是吃水浅，这使它们速度极快，能够航行于河流并在海滩登陆。

raw_item.translation: 基督教由罗马人传入不列颠，但在撒克逊人入侵中被摧毁了。格里高利传教团于公元600年前后重新引入了基督教。

source: Christianity was brought to Britain by the Romans, but was destroyed in the Saxon invasions. The Gregorian Mission reintroduced Christianity around 600 AD.
translation: 基督教由罗马人传入不列颠，但在撒克逊人入侵中被摧毁了。格里高利传教团于公元600年前后重新引入了基督教。

raw_item.translation: 敌人会格挡远程攻击的视线。你自己的角色不会互相阻挡攻击。

source: Enemies block line-of-sight for ranged attacks. Your own characters do not block each others' attacks.
translation: 敌人会格挡远程攻击的视线。你自己的角色不会互相阻挡攻击。

raw_item.translation: 100件贵重物品相当于10厄尔图格白银，或5枚盎格鲁-撒克逊便士。

source: 100 Valuables is equivalent to 10 ørtug of silver, or 5 anglo-saxon Pence.
translation: 100件贵重物品相当于10厄尔图格白银，或5枚盎格鲁-撒克逊便士。

raw_item.translation: 双手武器具有攻击距离，让你能接战敌人而不会被他们的借机攻击缠住。

source: Two-handed weapons offer reach, which lets you engage enemies without being trapped by their attack of opportunity.
translation: 双手武器具有攻击距离，让你能接战敌人而不会被他们的借机攻击缠住。

raw_item.translation: 在古诺尔斯语中，“维京人”既指一次远征，也指发起远征的人。所以从某种意义上说，这款游戏叫《远征：远征》。

source: In Old Norse, "viking" was the word for an expedition as well as someone who undertook one. So in a sense, this game is called Expeditions: Expedition.
translation: 在古诺尔斯语中，“维京人”既指一次远征，也指发起远征的人。所以从某种意义上说，这款游戏叫《远征：远征》。

raw_item.translation: 雅尔的势力仅次于国王，也可能受命代其统治。领主是地方的酋长，通常负责一艘船。

source: A jarl is just beneath the king in power, and may be appointed to rule in his place. A thegn is a local chieftain, who often holds responsibility for a ship.
translation: 雅尔的势力仅次于国王，也可能受命代其统治。领主是地方的酋长，通常负责一艘船。

raw_item.translation: 盾女是选择以战士身份作战的女性。尽管名为盾女，她们并不一定持盾。

source: A shieldmaiden is a woman who has chosen to fight as a warrior. Despite the name, they don't necessarily carry shields.
translation: 盾女是选择以战士身份作战的女性。尽管名为盾女，她们并不一定持盾。

raw_item.translation: 标准的远程攻击会施加“受扰”，使目标的伤害减免降低一轮。技能不会使敌人受扰。

source: Standard ranged attacks apply Harried which reduces the target's damage reduction for one round. Abilities do not harry enemies.
translation: 标准的远程攻击会施加“受扰”，使目标的伤害减免降低一轮。技能不会使敌人受扰。

raw_item.translation: 回合结束时仍保有攻击行动（红圈）的角色将进入“稳住”状态，保护他们不被弓箭手施加“受扰”。

source: Any characters who still have their attack action (red ring) when the turn ends will be Steadied, protecting them from being Harried by archers.
translation: 回合结束时仍保有攻击行动（红圈）的角色将进入“稳住”状态，保护他们不被弓箭手施加“受扰”。

raw_item.translation: 战斗中，你可以按 F1 - F12 选择随从。

source: During combat, you can select your followers by pressing F1 - F12
translation: 战斗中，你可以按 F1 - F12 选择随从。

raw_item.translation: 日德兰的领主们将在秋分——9月19日——于阿尔庭议会与西居尔德·环王会面。你必须在那之前达成目标。

source: The thegns of Jutland meet King Sigurdr Hring at the Althing on the autumn equinox - September 19. You must achieve your goals before then.
translation: 日德兰的领主们将在秋分——9月19日——于阿尔庭议会与西居尔德·环王会面。你必须在那之前达成目标。

raw_item.translation: 区域地图

source: Area Map
translation: 区域地图

raw_item.translation: 物品栏

source: Inventory
translation: 物品栏

raw_item.translation: 选项菜单

source: Options Menu
translation: 选项菜单

raw_item.translation: 家园

source: Homestead
translation: 家园

raw_item.translation: 任务日志

source: Quest Log
translation: 任务日志

raw_item.translation: 图鉴

source: Codex
translation: 图鉴

raw_item.translation: 角色与技能菜单

source: Character and Skills Menu
translation: 角色与技能菜单

raw_item.translation: 休息可以防止疲劳。

source: Resting staves off fatigue.
translation: 休息可以防止疲劳。

raw_item.translation: 警戒有助于保护营地免受袭击或盗窃。

source: Guarding helps protect the camp from attacks or theft.
translation: 警戒有助于保护营地免受袭击或盗窃。

raw_item.translation: 狩猎可为你的远征增添肉。

source: Hunting adds meat to your expedition.
translation: 狩猎可为你的远征增添肉。

raw_item.translation: 侦察有几率在营地附近的战役地图上发现资源。

source: Scouting has a chance to discover resources on the campaign map near the campsite.
translation: 侦察有几率在营地附近的战役地图上发现资源。

raw_item.translation: 烹饪有几率让你的战士获得增益。

source: Cooking has a chance to apply a bonus to your warriors.
translation: 烹饪有几率让你的战士获得增益。

raw_item.translation: 腌制决定将多少肉转化为口粮。

source: Preserving determines the amount of Meat converted into Rations.
translation: 腌制决定将多少肉转化为口粮。

raw_item.translation: 制作让随从能够制作战斗用的武器和护甲。

source: Crafting lets a follower create weapons and armour to use in combat.
translation: 制作让随从能够制作战斗用的武器和护甲。

raw_item.translation: 修理已损坏的物品。

source: Repairs items that have been damaged.
translation: 修理已损坏的物品。

raw_item.translation: 治疗用于救治受伤的随从。

source: Healing is used to treat injured followers.
translation: 治疗用于救治受伤的随从。

raw_item.translation: 巫术决定将多少草药转化为药品。

source: Witchcraft determines the amount of Herbs converted into Medicine.
translation: 巫术决定将多少草药转化为药品。

raw_item.translation: 巧作让随从能够制作战斗物品。

source: Tinkering lets followers create combat items.
translation: 巧作让随从能够制作战斗物品。

raw_item.translation: 清扫可让营地保持隐秘和安全，防止其安全度因使用而下降。

source: Cleaning keeps the camp secret and secure, preventing its Security from deteriorating with use.
translation: 清扫可让营地保持隐秘和安全，防止其安全度因使用而下降。

raw_item.translation: 营地不会遭到袭击或盗窃的几率。

source: The probability that the camp will not be subjected to attacks or theft.
translation: 营地不会遭到袭击或盗窃的几率。

raw_item.translation: 你的猎人带回大约每技能等级狩猎2肉的概率。

source: The chance that your hunters will bring back roughly 2 Meat per rank of hunting.
translation: 你的猎人带回大约每技能等级狩猎2肉的概率。

raw_item.translation: 在该营地附近的战役地图上发现资源的几率。

source: The chance of discovering resources on the campaign map near this campsite.
translation: 在该营地附近的战役地图上发现资源的几率。

raw_item.translation: 在可用肉总量中，计划转化为口粮的肉量。

source: The amount of Meat set to be converted into Rations, out of the total amount of Meat available.
translation: 在可用肉总量中，计划转化为口粮的肉量。

raw_item.translation: 在可用草药总量中，计划转化为药品的草药量。

source: The amount of Herbs set to be converted into Medicine, out of the total amount of Herbs available.
translation: 在可用草药总量中，计划转化为药品的草药量。

raw_item.translation: 选择下一个随从显示筛选器。

source: Select the next filter for displaying your followers.
translation: 选择下一个随从显示筛选器。

raw_item.translation: 选择上一个随从显示筛选器。

source: Select the previous filter for displaying your followers.
translation: 选择上一个随从显示筛选器。

raw_item.translation: 清除随从的所有任务，默认设为休息。

source: Clears all the tasks for your followers, defaulting to resting.
translation: 清除随从的所有任务，默认设为休息。

raw_item.translation: 根据你的需求和随从的技能为他们分配任务。不会分配制作、巧作、修理或治疗。

source: Assigns tasks for all your followers based on your needs and their skills. Will not assign crafting, tinkering, repairing, or healing
translation: 根据你的需求和随从的技能为他们分配任务。不会分配制作、巧作、修理或治疗。

raw_item.translation: 不为任何随从分配食物。

source: Assign no food to all followers.
translation: 不为任何随从分配食物。

raw_item.translation: 将所有肉分配给你的随从，然后切换为口粮。

source: Assign all Meat to your followers, then switch to Rations.
translation: 将所有肉分配给你的随从，然后切换为口粮。

raw_item.translation: 为所有随从分配口粮，直到补给耗尽。

source: Assign a Ration to all followers until supplies run out.
translation: 为所有随从分配口粮，直到补给耗尽。

raw_item.translation: 自动将上次营地期间获得的肉分配给随从，减少口粮消耗。

source: Automatically assigns Meat procured during the last camp to your followers, lowering the use of Rations.
translation: 自动将上次营地期间获得的肉分配给随从，减少口粮消耗。

raw_item.translation: 决定谁先进食，即新获得的肉会优先分配给这些人，然后分配口粮，依次递减，直到补给耗尽。

source: Determines who eats first, meaning new Meat will be assigned to these people first, then Rations, then descending in order until supplies run out.
translation: 决定谁先进食，即新获得的肉会优先分配给这些人，然后分配口粮，依次递减，直到补给耗尽。

raw_item.translation: 将所选食物分配给所有随从。

source: Assigns the selected food to all followers.
translation: 将所选食物分配给所有随从。

raw_item.translation: 最健康的随从先吃，确保那些整装待战的人饱腹。

source: Healthiest followers eat first, making sure those in fighting trim are well fed.
translation: 最健康的随从先吃，确保那些整装待战的人饱腹。

raw_item.translation: 最虚弱的随从先吃。对需要帮助的人施以怜悯。

source: Weakest followers eat first. Showing mercy to those in need.
translation: 最虚弱的随从先吃。对需要帮助的人施以怜悯。

raw_item.translation: 最善战的人先吃，依据是投入战斗技能的技能点数量。

source: The best fighters eat first, based on the amount of skillpoints spent on combat skills.
translation: 最善战的人先吃，依据是投入战斗技能的技能点数量。

raw_item.translation: 最不善战的人先吃，依据是投入战斗技能的技能点数量。

source: The worst fighters eat first, based on the amount of skillpoints spent on combat skills.
translation: 最不善战的人先吃，依据是投入战斗技能的技能点数量。

raw_item.translation: 最忠诚的人先吃，意味着你能以性命相托的人也能以性命托付于你。

source: The most loyal eat first, meaning those you can trust with your life can trust you with theirs.
translation: 最忠诚的人先吃，意味着你能以性命相托的人也能以性命托付于你。

raw_item.translation: 最不忠诚的人先吃，因为你想争取那些可能背叛你的人。

source: The least loyal eat first, because you want to win over those might betray you.
translation: 最不忠诚的人先吃，因为你想争取那些可能背叛你的人。

source: The right and left hand slots can hold a 1-handed weapon and a shield, a 1-handed weapon and an axe or knife, or a single two-handed weapon. If your left hand is empty, you get a small bonus to your Critical Chance.

source: Until you make an attack, you can freely switch between your primary and secondary weapon sets during combat. Once you attack, you can no longer switch weapons for the rest of your turn.

raw_item.translation: 轻伤相对无害，惩罚更轻，花费也大幅减少。

source: Light injures are relatively harmless, the penalties are lighter and the cost is reduced significantly.
translation: 轻伤相对无害，惩罚更轻，花费也大幅减少。

raw_item.translation: 中度伤势没有惩罚修正，治疗费用略低，但恶化风险增加[P1]+5%[P2]。

source: Moderate injuries have no penalty modifications and are a little cheaper to treat, but increases the deterioration risk by [color="#ff0000"]+5%[/color].
translation: 中度伤势没有惩罚修正，治疗费用略低，但恶化风险增加[color="#ff0000"]+5%[/color]。

raw_item.translation: 重伤的惩罚略高，且花费没有减免。恶化风险增加[P1]+15%[P2]。

source: Severe injuries get a slightly higher penalty with no reduction to cost. Deterioration Risk is increased by [color="#ff0000"]+15%[/color].
translation: 重伤的惩罚略高，且花费没有减免。恶化风险增加[color="#ff0000"]+15%[/color]。

raw_item.translation: 危重伤势的惩罚大幅增加，其花费和恶化风险也提高了[P1]+30%[P2]。

source: Critical injuries sees a significant penalty increase, as well cost and deterioration risk is increased by [color="#ff0000"]+30%[/color].
translation: 危重伤势的惩罚大幅增加，其花费和恶化风险也提高了[color="#ff0000"]+30%[/color]。

raw_item.translation: 致命/致残伤势只需一次判定失手，便会造成永久后果；其惩罚和花费大幅增加，恶化风险更是高达[P1]+50%[P2]。

source: Fatal/Crippling injuries are one dice-rool away from permanent consequences, the penalties and cost are heavily increased and deterioration risk is now at a whopping [color="#ff0000"]+50%[/color].
translation: 致命/致残伤势只需一次判定失手，便会造成永久后果；其惩罚和花费大幅增加，恶化风险更是高达[color="#ff0000"]+50%[/color]。

raw_item.translation: 如果你在患者病情发展到这一步之前没有对其施救，就必须承担后果——大多数情况下是死亡，或是永久伤势。

source: If you don't treat your patient before reaching this point, you must suffer the consequences, which in most cases are death, or permanent injuries.
translation: 如果你在患者病情发展到这一步之前没有对其施救，就必须承担后果——大多数情况下是死亡，或是永久伤势。

raw_item.translation: [P1]攻击技能[P2][P3]攻击技能提供可在战斗中使用的额外技能，不绑定任何特定武器。

raw_item.translation: [P1]支援技能[P2][P3]支援技能可协助盟友、阻挠敌人，或提供战术优势，但不造成直接伤害。

source: [size="16"]Support skills[/size]\nSupport skills help allies, hinder enemies, or provide tactical advantages without dealing direct damage.
translation: [size="16"]支援技能[/size]\n支援技能可协助盟友、阻挠敌人，或提供战术优势，但不造成直接伤害。

raw_item.translation: [P1]辅助技能[P2][P3]辅助技能有助于让队伍装备齐全、心情愉快、饱腹，总体来说对整个队伍都有帮助。

source: [size="16"]Utility skills[/size]\nUtility skills are useful for keeping the party equipped, happy, and well fed, and in general help the party as a whole.
translation: [size="16"]辅助技能[/size]\n辅助技能有助于让队伍装备齐全、心情愉快、饱腹，总体来说对整个队伍都有帮助。

raw_item.translation: [P1]被动技能[P2][P3]被动技能会小幅但永久地提升属性，或在特定条件下为你带来额外优势。

source: [size="16"]Passive skills[/size]\nPassive skills provide small but permanent boosts to stats or give you an extra edge under specific conditions.
translation: [size="16"]被动技能[/size]\n被动技能会小幅但永久地提升属性，或在特定条件下为你带来额外优势。

raw_item.translation:
在北方群山之中，有一支自称乌尔夫赫德纳的战士教团。据说他们是奥丁的特殊战士，上阵时除了披一张沃尔夫皮之外几乎不着寸缕，刀枪不入，火烧不伤。那个名叫“和平者”的巨人贡纳尔——这别名讽刺得彻底——声称自己就是这些狂战士中的一员。

贡纳尔带着一伙劫掠者从北方交易重镇考庞出发，前往西边的奥克尼岛，在那里他倒霉地遇上了碎颅者斯库勒。斯库勒说服贡纳尔对你的村庄发动劫掠。他或许不是你麾下最靠谱的侍卫，但有一件事可以肯定：让贡纳尔站在你这边，远比他与你为敌要好。

source: In the mountains of the north, there exists a cult of warriors who call themselves the Ulfhednar. They are said to be Odinn's special warriors, who wear little except the pelt of a wolf into battle and become impervious to steel or fire. Gunnarr, the giant with the wholly ironic byname "the Peaceful", claims to be one of these berserkers.\n\nGunnarr led a group of raiders from the northern trade hub Kaupang to the isle of Orkney in the west, where he had the misfortune to meet Skule Skullcleaver. Skule convinced Gunnarr to mount a raid against your village. He may not be the most predictable huscarl in your service, but one thing is certain: it is far better to have Gunnarr on your side than against you.
translation:

raw_item.translation:
你从小就认识内夫娅和她的姐妹埃芙拉。她们已故的父亲霍尔蒙曾是你父亲最亲近的侍卫之一，他随领主外出时，姐妹俩常常只能由母亲独自照看。

这对双胞胎从小就各走各的路——埃芙拉一直是母亲眼中美丽娇柔的女儿，内夫娅则更像父亲，整天在林子里探险，在荒野上玩耍，或是跟男孩们打架。她刚大到能握住木棍，就开始训练成为一名战士。

这些年来，内夫娅心中那团炽烈的火焰把她锻炼成了一名训练有素的盾女；她在蛮力上的不足，完全由灵巧和坚毅弥补有余。

source:
You've known Nefja and her sister Eyfura since you were children. Their late father Holmunn was among your father's closest huscarls, and the sisters were often left solely in the care of their mother while he was travelling with his thegn.

The twins grew apart from an early age - where Eyfura was always her mother's beautiful and delicate girl, Nefja took more after her father and would spend her days exploring the woods, playing in the moor, or fighting with the boys. As soon as she was old enough to hold a wooden stick, she started training to be a warrior.

Over the years, the fire that burns brightly inside Nefja has turned her into a disciplined shieldmaiden, and what she lacks in raw strength is more than made up for in deftness and resolve.

raw_item.translation:
虽然她的头衔是凯特王国的公主，但艾芙几乎没有公主的仪态，也没有那些典型的傲气。凯特是个贫穷严酷的国家，艾芙从小就被培养得像她父亲的任何臣民一样坚韧果断。她一到足够年纪，就被送去跟随著名的战士格兰妮训练，在她的教导下成了一名熟练的陷阱专家。

艾芙自幼便兼具好奇与勇气，几乎是一时兴起决定加入你的亲兵队。显然，她对你和你的文化怀有某种迷恋。所幸她在战场上确是个相当得力的帮手。

source: Though her title is Princess of the Kingdom of Cait, Aife has few of a princess's manners and none of the typical conceits. Cait is a poor and harsh country, and Aife was raised to be as resilient and determined as any of her father's subjects. As soon as she was old enough, she was sent to train with the famous warrior Grainne, whose tutelage has turned her into a skillful trapper.\n\nGifted from an early age with equal parts curiosity and courage, Aife decided almost on a whim to join your hird. It's clear that she harbours some fascination with you and your culture. It's fortunate then that she is such a considerable asset on the field of battle.
translation:
虽然她的头衔是凯特王国的公主，但艾芙几乎没有公主的仪态，也没有那些典型的傲气。凯特是个贫穷严酷的国家，艾芙从小就被培养得像她父亲的任何臣民一样坚韧果断。她一到足够年纪，就被送去跟随著名的战士格兰妮训练，在她的教导下成了一名熟练的陷阱专家。

艾芙自幼便兼具好奇与勇气，几乎是一时兴起决定加入你的亲兵队。显然，她对你和你的文化怀有某种迷恋。所幸她在战场上确是个相当得力的帮手。

raw_item.translation:
埃迪丝年轻时与丈夫阿尔瓦尔德新婚不久便来到你的村庄，接手了他叔叔在你家园外围的农场，准备成家立业。在你的童年记忆里，她是个热情又活泼的女人，喜欢给氏族里的孩子们讲远古宝藏的故事，或者吟诵关于诸神的诗篇。

大约十年前，一场疾病夺走了阿尔瓦尔德，只留下她独自抚养他给她的两个儿子。如今她唯一牵挂的就是孩子们的安全与声望。既然两个儿子都已长大，能够打理农场，她便请求随你远征海外诸岛，好带回丰厚的财富，为儿子们谋个更好的未来。

source: Eydis came to your village with her husband Alvaldr when they were young and recently married, to take over his uncle's farm on the outskirts of your homestead and start a family. In your childhood, she was a warm and bubbly woman who loved to entertain the children of the clan with stories of ancient treasures or by reciting poems about the gods.\n\nA disease claimed Alvaldr almost a decade ago, leaving her alone to raise the two sons he gave her. Now her only concern is the safety and prosperity of her children. Since both of them are now old enough to tend to the farm, she has asked to join you on your expedition to the isles across the sea, that she might bring great wealth home and build a better future for her sons.

埃迪丝年轻时与丈夫阿尔瓦尔德新婚不久便来到你的村庄，接手了他叔叔在你家园外围的农场，准备成家立业。在你的童年记忆里，她是个热情又活泼的女人，喜欢给氏族里的孩子们讲远古宝藏的故事，或者吟诵关于诸神的诗篇。

raw_item.translation:
阿斯莱夫是你的远房表亲，也是你氏族中另一家族最受宠爱的儿子。氏族的领导权在你家族和他家族之间世代交替，但尽管你父亲从阿斯莱夫的父亲手中赢得了领主的位子，格里姆瓦尔德此后仍忠心耿耿地为你父亲效力多年。

格里姆瓦尔德让阿斯莱夫自小就深受荣誉感与责任感的熏陶。阿斯莱夫被培养成一名强壮而熟练的战士，他此生别无所求，只想侍奉并保护自己的家族和氏族。为此，他被迫质疑你继承父亲王位的资格，认为你软弱无能，不配领导众人。在那场决斗中，他被说服改变了看法，如今已宣誓在你前往海外诸岛的旅途中为你效力。

source: Asleifr is a distant cousin, the favourite son of another family in your clan. Leadership of the clan has passed back and forth between your family and his for generations, but although your father won the seat of thegn from Asleifr's father, Grimvardr served your father dutifully for years afterwards.\n\nFrom Grimvardr, Asleifr was instilled with an overwhelming sense of honour and duty. Asleifr has been raised as a strong and skilled warrior who wants nothing more from life than to serve and protect his family and his clan. To that purpose, he was compelled to challenge your claim to your father's throne, seeing you as weak and undeserving of leadership. In your duel, he was convinced otherwise, and he is now sworn to serve you on your travels to the isles across the sea.

raw_item.translation: 莫坎特是蒙克韦尔茅斯修道院的一名修士，年轻时潜心学习与沉思。他极为敬重有学问之人，并受前辈比德的激励，去探求知识，并将其整理成文，以表达信仰以及对上帝造物的惊叹。[P1][P2]他曾用数年时间游历诺森布里亚乡间，照料并教导当地百姓。正是在这些游历中，他对异教徒信仰产生了浓厚兴趣，并设法将其保存下来。在他看来，这些仪式与故事让那些未开化、盲目摸索上帝真理之光的人得以窥见一二——而通过理解它们，他希望能帮助他们更顺利地皈依真正的信仰。

source: Morcant is a brother of the Monkwearmouth monastery and spent his youth in diligent study and contemplation. He has immense respect for the learned and was inspired by his senior Bede to seek knowledge and codify it as an expression of faith and wonder of God's work.\n\nHe spent several years wandering the Northumbrian countryside, tending to and teaching the people. It was during these travels that he developed his fascination with pagan beliefs and sought to preserve them. In his eyes, these rites and stories inform the unenlightened grasping blindly for the illumination of God's truth - and through understanding them, he hopes to ease their transition into the true faith.
translation: 莫坎特是蒙克韦尔茅斯修道院的一名修士，年轻时潜心学习与沉思。他极为敬重有学问之人，并受前辈比德的激励，去探求知识，并将其整理成文，以表达信仰以及对上帝造物的惊叹。\n\n他曾用数年时间游历诺森布里亚乡间，照料并教导当地百姓。正是在这些游历中，他对异教徒信仰产生了浓厚兴趣，并设法将其保存下来。在他看来，这些仪式与故事让那些未开化、盲目摸索上帝真理之光的人得以窥见一二——而通过理解它们，他希望能帮助他们更顺利地皈依真正的信仰。

raw_item.translation: 罗斯克娃还是个婴儿时，就被放在篮子裡遗弃在你家园外的沼泽中——直到今天，也没人知道她的父母是谁，又为何要把她丢给食腐的鸟。罗斯克娃运气很好，年老的女巫胡尔达——她自己没有孩子——发现了这个新生女婴，决定把罗斯克娃当作学徒抚养长大。[P1][P2]罗斯克娃还很年轻，但她已经懂得如何利用植物，也摸清了幽灵的脾性。这位年轻女巫是一位灵巧而富有同情心的医者，但她对致命的毒药和残酷的诅咒也毫无顾忌。二十个冬天过去，她先是由一位老妪照料，后来又反过来照料那位老妪，如今罗斯克娃渴望离开村庄，去远方寻求新的知识。

source: As a babe, Røskva was left in a basket in the bog outside your homestead - to this day, no one knows who her parents were, or why they decided to leave her to the carrion birds. To Røskva's great fortune, the old witch Hulda - herself childless - found the newborn girl and decided to raise Røskva as her apprentice.\n\nRøskva is still young, but she is already wise to the uses of plants and the whims of spirits. The young witch is a deft and compassionate healer, but she has no qualms with deadly poisons and cruel curses. After a score of winters first in the care of an old crone, then caring for the crone in turn, Røskva is keen to leave the village and seek new knowledge in distant lands.
translation: 罗斯克娃还是个婴儿时，就被放在篮子裡遗弃在你家园外的沼泽中——直到今天，也没人知道她的父母是谁，又为何要把她丢给食腐的鸟。罗斯克娃运气很好，年老的女巫胡尔达——她自己没有孩子——发现了这个新生女婴，决定把罗斯克娃当作学徒抚养长大。\n\n罗斯克娃还很年轻，但她已经懂得如何利用植物，也摸清了幽灵的脾性。这位年轻女巫是一位灵巧而富有同情心的医者，但她对致命的毒药和残酷的诅咒也毫无顾忌。二十个冬天过去，她先是由一位老妪照料，后来又反过来照料那位老妪，如今罗斯克娃渴望离开村庄，去远方寻求新的知识。

raw_item.translation: 你父亲在北方的一次旅行中把凯蒂尔带回了家。那时这个黑发男孩不过八岁，性情腼腆而阴郁。你父亲从未好好解释过自己怎么会负责照管这孩子，但应领主的请求，凯蒂尔被氏族收留，作为孤儿抚养长大。[P1][P2]凯蒂尔渐渐走出了自己的壳，由于你们年纪相仿，很快便成了挚友。凯蒂尔长成了一个精瘦的年轻人，脚步轻柔、目光锐利，使他成了一名熟练的猎人。他早已不是当年你父亲带回家的那个沉默男孩，如今的凯蒂尔有着迷人的笑容和让人卸下防备的机智。他是个好朋友，也是个忠诚的侍卫，你让他去哪里，他就跟到哪里。

source: Your father brought Ketill back home from one of his journeys in the north. The dark-haired boy had seen no more than eight winters at the time, and he had a shy and brooding demeanour about him then. Your father never adequately explained how he came to be responsible for the kid, but at the thegn's request, Ketill was taken in by the clan and raised as an orphan.\n\nKetill gradually came out of his shell, and being about the same age, you became fast friends. Ketill grew up to be a lean young man, whose soft step and keen eyes have made him a skillful hunter. Far from the quiet boy your father brought home with him, Ketill has come to wield a charming smile and a disarming wit. He is a good friend and a loyal huscarl who will follow you wherever you ask of him.
translation: 你父亲在北方的一次旅行中把凯蒂尔带回了家。那时这个黑发男孩不过八岁，性情腼腆而阴郁。你父亲从未好好解释过自己怎么会负责照管这孩子，但应领主的请求，凯蒂尔被氏族收留，作为孤儿抚养长大。\n\n凯蒂尔渐渐走出了自己的壳，由于你们年纪相仿，很快便成了挚友。凯蒂尔长成了一个精瘦的年轻人，脚步轻柔、目光锐利，使他成了一名熟练的猎人。他早已不是当年你父亲带回家的那个沉默男孩，如今的凯蒂尔有着迷人的笑容和让人卸下防备的机智。他是个好朋友，也是个忠诚的侍卫，你让他去哪里，他就跟到哪里。

raw_item.translation: [P1]格挡几率[P2][P3]决定你用盾牌格挡攻击的几率，格挡成功时由盾牌承受伤害，而不是你本人。

source: [size="16"]Block Chance[/size]\nDetermines how likely you are to block an attack with a shield, so the shield will take the damage instead of you.
translation: [size="16"]格挡几率[/size]\n决定你用盾牌格挡攻击的几率，格挡成功时由盾牌承受伤害，而不是你本人。

raw_item.translation: [P1]命中率[P2][P3]决定远程攻击的最大命中率。与目标距离每增加一个六角格，命中率便降低6点，最终命中率永远不会超过95%。

source: [size="16"]Accuracy[/size]\nDetermines the maximum accuracy for ranged attacks. This drops by 6 points per hex of distance to the target, and the final hit chance can never exceed 95%.
translation: [size="16"]命中率[/size]\n决定远程攻击的最大命中率。与目标距离每增加一个六角格，命中率便降低6点，最终命中率永远不会超过95%。

raw_item.translation: [P1]暴击率[P2][P3]决定打出暴击的几率。暴击时，伤害会乘以所装备武器的暴击倍率。

source: [size="16"]Critical Chance[/size]\nDetermines the likelihood of landing a critical hit, which multiplies the damage by the critical modifier of the equipped weapon.
translation: [size="16"]暴击率[/size]\n决定打出暴击的几率。暴击时，伤害会乘以所装备武器的暴击倍率。

raw_item.translation: [P1]伤害[P2][P3]伤害等于你的[P4]基础伤害[P5]，再加上当前所装备武器的伤害。

source: [size="16"]Damage[/size]\nDamage is your [color="lightblue"]Base Damage[/color], plus the damage of the currently equipped weapon.
translation: [size="16"]伤害[/size]\n伤害等于你的[color="lightblue"]基础伤害[/color]，再加上当前所装备武器的伤害。

raw_item.translation: [P1]移动力[P2][P3]你在战斗中仍能发动攻击的前提下可移动的六角格数量。护甲会对此造成惩罚，使单位能移动的六角格减少。

source: [size="16"]Movement[/size]\nThe amount of hexes you can move during combat while still performing an attack. Armours can add penalties to this, making the unit able to move less hexes.
translation: [size="16"]移动力[/size]\n你在战斗中仍能发动攻击的前提下可移动的六角格数量。护甲会对此造成惩罚，使单位能移动的六角格减少。

raw_item.translation: [P1]伤害减免（DR）[P2][P3]伤害减免决定从来袭攻击中减去的伤害量。根据所装备的装备不同，近战攻击和远程攻击的伤害减免可能不同。

source: [size="16"]Damage Reduction (DR)[/size]\nDamage Reduction determines the amount of damage subtracted from incoming attacks. This might be different between melee and ranged attacks, depending on the equipped gear.
translation: [size="16"]伤害减免（DR）[/size]\n伤害减免决定从来袭攻击中减去的伤害量。根据所装备的装备不同，近战攻击和远程攻击的伤害减免可能不同。

raw_item.translation: [P1]体力[P2][P3]决定一名角色在陷入疲惫前能坚持多少小时。在营地睡满两班次即可重置计时。

source: [size="16"]Stamina[/size]\nDetermines how many hours a character can go before becoming Fatigued. Getting two shifts of sleep at camp will reset the timer.
translation: [size="16"]体力[/size]\n决定一名角色在陷入疲惫前能坚持多少小时。在营地睡满两班次即可重置计时。

raw_item.translation: [P1]生命值（HP）[P2][P3]决定一名角色在[P4]倒地[P5]前能承受多少伤害。每场战斗后生命值都会恢复，但若倒地时间过久，角色会遭受伤势。

source: [size="16"]Hitpoints (HP)[/size]\nDetermines the amount of damage a character can sustain before getting [color="yellow"]Incapacitated[/color]. Hitpoints replenish after each fight, but characters will suffer injuries if incapacitated for too long.
translation: [size="16"]生命值（HP）[/size]\n决定一名角色在[color="yellow"]倒地[/color]前能承受多少伤害。每场战斗后生命值都会恢复，但若倒地时间过久，角色会遭受伤势。

raw_item.translation: [P1]纪律[P2][P3]决定抵抗负面精神与物理效果的几率。

source: [size="16"]Discipline[/size]\nDetermines the chance of resisting negative mental and physical effects.
translation: [size="16"]纪律[/size]\n决定抵抗负面精神与物理效果的几率。

raw_item.translation: [P1]物理抗性[P2][P3]决定抵抗负面物理效果的几率。由力量与士气派生。盾牌可提升此数值。

source: [size="16"]Physical Resistance[/size]\nDetermines the chance of resisting negative physical effects. Derived from Strength and Morale. Shields can bolster this value.
translation: [size="16"]物理抗性[/size]\n决定抵抗负面物理效果的几率。由力量与士气派生。盾牌可提升此数值。

raw_item.translation: [P1]精神抗性[P2][P3]决定抵抗负面精神效果的几率。由感知与士气派生。头盔可提升此数值。

source: [size="16"]Mental Resistance[/size]\nDetermines the chance of resisting negative mental effects. Derived from Sense and Morale. Helmets can bolster this value.
translation: [size="16"]精神抗性[/size]\n决定抵抗负面精神效果的几率。由感知与士气派生。头盔可提升此数值。

raw_item.translation: [P1]士气[P2][P3]决定一名角色的信心，范围为-10到10。影响物理抗性与精神抗性。

source: [size="16"]Morale[/size]\nDetermines the confidence of a character on a scale from -10 to 10. Affects physical and mental resistances.
translation: [size="16"]士气[/size]\n决定一名角色的信心，范围为-10到10。影响物理抗性与精神抗性。

raw_item.translation: 在露营期间，可以把治疗任务分配给精通治疗之术的人，以此处理伤势。

source: Injuries can be treated during camping by assigning the task to a person who is versed in the art of healing.
translation: 在露营期间，可以把治疗任务分配给精通治疗之术的人，以此处理伤势。

raw_item.translation: [P1]力量[P2][P3]决定使用斧与剑时的[P4]基础伤害[P5]，并影响[P6]物理抗性[P7]。力量对战士至关重要，有时还能在对话中触发击倒及其他体能类特殊选项。

source: [size="16"]Strength[/size]\nDetermines [color="lightblue"]Base Damage[/color] with axes and swords and affects [color="lightblue"]Physical Resistance[/color]. Strength is essential for warriors, and will occasionally enable knockouts and other physical feats in dialogue.
translation: [size="16"]力量[/size]\n决定使用斧与剑时的[color="lightblue"]基础伤害[/color]，并影响[color="lightblue"]物理抗性[/color]。力量对战士至关重要，有时还能在对话中触发击倒及其他体能类特殊选项。

raw_item.translation: [P1]耐力[P2][P3]决定[P4]生命值[P5]、[P6]基础伤害减免[P7]、持盾时的[P8]格挡几率[P9]，并影响[P10]体力[P11]。耐力对前线战士至关重要。

source: [size="16"]Endurance[/size]\nDetermines [color="lightblue"]Hitpoints[/color], [color="lightblue"]Base Damage Reduction[/color], [color="lightblue"]Block Chance[/color] with shields, and affects [color="lightblue"]Stamina[/color]. Endurance is of utmost importance to front-line fighters.
translation: [size="16"]耐力[/size]\n决定[color="lightblue"]生命值[/color]、[color="lightblue"]基础伤害减免[/color]、持盾时的[color="lightblue"]格挡几率[/color]，并影响[color="lightblue"]体力[/color]。耐力对前线战士至关重要。

raw_item.translation: [P1]灵巧[P2][P3]决定使用匕首和长矛时的[P4]基础伤害[P5]，以及所有[P6]武器的暴击率[P7]。灵巧对远程角色和出手迅捷的盗贼很重要，有时还能在对话中用于发动突袭。

source: [size="16"]Finesse[/size]\nDetermines [color="lightblue"]Base Damage[/color] with knives and spears and [color="lightblue"]Critical Chance[/color] with all weapons. Finesse is important to ranged characters and fast-handed rogues, and can occasionally be used for surprise attacks in dialogue.
translation: [size="16"]灵巧[/size]\n决定使用匕首和长矛时的[color="lightblue"]基础伤害[/color]，以及所有[color="lightblue"]武器的暴击率[/color]。灵巧对远程角色和出手迅捷的盗贼很重要，有时还能在对话中用于发动突袭。

raw_item.translation: [P1]察觉[P2][P3]决定使用[P4]远程武器时的命中率[P5]。察觉对弓箭手至关重要，还常常能在对话中揭示额外信息。

source: [size="16"]Perception[/size]\nDetermines [color="lightblue"]Accuracy[/color] with ranged weapons. Perception is crucial to archers, and will often reveal additional information during dialogue.
translation: [size="16"]察觉[/size]\n决定使用[color="lightblue"]远程武器时的命中率[/color]。察觉对弓箭手至关重要，还常常能在对话中揭示额外信息。

raw_item.translation: [P1]感知[P2][P3]影响[P4]精神抗性[P5]和[P6]体力[P7]。感知是女巫、吟游诗人及其他辅助角色的基础属性，还常常能在对话中用于说服。

source: [size="16"]Sense[/size]\nAffects [color="lightblue"]Mental Resistance[/color] and [color="lightblue"]Stamina[/color]. Sense is fundamental to witches, skalds, and other support characters, and can often be used for persuasion in dialogue.
translation: [size="16"]感知[/size]\n影响[color="lightblue"]精神抗性[/color]和[color="lightblue"]体力[/color]。感知是女巫、吟游诗人及其他辅助角色的基础属性，还常常能在对话中用于说服。

raw_item.translation: [P1]士气[P2][P3]影响[P4]物理抗性[P5]和[P6]精神抗性[P7]。士气代表角色的信心，取值范围为 -10 到 10。

source: [size="16"]Morale[/size]\nAffects [color="lightblue"]Physical Resistance[/color] and [color="lightblue"]Mental Resistance[/color]. Morale represents the confidence of a character on a scale from -10 to 10.
translation: [size="16"]士气[/size]\n影响[color="lightblue"]物理抗性[/color]和[color="lightblue"]精神抗性[/color]。士气代表角色的信心，取值范围为 -10 到 10。

raw_item.translation: [P1][P2][P3][P4][P5][P6]当前日期与时间。只有在你旅行或扎营时，时间才会推进。如果你浪费时间，[P7]游戏将提前结束[P8]。

raw_item.translation: [P1][P2][P3][P4][P5]你父亲的葬礼就在这一天。

source: [size="18"][t][/size]\n\nYour father's funeral was on this date.
translation: [size="18"][t][/size]\n\n你父亲的葬礼就在这一天。

raw_item.translation: [P1][P2][P3][P4][P5][P6]你必须在这一天之前完成所有准备。如果时间耗尽，你的氏族就会任敌人宰割，[P7]游戏将提前结束[P8]。

source: [size="18"][t][/size][inactive]\n\nYou must finish your preparations before this date. If you run out of time, your clan will be at the mercy of your enemies and [color="orange"]the game will end prematurely[/color].
translation: [size="18"][t][/size][inactive]\n\n你必须在这一天之前完成所有准备。如果时间耗尽，你的氏族就会任敌人宰割，[color="orange"]游戏将提前结束[/color]。

raw_item.translation: [P1][P2][P3][P4][P5]你于这一天从斯凯恩启航。

source: [size="18"][t][/size]\n\nYou sailed out of Skjern on this date.
translation: [size="18"][t][/size]\n\n你于这一天从斯凯恩启航。

raw_item.translation: [P1][P2][P3][P4][P5][P6]你必须在这一天之前返回斯凯恩参加秋收。否则你将无法参加阿尔庭议会，[P7]你的氏族也将任碎颅者斯库勒宰割[P8]。

source: [size="18"][t][/size][inactive]\n\nYou must return to Skjern for harvest before this date. Otherwise you will not be able to participate at the Althing, and [color="orange"]your clan will be at Skule Skullcleaver's mercy[/color].

raw_item.translation: 多层布料缝成的简易护衣能挡下擦身而过的攻击，也不妨碍穿戴者的移动力，但比普通衣物强不了多少。

source: Simple coats of layered cloth protect against glancing blows without restricting the wearer's movement, but it isn't much better than regular clothes.
translation: 多层布料缝成的简易护衣能挡下擦身而过的攻击，也不妨碍穿戴者的移动力，但比普通衣物强不了多少。

raw_item.translation: 在胸口和后背层叠已治愈的兽皮，再以毛皮加衬，能有效抵挡轻度的割伤和冲击，但会略微限制穿戴者的移动力。

source: Cured hide layered around the chest and back and padded with fur protects well against light cuts and impacts, but does restrict the wearer's movement slighty.
translation: 在胸口和后背层叠已治愈的兽皮，再以毛皮加衬，能有效抵挡轻度的割伤和冲击，但会略微限制穿戴者的移动力。

raw_item.translation: 将煮革小甲片成排穿缀起来，防护胜过布料和普通皮甲，对移动力的限制也不比皮甲更多。

source: Laced rows of boiled leather platelets protect better than cloth and simple hide without restricting movement any more than hide armour.
translation: 将煮革小甲片成排穿缀起来，防护胜过布料和普通皮甲，对移动力的限制也不比皮甲更多。

raw_item.translation: 由互锁铁环编成的护衣能对各类武器提供出色保护，但这件护衣相当沉重，会明显限制移动力。

source: A shirt of interlocking iron rings offers excellent protection against all weapons, but the coat is quite heavy and significantly restricts movement.
translation: 由互锁铁环编成的护衣能对各类武器提供出色保护，但这件护衣相当沉重，会明显限制移动力。

raw_item.translation: 这些原始毛皮头盔制作简单，但不如更先进的款式强韧。

source: These primitive fur helmets are easy to make, but not as robust as more advanced designs.
translation: 这些原始毛皮头盔制作简单，但不如更先进的款式强韧。

raw_item.translation: 已治愈的皮革头盔能有效抵挡擦身而过的攻击。

source: Cured leather helmets offer decent protection from glancing blows.
translation: 已治愈的皮革头盔能有效抵挡擦身而过的攻击。

raw_item.translation: 钢盔需要高超的工艺才能制成，但能承受大量打击。

source: Steel cap helmets require great expertise to produce, but can take a lot of punishment.
translation: 钢盔需要高超的工艺才能制成，但能承受大量打击。

raw_item.translation: 一些制甲匠发现，把锁子甲帘幕装在钢盔上，是提供额外保护的简便方法。

source: Some armourers have found that attaching a curtain of ring mail to steel helmets is an easy way to offer extra protection.
translation: 一些制甲匠发现，把锁子甲帘幕装在钢盔上，是提供额外保护的简便方法。

raw_item.translation: 在垂帘盔上加装护目镜和护鼻，不仅能多提供一点保护，样子也非常威风。

source: Adding goggles and a nose guard to an aventailed helmet not only yields a little more protection, but looks very impressive.
translation: 在垂帘盔上加装护目镜和护鼻，不仅能多提供一点保护，样子也非常威风。

translation: 这种设计是战斗用斧的顶峰，各种花招与阴狠手段都能施展开来。

raw_item.translation: 用柳木制成的简易弓。用来狩猎动物还算趁手，对付人就不太行了。

source: A simple bow made from the wood of a willow tree. Useful for hunting animals, but not as good against humans.
translation: 用柳木制成的简易弓。用来狩猎动物还算趁手，对付人就不太行了。

raw_item.translation: 桦木坚固而有韧性，制成的狩猎弓相当出色，在战斗中也颇为堪用。

source: Birch wood is strong and flexible, and yields an excellent hunting bow which is quite serviceable in combat.
translation: 桦木坚固而有韧性，制成的狩猎弓相当出色，在战斗中也颇为堪用。

raw_item.translation: 一柄做工扎实的松木弓，配上等质的马鬃弦，握把舒适，满拉时也能保持稳定。

translation: 一柄做工扎实的松木弓，配上等质的马鬃弦，握把舒适，满拉时也能保持稳定。

raw_item.translation: 这柄芬妮弓以榆木制成。它柔韧而坚固——到了熟练弓箭手手中便是致命武器。

translation: 这柄芬妮弓以榆木制成。它柔韧而坚固——到了熟练弓箭手手中便是致命武器。

source: The wood of a yew is perfectly suited for a war-bow. This is a powerful and sturdy weapon, decorated with a fine grip and the highest quality bow string.
translation: 紫杉木天生适合做战弓。这柄武器强劲结实，饰有精美的握把和品质上乘的弓弦。

source: Short one-edged blade of varying sharpness, attached to a wooden handle. Never leave home without one.

source: The tip of this one is cleverly shaped to pry through armour and offers limited slashing capabilities for the dextrous wielder.
translation: 这柄矛的矛尖造型巧妙，能撬穿护甲，灵巧的使用者还能用它做出有限的挥砍。

raw_item.translation: 给矛尖做花纹锻焊看似小题大做，但额外的韧性让刺击更有力、更精准。

source: Though pattern-welding a speartip might seem like overkill, the extra flexibility allows for more powerful and accurate thrusts.
translation: 给矛尖做花纹锻焊看似小题大做，但额外的韧性让刺击更有力、更精准。

raw_item.translation: 巧妙的设计结合大师级的锻造技艺，这柄矛到了行家手里便极其致命。

source: Combining a clever design with masterful smithing technique, this spear is incredibly deadly in the right hands.
translation: 巧妙的设计结合大师级的锻造技艺，这柄矛到了行家手里便极其致命。

raw_item.translation: 这柄矛的品质让它不再是寻常兵器，而更像一件宗教圣物。

source: The quality of this spear elevates it from a common weapon to something resembling a religious relic.
translation: 这柄矛的品质让它不再是寻常兵器，而更像一件宗教圣物。

raw_item.translation: 剑除了取人性命几乎别无他用，但做这件事它非常在行。

source: Swords have little use other than for taking lives, but they are very good for that purpose.
translation: 剑除了取人性命几乎别无他用，但做这件事它非常在行。

raw_item.translation: 通过加宽刀身并磨利两侧刃口，打造出了一件威力强大而用途多样的武器。

source: By broadening the blade and sharpening both edges, a powerful and versatile weapon has been produced.
translation: 通过加宽刀身并磨利两侧刃口，打造出了一件威力强大而用途多样的武器。

raw_item.translation: 对剑进行错纹焊接需要极高水平的锻造技艺，但它的效果无可争辩。

source: Pattern-welding a sword requires a high degree of mastery over the forge, but you can't argue with the results.
translation: 对剑进行错纹焊接需要极高水平的锻造技艺，但它的效果无可争辩。

raw_item.translation: 尽管刀身尺寸不小，这把剑却轻盈且配重完美。它华丽的剑柄握在任何手中都很舒适。

source: Despite the size of its blade, this sword is light and perfectly balanced. It's ornate hilt rests comfortably in any hand.
translation: 尽管刀身尺寸不小，这把剑却轻盈且配重完美。它华丽的剑柄握在任何手中都很舒适。

raw_item.translation: 欧洲锻造技艺的顶尖水平打造出了一柄美丽的剑刃，感觉它能像切雪一样轻易劈开岩石。

source: The state of the art of European smithing has produced a beautiful blade that feels like it could cut through a rock as easily as snow.
translation: 欧洲锻造技艺的顶尖水平打造出了一柄美丽的剑刃，感觉它能像切雪一样轻易劈开岩石。

raw_item.translation: 它也许算不上优雅的武器，但高速飞来的石头往往更能解决问题。

translation: 它也许算不上优雅的武器，但高速飞来的石头往往更能解决问题。

raw_item.translation: 更结实的细绳和改良的释放装置，让这条投石索每次投掷都能施加更大的势力。

source: A stronger string and an improved release mechanism allows this sling to impart more power on each throw.
translation: 更结实的细绳和改良的释放装置，让这条投石索每次投掷都能施加更大的势力。

raw_item.translation: 羊毛被紧密纺成更长的细绳，配上设计更好的弹兜，让这条投石索出人意料地强劲。

source: Wool spun tightly into a longer string, fitted with a better designed cradle for the projectile, makes this sling surprisingly powerful.
translation: 羊毛被紧密纺成更长的细绳，配上设计更好的弹兜，让这条投石索出人意料地强劲。

raw_item.translation: 制造这条投石索投入了非同寻常的巧思。舒适的握柄和精心校准的弹兜让它用起来得心应手。

source: An unusual amount of ingenuity has gone into the creation of this sling. Its comfortable grip and carefully calibrated cradle makes it a joy to use.
translation: 制造这条投石索投入了非同寻常的巧思。舒适的握柄和精心校准的弹兜让它用起来得心应手。

raw_item.translation: 这条投石索做工如此精良、设计如此考究，拿它和其他同类武器相比几乎是一种侮辱。

source: This sling is so well made, so carefully designed, that comparing it to other weapons of its type is almost an insult.
translation: 这条投石索做工如此精良、设计如此考究，拿它和其他同类武器相比几乎是一种侮辱。

raw_item.translation: 松木号并非做盾牌的最佳木材，但它来源充足，而且总比用手臂去挡一击强得多。

source: Pine isn't the best wood for a shield, but it's abundant and it certainly beats blocking a blow with your arm.
translation: 松木号并非做盾牌的最佳木材，但它来源充足，而且总比用手臂去挡一击强得多。

raw_item.translation: 这面盾牌取自一棵正值壮年的冷杉，比松木盾更坚固，又不会增加太多重量。

source: Made from a fir cut down in its prime, this shield is tougher than its pine counterparts without adding too much weight.
translation: 这面盾牌取自一棵正值壮年的冷杉，比松木盾更坚固，又不会增加太多重量。

raw_item.translation: 用已治愈的皮革给松木盾加衬，能显著提升盾牌的结构稳固性，并防止木刺伤人。

source: Padding a pine shield with cured leather improves the structural integrity of the shield significantly and protects against slinters.
translation: 用已治愈的皮革给松木盾加衬，能显著提升盾牌的结构稳固性，并防止木刺伤人。

raw_item.translation: 这面耐用的皮革加衬冷杉木盾还加固了握柄与木材连接处的区域，从而得到进一步改良。

source: This durable leather-padded fir shield has been further improved by reinforcing the areas where its grip connects to the wood.
translation: 这面耐用的皮革加衬冷杉木盾还加固了握柄与木材连接处的区域，从而得到进一步改良。

raw_item.translation: 这样的盾牌挂在国王的宝座后面。它结构坚固，配上绘饰精美的已治愈皮革，说不定能挡住一头冲来的公牛。

source: Shields like this hang behind the thrones of kings. With its sturdy build and beautifully painted cured leather, it might stop a charging bull.
translation: 这样的盾牌挂在国王的宝座后面。它结构坚固，配上绘饰精美的已治愈皮革，说不定能挡住一头冲来的公牛。

raw_item.translation: 猎人利奥特和西格丽德住在这里，这样能靠近森林。凯蒂尔在里屋有张床。

source: The hunters Ljotr and Sigridr live here, where they can be close to the forest. Ketill has a bed in the back.
translation: 猎人利奥特和西格丽德住在这里，这样能靠近森林。凯蒂尔在里屋有张床。

raw_item.translation: 这座小农场属于埃迪丝，她是阿尔瓦尔德的遗孀，和两个儿子住在这里。

source: This small farm belongs to Eydis, the widow of Alvaldr, who lives here with her two sons.
translation: 这座小农场属于埃迪丝，她是阿尔瓦尔德的遗孀，和两个儿子住在这里。

raw_item.translation: 内夫娅和她的母亲比约格迪丝以及她的双胞胎姐妹埃芙拉住在这里。这个时辰去打扰她们可不礼貌。

source: Nefja lives here with her mother Bjørgdis and her twin sister Eyfura. It would be impolite to impose yourself on them at this hour.
translation: 内夫娅和她的母亲比约格迪丝以及她的双胞胎姐妹埃芙拉住在这里。这个时辰去打扰她们可不礼貌。

raw_item.translation: 宴席的剩菜还在壁炉上欢快地咕嘟冒泡。这锅炖菜只要保存得当，能吃上好几个月。

source: Left-overs from the feast still bubble merrily over the fireplace. This stew will last for months if you treat it well.
translation: 宴席的剩菜还在壁炉上欢快地咕嘟冒泡。这锅炖菜只要保存得当，能吃上好几个月。

raw_item.translation: 你父亲打造的第一把剑。算不上什么好武器，但作为初次尝试倒也不差。

source: The first sword your father forged. It's not a great weapon, but it's not a bad first effort.
translation: 你父亲打造的第一把剑。算不上什么好武器，但作为初次尝试倒也不差。

raw_item.translation: 内夫娅和埃芙拉同睡一张床。内夫娅的一堆装备藏在床架下，像个见不得人的秘密。

source: Nefja and Eyfura share a bed. A pile of Nefja's equipment is stashed under the frame like a shameful secret.
translation: 内夫娅和埃芙拉同睡一张床。内夫娅的一堆装备藏在床架下，像个见不得人的秘密。

raw_item.translation: 作为猎人的饭食，这锅炖菜无论卖相还是气味都出奇地叫人没胃口。显然好肉都卖给别人了。

source: For a hunters' meal, this stew looks and smells surprisingly unappetising. Clearly all the good meat is sold to others.
translation: 作为猎人的饭食，这锅炖菜无论卖相还是气味都出奇地叫人没胃口。显然好肉都卖给别人了。

source: A plate with some kind of sweet-smelling powder has been placed next to Freyja's shrine, among the pile of precious jewellery sacrificed to the goddess of love, fertility, and war.

raw_item.translation: 有人小心翼翼地把一柄精致的旧剑靠在奥丁神龛上，无疑是盼望得到这位智慧、巫术与死亡之神的眷顾。

source: Someone has carefully placed a fine old sword against Odinn's shrine, no doubt hoping to win the favour of the god of wisdom, sorcery, and death.
translation: 有人小心翼翼地把一柄精致的旧剑靠在奥丁神龛上，无疑是盼望得到这位智慧、巫术与死亡之神的眷顾。

source: The surface is marred by charred spots and strange carvings. With dread, you recognise the name of the fire-giant Surtr repeated over and over and over.
translation: 表面布满焦斑和怪异的刻痕。你惊恐地辨认出火巨人苏尔特尔的名字，一遍又一遍，一遍又一遍。
